First_Encounter.Transcription:
It's really great to see you again, Ms. Vertin—oh—LSCC Intern Researcher Eagle, reporting in!
I hope you still recognize me ... I've gotten a little taller.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
My detector shows a 73.2% chance of precipitation today.
But even using the latest technology with precision accuracy down to ten decimal places,
we still can't always predict what tomorrow will bring.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Ms. Marguerite once said that if I could find a way to incorporate my arcane skill into these detection devices in a reproducible method,
then she would help me publish a paper on it. I always find working toward a clear goal helps me focus.

Idle.Transcription:
I never picked up on it before, but each room—no, almost every location here—has its own energy field.
It's as if there were many independent worlds coexisting within the same space. It's truly amazing ...

Greetings.Transcription:
Is there anything I can do around here?
Analyze data, file reports, organize documents, draft letters, handle parcels, make coffee—whatever's needed.

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning! Before we get going today, would you like some coffee?
It's just the thing to help you get through a long day—at least that's what Ms. Marguerite says.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I really enjoy my current duties, but these quiet, monotonous mornings at my desk make me miss being a little kid.
I remember waking up before everyone else and hurrying outside to set up camp as quickly as I could ...

Night.Transcription:
You're still working?!
As much as I empathize with wanting to do your best, you should never neglect your health! Work can wait until morning.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I enjoy our nighttime talks. It feels just like my childhood dreams—
spending the night camping, gathering by the bonfire, and chatting in our tent until we drift off to sleep.
Now that I think about it, the Suitcase is just like one big tent filled with all our friends, isn't it?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Laplace's uniforms are made of a special material.
It's light, wrinkle-resistant, and most importantly, insulated and fireproof.
They say it's to protect researchers during dangerous experiments ...
Luckily, I haven't had to test that out for myself yet.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You mean this All-in-One Particle Detector?
It's a joint design between Ms. Marguerite and Mr. X.
Not only does it have the most advanced detection hardware, but it also includes a medium-intensity energy beam emitter.
Yes ... I suppose Ms. Marguerite is quite serious, maybe even overenthusiastic, about my ability to protect myself in the field.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
This was my father's insignia ... I like to keep it close.
Every night, when I polish it, it's almost like he's there with me.
I think that's what gives me the strength to get through all the challenges of my training.

Hobby.Transcription:
Since I started working at Laplace, earning merit badges hasn't been quite so straightforward.
They're usually given out as holidays or year-end bonuses now,
or "grown-up badges," Ms. Marguerite calls them.

Praise.Transcription:
That's correct. By clicking the "merge" button there, we can compare multiple waveforms to analyze what's happening around us.
You don't seem like a novice at all—much better than I was when I started.
I still start to sweat a little just thinking about that day!

Intimacy.Transcription:
I know I still have a lot to learn before I can become an official researcher,
but ... I've made a lot of progress from my days as an Eagle Scout, haven't I?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Every day, I find new things to learn, and every time I think I've got the hang of something,
more challenges appear for me to rise up to meet. I wonder how much longer it will be before I can call myself a grown-up.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
You and Ms. Marguerite are very different people,
but at the same time I see something between you—a shared sense of composure. I hope I can share it too one day ...
But until then, I'll try to follow your example as best as I can.

Monologue.Transcription:
I still want to become a soldier one day—a good one, like my father,
who protected people in need. Although I'm not in the military right now,
my training will allow me to help people in a similar way.
So, I think I'm still on the right track.

Deployment.Transcription: Eagle, reporting in!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Identify, capture, compress, fire!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: What's next? Should I whip up a report on ambient energy fluctuations during the fight?

Insight.Transcription:
I used to believe it was Laplace's technology that brought me this far,
but Ms. Marguerite always reminds me that
technology is nothing more than scrap without someone with the right mind to use it.
I must work hard to prove I'm worthy of it!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Improved components and faster processors ... Thank you very much!
I promise to put them to the very best use!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
We're well past introductions, Timekeeper, but I'm grateful to do so again with a name of my own.
I'm Ms. Stranger, though I'm glad you've welcomed me here not as a stranger but as a friend.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
A man once came to me, trembling. "Please, help me, Ms. Grace," he begged, "I know about the 'Storm.' Is this it? Is it coming?"
He had no idea it was nothing more than a rainy day ... It was simple to convince him to put on the mask.
But I wish I had done something—anything else.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I've worn so many names, living their lives, yet I know so little of my own.
My "home" has always just been a line in a mission file.
Once, I saw "Iceland" in one of those papers. I've never had an identity from there ...
Perhaps it would be worth visiting someday.

Idle.Transcription:
I'm still getting used to this new peaceful life—
Knowing I don't need to look over my shoulder anymore feels strange but comforting.

Greetings.Transcription:
Hello there. What brings you here? Anything I can help with?
I could handle some paperwork ... or perhaps forge some documents, if that's needed.

Morning.Transcription:
Ms. Bunny Bunny always makes sure there's something new for me to try at breakfast—her solution to my lack of "hometown recipes."
It's always been enough to satisfy my curiosity, and I can sense that she takes a great deal of joy from getting my unbiased assessments.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I was often required to work without sleep for days at a time.
If not for the Phototaxis rewriting my brain to keep me functional, I think I would have lost my mind.
But since you don't have that, you really ought to consider a better sleep schedule.

Night.Transcription:
The evenings here are delightfully peaceful: no more clinking glasses and scheming under hushed breath.
No need to listen in for intelligence to send off with my moths before the first light. Now, I finally have this time to myself.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I've noticed a variety of flying insects in the Wilderness. Some appear to be entirely new species.
They're drawn in by my lights and come to rest in my room.
Oh, no need to be concerned—I welcome visitors of all shapes and sizes.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
There were 17,608 incantations in my mind at one point. Though they're silent now, the scars will remain.
They may be activated again one day, but for now, I'd prefer to cherish the freedom we've fought so hard to win.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
People often mistake my fan for a wand, and I've never corrected them.
It's only meant to lend me a bit of ladylike demeanor.
Still, the less they know about me, the better, wouldn't you agree?

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
These needles aren't mere accessories—they can serve as weapons if needed.
It's a clever design; I'd suggest getting something similar yourself.

Hobby.Transcription:
I find that watching what people do here is a kind of entertainment in itself:
some dance to disco music, some spend their afternoons playing tabletop games,
and others watch horror films until they're left huddled up together with fear ...
Ah. I suppose it could just be that old habits die hard, but I'm still trying to learn what to do with my own time.

Praise.Transcription:
How can we possibly defeat Arcana?
I find myself asking that question over and over.
But strange as it is, despite my worries, I trust you will find the answer.
But it's only a feeling; I don't want to put the weight of all this on your shoulders alone.

Intimacy.Transcription:
My memories come from a time when I wasn't really a person—just a tool.
They feel like wounds, but they're mine to carry.
Besides ... there are one or two things worth remembering.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I've noticed that others here can be rather ... inquisitive about the "inside stories" of the Foundation.
Of course, I've never indulged their curiosity: it's safer for everyone that way.
That said, if you have any pressing questions, Timekeeper, I'd consider making an exception.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Phototaxis is designed to overcome an arcanist's "innate flaws"
by resetting our minds whenever intense emotional disturbance is detected.
I had always assumed that once the Phototaxis was lifted, there would be some kind of recoil—that I would cry all my suppressed tears.
Yet, even now ... there's nothing.

Monologue.Transcription:
Whenever my identity was erased and rewritten,
I felt as though my mind was forced into a small locked room filled with keepsakes:
a photograph of Kayla with her cattle, specimens from Grace's collection, a forged ticket from Newman.
It was like studying my own past from the outside.
That room is still there, but now its door is always open.

Deployment.Transcription: No one is afraid of flying insects here, I hope?

PreBattle.Transcription: An effective way of gathering intelligence indeed.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Even the most unremarkable insect may have a deadly sting.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Close your eyes. The pain will pass quickly.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: At the quiver of scaled wings.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Lift the veil of lies.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
I can tidy up or make this look like nothing more than a tragic accident.
Just tell me what you need.

Insight.Transcription: At last, the moth long abandoned in a dark corner comes to feel the sun's warmth.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
The rightful owners of those names are gone, yet their thief was granted a second life.
I hope, in time, I can find some way to honor them.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Vertin! I knew you'd catch up!
Does that mean you'll join us in our adventures?
Wait ... It's more like the other way around, isn't it? Since you're taking us wherever you go.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
One time, when I was small, my mam set out a bunch of toys and objects around me. She waited to see which one I'd pick up first.
According to her, I picked up a Prophetic Bird first, and so that means my future will be tied up with birds and arcanum.
Sounds nice, doesn't it?

Idle.Transcription:
If you keep dozing off on your feet like that, the fledglings will start building nests in your hair.
This isn't some kind of joke—it's happened before, and it's a hell of a thing untangling those twigs from your hair.

Greetings.Transcription:
Good to see you, Vertin! I spotted you through Glyndŵr's eyes ...
Oh, he's right there; he just turned himself invisible. Don't worry, he's a good egg; he doesn't use it to get into any trouble ... I hope.

Morning.Transcription:
"IN A MINUTE!" is what I tell them every morning before breakfast is ready, but do they listen?
No, they peck and chirp and bother until I've gotten everything just right.
*sigh* These greedy little birdies never give me a break.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
You're earlier than usual today ...
Ugh, did my birds wake you?
S-Sorry. I'll clam them up for tomorrow, I promise.

Night.Transcription:
Can't sleep? I've got some cheese that could help. Family recipe, with fermented Tylwyth Teg berries ...
Wait. Are you old enough to drink?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
When I was little and couldn't sleep,
Glyndŵr would fly me up the mountain to a spot high in the trees where we could watch the town below.
It was comforting knowing that because of our family, the Adar Llwch Gwins could live safely.
It made me feel like a hero, but it could also be so isolating.
I'd sit and listen to the cheerful sounds carried up by the wind as I fell asleep nestled in Glyndŵr's warm feathers.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Bechan is always tousling my hair around like this. Adar Llwch Gwins will drive you crazy at this age ...
but her belly is really soft to touch! Give it a try!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
The perch? Well, it was made from a flute.
Most Adar Llwch Gwin trainers need to use a flute to control them, even though I don't,
it just feels wrong not to keep one handy.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I've noticed I'm a lot stronger than the other arcanists. Surprising, right?
I've been wondering why that could be ...
Oh, is it because I'm always carrying these birds to and fro? They aren't too heavy, but it is a lot of moving around.

Hobby.Transcription:
I'm tinkering with an incantation I designed for the birds.
It's a combination of a dream incantation and a calming incantation. In theory, it should ease them into sweet dreams every night ...
Oh? You want to try it? Well, I haven't really tried it on people yet.

Intimacy.Transcription:
There are a lot of fledglings in the Adar Llwch Gwins' nest that you haven't met.
You should come visit us again sometime—
well, except the molting season. You wouldn't want to spend the entire visit sneezing.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Fantastic news! Mam's enrolled me in a school that lets students bring familiars and pets!
I can't imagine life without them ...
You must have gone to a real school, right? What was it like?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
The other night I ran into two people;
one of them had red hair and wore a suit of armor. She kept seeming like she wanted to say something to me, but she never did.
The other was a bit stranger—he hid his face under a mask.
He offered me a piece of chocolate,
and when I took it, he said something like, "Perhaps this is for the best. At least fear will trouble you no longer."
Despite the circumstances, they seemed friendly, like they already knew me ...
Do you think they'll visit again? I'd like to return their kindness.

Monologue.Transcription:
I was once trapped in the past, drowning in regret ...
but I've learned to move on.
I no longer judge myself for my mistakes, because those around me—my loved ones and my enemies—
have helped me understand that there is no such thing as a perfect ending.
To become a better person, the first step I must take is to accept my own imperfections.

Deployment.Transcription: Let's see if studying those Prophetic Birds has paid off!

PreBattle.Transcription: Bechan, it's our time to shine!

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Don't screw it all up this time ...

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: The flock is ready; so am I!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: O ancient beings whose wings beat in their nests ...

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Ancient spirits of Annwn, I beseech you.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Is it over now? Wah! The little ones are probably starving.

Insight.Transcription:
I've designed a firework show using Flamo Flicker and Drako Drought! Would you like to be my first viewer?
It won't burn your hat, I promise!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
This outfit has been in my family for generations. Mam had it altered to fit my size;
she enchanted this buckle here with all the blessing incantations she could think of.
And all the fledglings in the nest have already completed their first flights ...
It feels as if everything in my life is urging me to embark on a new journey.
That this is the right moment to set off.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
When the wind began to stir, mother rose and wandered afar.
That Spinning Wheel has a familiar glow ... Warm. Bright.
Like the sunlight that used to fall from the dome.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Ms. Cornerstone told me the dome was destroyed once, when the first "Storm" happened.
She said, without it, even bright days were dark and gloomy ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Hmm ... I wish to ride a train and visit all the places I have only heard about in songs—
stately statues, bustling towns, cheerful crowds ... I want to be a photographer and travel all of Europe!
<Where she goes, Honza goes!>

Idle.Transcription:
Each of us is like a little singing island floating on a wide sea—
we can only catch bits of each other's songs when we drift close enough to hear them.
I've heard people sing of puppets that never speak, the devil's tricks, and garlic that keeps evil away ...
Oh, garlic! I love it in beet soup!

Greetings.Transcription:
Happy new year! Happy new year, everyone!
<No, silly-wig! Not yet, it's not New Year!>
New Year's Day ... music plays, sweets on plates!

Morning.Transcription:
Vertin ... I ... um, I took a little bite of the food on your desk.
I had heard people saying how good a "pen-cake" is with a little "paper" on top.
But it tasted like old potatoes from the bottom of the cellar. It was ... really bad.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
This is Honza, he's my friend ... Don't be afraid, he is a kind little boy with a very soft heart ...
<Urgh! That's more sickly-sweeting than a sticky-sugar bun! Oh, Honza's belly is grumbling—is breakfast ready?>

Night.Transcription:
<Ru-bu-ska! Ska-bu-ru! Hehe! I like her, she's a real tricksty-trickster with her shadow plays.>
<Ooh, sending the shivery-livers down people's spines is so-so fun!>

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I saw the workers gathered around the bonfire at dusk, leaning against the ruins of their homes and strumming the guitar.
And they sang ... until the last of the day's light faded away.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Joy and sorrow, happiness and pain ... they all live in my head, like little people in a tiny house.
It gets a little crowded sometimes, but I treasure every one.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
<One little puppet, tongue goes splat; two little puppets, hands go crack; three little puppets, heads go boom! ... >
<Heh-heh! Did Honza scare you?>

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Ms. Heron said if I harness the stream of light inside me, I can help the daisies grow,
but ... what does that mean? I have never seen them wilt or bud.
They have always been as they are now, swaying softly whenever a breeze brushes against my skin.

Hobby.Transcription:
Vertin, come! I am listening to Ms. Lorelei's little conch.
Here—do you hear her songs in it too? It is also a kind of Echo Stone, isn't it?

Praise.Transcription:
Vertin, are you an architect too, like Ms. Cornerstone?
I saw how you lined them up—many little hexagons side by side ... hehe, so pretty!
We have lots of hexagons in our building as well.
We should've asked you to help with the construction!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Vertin, would you watch Jabberwocky with me? I have never made it to the end, and I really want to know what happens ...
What's it about? Mmm ... Well, there is a very, very adorable little black cat in it ...!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Ms. Cornerstone told me what happened after the "Storm" ... I'm glad I was able to protect everyone.
I like being with them—we sing together and watch many kinds of fun shows on the TV.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Something about Ms. Recoleta feels ... very familiar.
But I think I might have let her down. She asked me about architectures and their history for a new book she is writing,
but ... I couldn't really answer.
Voices, cries, songs, children's faces ... that is all that comes to mind when I think of it.

Monologue.Transcription:
There used to be a quiet sense of loss in the air ...
So many wonderings: How did we end up here? Where are we meant to go?
And what is it that has left us all behind ...?

Deployment.Transcription: Yes, I am here.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: *a low hum deep within the stones*

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: A voice echoed, a past returned ...

Battle_Victory.Transcription: You knew it true, it's me, my dear.

Insight.Transcription:
What a pretty light ... Almost as pretty as the sunlight streaming through the dome.
It is the light of memories—of songs sung on fields, troubling storms, and whirring factories ... of so many lives.
I will do everything I can to keep them from fading.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I still think about that building ...
I was told that before I lost my memories, I wished my friends a bright future.
And now ... here I am, walking into it with them.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
You saved me a room here ...? What do you mean "saved"?
... You mean I'm free to stay or leave whenever I like?
Hmm, are you a Timekeeper or an innkeeper?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
For a long time, I thought the weather was decided by the number of lights on:
three for rain, one for clouds, and zero for the sun ... until I learned that it's the other way around.
'Cause one day it was dark with no lights on, and the lords and ladies said there was a "blackout" ...

Idle.Transcription:
You really like to nap, don't you?
Maybe you need a bigger hat;
one of the Big Hats told me it's a good way to trick people.
He said he's never been caught sleeping 'cause no one can tell if your eyes are closed if they can't see them!

Greetings.Transcription: ... Oh, it's you, Vertin the Small Hat.

Morning.Transcription:
ㄍ-Good morning!
I never knew I should greet people until the lords and ladies told me to ... That's part of being polite, right?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
When I feel like skipping breakfast, I'll go out and play hide-and-seek with the sunflower boy—
I like to hide behind one of the paintings, and when he's distracted by the flying radio or a food fight,
I take the chance to move around ...
How do you sleep through all those noisy noises?!

Night.Transcription:
There are so many new things to experience here,
but I have to go to bed now. I wish my dreams were as fun as this place …

Bond_Night.Transcription:
You're always still up when everyone else has gone to sleep, just like the stars in the sky,
and they never make a single note of sound either ... You really are just like them.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I like your hat.
It reminds me of my friends; they wear the same kind of hats, only much, much bigger.
I-I miss them ... Could I borrow it for a while?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You know what? Ice cream melts slower in my left hand than in my right hand.
I never had a chance to notice that before I came to the Suitcase.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
The ribbons and lace on my dress used to tangle up a lot; sometimes they even got stuck in my arm's joints ...
so the lords and ladies made me an apron and a dress without any ribbons or laces.
It wasn't as pretty, but it did save me from a lot of yelling and punishment.

Hobby.Transcription:
The lords and ladies said I should love music because I'm an instrument ...
But that's not right. I do love music, but I love it because I am Coppélia.

Praise.Transcription:
You are a good conductor—I see how you guide their arcane energy and make them work as a team.
You could make a name for yourself if-if you ever join the Manus orchestra, I'm telling you!

Intimacy.Transcription:
I heard from Ms. Bittersweet. It was a long, long letter,
but I barely understood what she was talking about. Look, she said, "You need a proper education to improve your grammar."
What's that mean?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I met a red-haired lady the other day; she said she was lo-looking for new instruments for her "instrument combination experiments."
I got scared and ran away ... Please, don't let her know I'm here.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There was a time I had a friend—or maybe a different "me"—in my mind. I don't know whether they are a he or a she,
but we share the same feelings: they cry when I'm hurt, they chew when I eat ...
Where are they now? Mm, they-they disappeared after I tried to fight the lords and ladies.

Monologue.Transcription:
I've grown up a lot. No, not on the outside really,
but, em ... How do I put it? I can see the world is bigger than I thought and a little scarier ...
But you've grown up even more, Vertin. How-How did you learn not to be scared?

Deployment.Transcription: Get into line? Okay! I'll be number ... one, two, three ... five?

PreBattle.Transcription: Are they picking on you? I'll p-punish them!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Go on! Time for the show!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Follow the beat of my heart.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Raise your hands and start playing! Let it out!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
The invisible strings are gone!
Thank goodness you are such a good conductor.

Insight.Transcription:
Th-That's it? A-Am I better and stronger already?
Aren't you going to install another tuning fork or add a sound box in my stomach?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: So many sounds echoing inside me, but none of them have my voice.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
No need for further introductions, Timekeeper.
Now that I'm here, our cooperation is 200% confirmed.
So, if you don't mind, I'd like to hear your plan so the LSCC can prepare their next steps.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
People often exaggerate the complexity of cryptography.
Take the simplest example—look at the shadow at your feet. Its length is how the Sun encrypts the time.
Just wait for it to be at its shortest, and just like that, you know that noon has arrived.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The sphinx's reflexive riddle asks us to consider mankind and our ages.
Humanity once walked firmly on two legs: logic and reason.
But now, we hobble with a third—the ar"cane"—a fact that cannot be denied.
Greta figured this out long ago, but she also said I could keep living in "our" age.
Her definition of "our," however, remains unsolved.

Idle.Transcription: If you have nothing else to say, I'll be off to my room to copy down the note on my arm.

Greetings.Transcription:
Take a seat as you like. But no touching of the files and drafts around you.
They may seem messy, but I assure you, they're all in their rightful place.

Morning.Transcription:
Timekeeper, please tell Madam Lucy and that ... wind-wielding kid that I don't need either of their wake-up services.
You have authority here in the Suitcase, they'll listen to you.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Shannon prefers to brainstorm at dawn.
An understandable inclination, given that many researchers are not awakened by daylight but by their epiphanies.
Even that rock-loving pirate and "disco-diviner" seem to do the bulk of their creative work in the early hours ...
the secrets of the artist laid bare.
Here, my wall reinforcement application and purchase list for soundproofing materials. Please process it as soon as possible.

Night.Transcription:
Just leave me a bun for dinner.
The crosswords from the paper have been piling up for a week now. You don't want this place to end up a wastepaper basket, do you?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Wenn man im Dunkeln einen Berg erklimmt, sind nur die Umrisse der Felsen zu erkennen.
Doch durch wiederholtes Besteigen lassen sich die Lage jedes Tritts und jeder Felsspalte verifizieren.
Nun wähle ich lediglich einen anderen Weg.
Unvertraut, ja — doch das Ziel steht fest: der Gipfel. Es braucht lediglich einige wiederholte Versuche.
Schließlich ist der Berg da.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Cheek-kissing, hand-shaking, hugging ...
There are many ways to greet people, your head-patting being the most "innovative" among them.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
There's no rule against writing down your thoughts on an arm or coat sleeve.
Far easier to reach than draft papers, and reusable after a quick scrub.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
A cipher machine once considered "perfect" was proven to have one crucial flaw:
the ciphered letter could never be encrypted to itself.
This spared it from the contamination of self-reference, yet inflicted the system with an ingrained incompleteness.
Hah. Maschinen, Menschen — es scheint, wir alle müssen uns selbst referenzieren, um uns wirklich klar erkennen zu können.

Hobby.Transcription:
I enjoy the simple structure of a crossword puzzle, each clue leading to a single precise answer.
I've certainly spent many hours on them to ease my mind.
And more importantly, they're proof that the cogs in my brain still turn even in these disordered times.

Praise.Transcription:
It's hard to believe so many Laplacers have willingly gathered somewhere besides Laplace,
given how picky they can be in choosing friends.
You practically have your own branch here.

Intimacy.Transcription:
If thoughts could be presented in a binary system, everything would be far more manageable.
Unfortunately, while my colleagues and I are experienced in validating research conclusions,
we have made little progress in validating the mind.
Timekeeper, can I be certain that our collaboration has the stability to allow for long-term testing?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Ich versuchte, Gretas Denkprozess nachzuvollziehen, als sie dem Tod gegenüberstand — ein Unterfangen der Vergeblichkeit.
Ihre Entschlossenheit ist nichts, was ich simulieren könnte, selbst wenn ich mir die Pistole, die sie mir gab, an den Kopf hielte.
Vermutlich sind manche Wahrheiten dazu bestimmt, in der Vergangenheit verloren zu gehen
— ganz gleich, wie verzweifelt wir auch sein mögen, sie ans Licht zu bringen.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Arcanum is inherited mostly through bloodline, a phenomenon that is neither reproducible nor verifiable.
The whole thing reminds me of the agnosticism that haunted me for a long time.
But if it truly is unverifiable, its unverifiability must first be verified.

Monologue.Transcription:
To this day, I fail to understand why Madam Lucy appointed me as head of Laplace.
She knows I hate dealing with administrative work and that trivial matters wear on me.
Still, I'd hate to see the LSCC becoming a bed for power struggles—
and someone has to make sure we're on the right track.
All that is to say, if a true leader emerges, I'd be glad to return to my work as a researcher.

Deployment.Transcription: Part of our deal, I know.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Befreie dich von den Grenzen des Geistes!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: No written report needed? They should push your management style everywhere.

Insight.Transcription:
What puts weight behind the Laplace name isn't any hollow slogan or catchphrase,
it's the people doing the hard work toward it.
My burden has been light for too long. It's time I shouldered that weight for the good of all the LSCC.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Mit einem ungestörten Raum, einem Stift und Papier
kann ein Forscher innerhalb eines endlichen Raumes die Unendlichkeit erforschen.
Leider scheint es einen solchen Ort in dieser Welt nicht zu geben.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Never figured that I'd be summoned by a spinning wheel one day.
That's a whole new kind of bizarre. Compared to that, this Suitcase of yours is almost normal ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
When I was seven, the city started building this palace of sorts. It was a massive thing topped with a dome.
But by the time I turned 17, they had forgotten all about it. Now it just stands there uncompleted, baking in the sun.
Sometimes I like to go and stand beneath its half-finished dome, just to sit in its shade.

Idle.Transcription:
No worries. Just stand there, if you like.
You've got every right to take a little break with how much work you do.
There's no use rushing yourself out of the land of the living.

Greetings.Transcription:
You've got a habit of sneaking up on people, don't you?
I've known spirits that were noisier than you.

Morning.Transcription:
Want some? It's chilaquiles—tortilla and chiles—it's a good breakfast;
the tortilla gives you endurance, and there's nothing like hot chiles to wake you up.
That's what they'll tell you anyways.
I think people just eat what they've got and make the rest up later.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
"Limpia el campo antes de echar nuevo grano."
When you wake up, sit up for a while and just let go of all the problems you're carrying on your shoulders.
Then you need to focus on your work for the day.
I'm not much of a "planner," but this little ritual keeps me sane.

Night.Transcription:
Passion fruit juice, Miguel candle ...
Hey, Timekeeper. Just headed out on a job. Apparently, my latest client thinks exorcisms work better at night.
Classic, probably thinks ghosts wear bedsheets and say "boo"—
Huh, I look tired? Nah, I actually don't mind working late.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Burning white sage has a calming effect.
Give it a moment, breathe it in deep, soon enough you'll feel like you've been stripped of all your burdens.
Let the sage do its work and you'll sleep as easy as a corpse.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Huh? So, you can see that guy on my head too?
Careful. I've got the feeling there are more of them nearby.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I feel a disturbance in the pneuma! Quick, grab that agave incense and follow the smoke!
I see, I see; it's all very clear! The spirits are calling to you—Ahah, did I have you going there?
... Well, I thought it was funny.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
For most of my life I didn't really believe in ghosts—ironic, I know.
To me, life was a thing you could touch; something to be seen, heard, and experienced.
But I've come to see things a different way.
Spirits experience things in a different way than you or I, but that doesn't mean they don't exist.

Hobby.Transcription:
Ghosts are easy to get along with. They don't make much of a fuss or cause trouble.
Sometimes, though I didn't see it at the time, they've even helped me along my way.

Praise.Transcription:
You're a good leader, as far as I can tell.
You don't boss people around, and you don't expect perfection. Only effort.
Not many people are lucky enough to have that kind of leadership.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Working with spirits, I don't scare easy.
But damned if I didn't panic the first time I got pulled into that painting of yours. Bad memories, is all.
Part of me wants to whip out my gear and perform a purging on this cuadro maldito.
But I don't wanna mess up this nice lobby.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
If my parents had their way, I would be living the high life and making big money;
instead, I wound up living in a cemetery on my own.
And if I had it my own way, I probably never would have left Mexico City. But here I am in your Suitcase.
Don't try to be what people expect of you, or even what you expected for yourself. You gotta let adventure take you where it will.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Señorita Recoleta has taken an interest in my exorcism rituals. I think she wants to put them in her book.
Though, I don't think she's got the right idea about it.
She's been calling my candles "sparks of life" and the incense sticks "bows of abjuration,"
and my relationship with the spirits is apparently some "sign of divinity."
I feel like she's got me confused with a goddess.

Monologue.Transcription:
Memento mori. If Mexicanos aren't the masters of it, then I don't know who is.
We don't fear talking about death; we celebrate it and keep our departed close to our minds and hearts.
Because it's only when you understand that death is always with you that you begin to see how precious life really is.

Deployment.Transcription: Yeah, don't worry about me. I'll be right here.

PreBattle.Transcription: I'd rather deal with the unseen world.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Este lugar, este instante. Revelado ante mí. Mostrado para mí.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: ¡Abraza la luz... hacia las tierras más allá de la muerte!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Their souls will reach the bright side,
flying over blooming fields of marigolds.

Insight.Transcription:
I don't really much care for dealing with people. Living ones, anyway—they're too complicated.
Guess that's why I never got along well with my parents.
They wanted to make me famous. But I've always preferred the simple life;
I think that's what keeps me on the right path.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
If you do your work right the first time, you won't have to do it again.
Simplify your rituals when possible, always keep the incense burning,
and have the incantations memorized before you begin.
Put a little brains into your work, and it goes by much faster.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Oooof, that was quite a spin ...
Well now, would you look at you? Time truly does gallop like a wild horse, eh?
I am Paper Heron, humble Daoist, wanderer—and very glad to make your acquaintance.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Oh! Rain ... Quite unlike the kind in Huanzhou.
"A drizzle through spring blossoms holds no wet, just as a gentle breeze beneath willows carries no cold," they'd say.
You could walk in it all day and come away with only a few pearly drops in your hair.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Once, a countryman with ambitions to measure the land with his own feet urged me to put my journey into words.
I didn't think much of it then, but lately, it feels worth a volume or two. Or ten.
What can I say? Haha—there's so much worth remembering these days!

Idle.Transcription:
Why the sullen look, hm? Something weighing on you? Come—sit. Let's see what this coin has to say.
Heads, and all will be well. Tails ... and, well, let's just say you're in for a lucky escape.

Greetings.Transcription:
Ah! Oh, it's you! I'm still settling in. Not so used to staying in one place, see—especially with so many visitors.
Lucky for me, I have a few more centuries to get accustomed to it.

Morning.Transcription:
To follow the Way is to master the art of flow—unbound and ever at ease:
if you're tired, nap; if you're hungry, eat ... Speaking of which, what's for breakfast?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
A quiet morning indeed. Wait, this touch on my cheek, is it ... the morning breeze?
So soft, so crisp ... You feel it too, don't you?

Night.Transcription:
I often climb the highest roof I can find—watch the city lights flicker below, listen to the laughter riding on the wind.
It all feels so familiar, and yet somehow so very far away.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
It was a bright, silvery night—the sort where the moon bathes the world in a thin sheen.
For the first time in a hundred years, I climbed those stairs again, through grass that had surely sprung anew countless times.
And yet, there it was—the Mei tree, looking down at me from atop the mountain.
Hard to believe another few hundred years have passed since even that night.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
The flower on my hairpin—ah, the Mei blossom? You like it, eh?
It certainly isn't the easiest flower to favor.
Admired for blooming in frost and snow, yet cannot bear even the smallest touch of warmth.
Quite the temperament, I'd say.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: —Still does all a sword must do.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Scattered beans turned into an army, a river carved with the stroke of a sword—all child's play to me!
Just a ditch and paper-cut figures? Come now—large or small, life or death, everything is relative.

Hobby.Transcription:
The lakeside soil is rich—a fine place to grow flowers.
I've often thought to try my hand at gardening, but I never stayed in one place long enough.
Flowers speak of their keeper, don't you think?
Even the most talented gardener won't reap much if they tend them without care.

Praise.Transcription:
Carrying the vastness of heaven and earth in your mind, while holding the lives of the small in your heart.
If all who practiced Daoism were as steadfast as you, the world would be a kinder place.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Here, a paper cutting I made just now ... No, not a talisman—not a magic trick either. It's the real thing!
A sparrow, see? Adorable, eh?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I know people travel by other means these days, but I still prefer to hop on my mule.
After all, traveling is best done with a loyal friend by your side, eh?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
That human-faced bird ... Is he a Miemeng?
A curious race—given lifetimes upon lifetimes, yet ever searching for a cause worth dying for.
I suppose, in the end, whether our lives are long or short, we all pursue our own meaning.

Monologue.Transcription:
I was once told that a flower—its color, scent, its shape as we see it—exists only within our consciousness.
I wonder, after a thousand miles, if my world will be the same as when I first set out.

Deployment.Transcription: Your humble Daoist, at your service.

PreBattle.Transcription: Very well! Let me try my hand!

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Hmm, let me think on it ...

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: The workings of heaven remain constant.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Heaven and earth are one within me.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Not bad, eh?

Insight.Transcription:
At last, the veil that once distanced me from the world has lifted.
Its sights, its sounds, its tastes ... I feel them all again.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: "Be as a humble boat drifting on the world's boundless waters; so shall one find freedom in every land."

Enter.Transcription:
There are two kinds of tales on longevity:
one where an immortal is drawn to the world below, and one where a mortal longs for the world above.
But I would suggest a third: a tale of one who walks between the two.

Voicelines.Transcription: Ah, there it goes. Now, now, don't look like that; I'll make you another next time. Deal?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
A pleasure to finally meet you, Timekeeper. I'm Cornerstone, the Foundation's architect.
Ah, straight to the handshake—I like it.
So, what do you need doing? I'll get it done and then some.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
When I was little, I'd be woken up on misty mornings like these by my mum opening the front door.
She'd hurry downstairs with half-dry sheets draped over her arms, ready to hang them in the coming sun.
And she did it all with a smile—as long as she didn't notice the doodles I'd left on them.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Even in the plain, gray world we lived in, we dared to dream in technicolor.
Sunlight spilling into rooms, stars twinkling across rooftops—we'd planned this whole bright future together ...
But, I suppose I'm the only one left to realize them now.

Idle.Transcription:
Have you ever stopped to listen to this place? It has a clean, rational voice by and large ... except that windowed wall there.
Yes, that softens the tone considerably. See how the light comes in? How it lays a sort of warm glow over the edges of the—
Hmm? What's this material here ...?

Greetings.Transcription:
Oh—no, no, no! ... Sorry, Timekeeper—could you wait by the door? I just need to ... sort this out.
*huff* There. That's better. Come in—ah, maybe left foot first.

Morning.Transcription:
I know, I know, the floor plan's due the day after tomorrow. But don't panic, I always outdo myself under pressure.
I may have left young, but I've still got that five-day apartment-building blood in my veins!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
First thing I'd do when I got back to my apartment in Zurich was drop my suitcase by the door.
The second, a trip to the coffee machine, obviously.
Then, I'd wander over to the desk by the Corbusier window and check on some graphs ...
and before I knew it, the sun was rising again.

Night.Transcription:
Coffee break again! Too late ...?
The timing's perfect! Come on—one little cup and we're getting a whole extra night out of this one.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Shh ... Be quiet for a moment. Let the silence settle around you. There, can you feel it?
Its eyes, its breath, its attention. Buildings are nearly as alive as we are,
if we just slow down and listen.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I'm telling you, manners and a smile might just be the next most crucial things in life after food and clothing.
Trust me, a respectful and professional attitude will take you far ...
Especially when you're being stared down by an immigration officer.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I'm nothing without my suitcase. It's got everything
—scribbled ideas, my trusty drafting tools, sketchbooks filled with animal doodles.
But most of all, it has the perfect handle to tie the scarf I brought from my hometown,
so I can take a little piece of home with me wherever I go.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
It was a still, sunny day.
The building felt almost too big and too empty as I stood in that atrium, a little girl letting the sunlight drape me in gold ...
I'll always remember that as one of the rare moments when Silence spoke.

Hobby.Transcription:
Hmm ... I've always enjoyed the regularity and order of circles, rectangles, and triangles—
and the way they come together to form structures.
Oh! And arches! Haha! I'll never get tired of those.

Praise.Transcription:
Some people are so level-headed and orderly
that a chat with them is like flipping through Carlo Scarpa's sketches ...
Hm? I don't really have to name names, do I?

Intimacy.Transcription:
If it's alright with you, I'd like to keep a night light outside my room.
Think of it as my little beacon—a sign for all the night owls to stop by for a chat while I'm working through the night.
You'd be welcome to drop by too, of course.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Thinking back, it's a bit like a dream. Running up stairs that never seemed to end, reaching for the sunlit outlines of my friends ...
Even now,
I can still hear the faint echo of our little footsteps lingering in the air.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I always thought that leaving so young had cut me off from home.
But that building and those stones proved me wrong.
They've held the memory of me for all these years—and better yet, they're now helping shine a new light on the futures of many others.

Monologue.Transcription:
Under the arches of that Indian Institute of Management, an old man stood, his face scarred, but his eyes bright and clear.
He knocked on a brick and asked, "What do you want, brick?"
And somewhere from the shadows cast along its walls there came a long, trembling echo.
And he realized it had already given its answer.

Deployment.Transcription: All signed and ready.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Pushing close to the ultimate bearing capacity.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Model it, test it ... until it finally stands.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: This will hold.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Project delivered.
Did we meet your expectations?

Insight.Transcription:
Whoa, this is a generous budget. Far more than we need for the—wait, this is for me personally?
Oh, have I just won the Suitcase's version of the Pritzker Architecture Prize?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
An architect must listen intently, to the point where we forget ourselves,
before we can see what's been overlooked.
That's how we come to truly understand these structures.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
You spin the wheel in the primordial waters of the lake, and here I appear in an instant.
Perhaps this simple tool is how fate is woven—the purest form of arcanum.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Rising rain, falling rain—you do know the difference, don't you?
One erases your existence; the other gives you a cold.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I see the "Storm" as an opportunity—to see the dawn of ancient civilizations,
witness the very first "butterfly" beat its wings.
Ha, but for most, this is all a kind of nightmare. What a shame.

Idle.Transcription:
J'ai retrouvé la trace de tes larmes parfumées dans le pigment arcanique.
Alors toi aussi, tu t'es jointe aux recherches sur le rituel de résurrection, mon sujet d'étude le plus fascinant.
« La sainte qui pleure pour les innocents »... Où te caches-tu... ?

Greetings.Transcription:
Transitivement topologique... Calcul de l'exposant de Lyapunov maximal requis...
Quant à la condition initiale, elle devrait être... Statut actuel de Vertin ?
Oh, I'd like to run some calculations on your Suitcase—and you—if you don't mind.

Morning.Transcription:
Morning, Timekeeper. Up to much today?
I'll be eliminating—well—investigating a certain arcanist.
Managed to squeeze in a four-hour nap after a long night of data review, more than enough to keep me sharp.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
"Su rostro pálido y frío casi se fundía con el silencio incoloro que la rodeaba.
Contemplarla evocó en mi mente una serie de escenas siniestras,
que narraban la historia de una asesina esquiva y empapada en sangre."
I noticed Recoleta's novel on your desk. Is this what you've been reading these days?

Night.Transcription:
You know 37's "Twin Prime Conjecture Seminar"?
Hissabeth's prepared some calming incense to make sure it goes smoothly—rare stuff.
Why don't we join them? Might not learn anything useful, but at least we'll get a decent nap.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
« Pour véritablement comprendre le chaos, il faut l'embrasser pleinement. »
I like to slip into the rehab center at night to "borrow" the Artificial Somnambulism gear—
perfect for testing Chaotic Energy.
I'm sure you, unlike those fossils at Laplace, understand that arcanum is anything but ordered.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I like to keep my mind busy, especially when things get boring.
Right now, I'm analyzing "Storm" meteorological data, studying the research subjects' bios,
and iterating on an arcane sniper rifle.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Reforged from an Awakened lump of metal I melted down.
Even now, I still hear it wailing and clanging against my fingertips.
I'm messing with you—it's just a standard Laplace sensor glove.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I can craft you some things if you want.
Arcanist-tracking compasses, dream-peeking crystals,
Manus mask replicas ...
All on the Foundation's ban list, of course.
You can keep a secret, can't you?

Hobby.Transcription:
Scrutinize every detail of their lives,
study every trauma that shaped them,
and I'll read their minds and actions like a grandmaster reads a chessboard—
that is how I honor my research subjects.

Praise.Transcription:
Determined, composed, always focused on the objective—
a woman of action with the resolve to seek answers in the face of danger.
You and I have more in common than you think.
Interested in joining Lorentz?

Intimacy.Transcription:
X just intercepted another communication from the Foundation—a list of "defected" arcanists to be sent to the Pax House.
I'll take your silence as approval for us to ... make a few adjustments.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
One day, X turned up covered in soot and reeking of explosives—like a cat that had fallen down a chimney.
He told me he'd recruited a new member for Lorentz: a teenage girl scout.
Wasn't long before she was my virtual assistant.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
The LSCC—a shining beacon of science led by all manner of geniuses:
a "Hydra" expert in suicide notes, a piston plagued by low-battery anxiety,
a theoretical physicist with a penchant for jumping off buildings ...
and me? A mere meteorological observer. I slip right under the radar, don't you think?

Monologue.Transcription:
If some law or algorithm could predict everything—
every action and thought—
I can't imagine how unbearably dull that world would be.
But a world ruled by chaos? By the thrill of the unpredictable?
Now that's fun—even if it comes at a cost.

Deployment.Transcription: Seems dull, but it'll kill some time.

PreBattle.Transcription: Combat, science—they both take lives. The only difference is who pulls the trigger.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: All it takes are some minor changes to the initial condition.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Could the flap of a butterfly's wings in Brazil stir a tornado in Texas?

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Oh, I do like seeing their faces now—
beaten into the ground like this.

Insight.Transcription:
Aucune idée de la façon dont fonctionnent ces petits trucs scintillants,
mais je suis sûr qu'ils continueront de nous être utiles - tout comme ce qui se passe entre toi et moi.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
"Ms. Jones the Investigator" and "Marguerite the Meteorological Observer" are merely costumes I wear.
"Lorentz Butterfly," though, she is exceptional, meaningful—
a symbol of chaos itself.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Like autumn, the dusk can make me feel strangely lonely.
It means losing another day ... Huh? The view in the Suitcase changes randomly?
Thanks! I still got a lot of work to do.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
There was a time when I hoped the future would never come and everything could stay the same.
But I don't anymore ... It's more fun to see the ending than to live the same day over and over again, right?

Idle.Transcription:
Look at the trees and bushes in the Wilderness. Don't you feel bad for them?
Even though they'll have long lives, all they can do is sit around wasting time ...
Like what I'm doing right now.

Greetings.Transcription: Oh, hey! Good timing! I was just wondering what to write for today's diary.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
What?! Your schedule is exactly the same as yesterday!
You can't just waste time like that, TIMEKEEPER! C'mon, I bought you tickets to a debate competition,
an art exhibition, and a movie! Get up, let's start moving!

Night.Transcription:
Becoming an arcanist isn't all upsides—regular old plants don't have to spend so much time sleeping!
I can't help but stay up late 'cause I never want the day to run out ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
The Mood Switch had another glitch; I had to smack it a few times to get it working.
I counted seventeen ants crawling on to clean up the food scraps.
The Timekeeper seemed to be in a good mood with bags of Dust and Sharpodonties in her arms ...
Alright, that's all for today.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Hey, hey! Those leaves have feelings!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Keeping a record is a significant thing to do.
It carries one's knowledge and experience down the river of time and passes them down to their successors.
It's, like, how civilizations were built,
and maybe, in our case, how we'll make things like they were before the "Storm"!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Nice jacket, right? It's warm and weatherproof.
Even though my leaves love bathing in the rain,
my notebooks and cameras aren't as into it.

Hobby.Transcription:
I'm really getting into the country music Barbara plays whenever she writes.
The melodies are so simple and steady, they make me wonder what life in the wild would be like ...
but judging from my notes, I didn't enjoy it.

Praise.Transcription: You are one of the few punctual ones among my interviewees. If only everyone could have your sense of timing!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Timekeeper! I just came up with a great topic, and I need to head out on a field trip right away!
Could you find someone to cover my shift?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Ms. Verity left over a hundred comments on my draft ...
I'm almost glad I only have a few months left.
They can be the next Reed's problem, haha!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I just finished my schedule for next month!
I'll ride the wooden roller coaster in Ohio, then fly in a hot-air balloon to the west coast,
where I'll try scuba diving, dog sledding, and bungee jumping ...
and last but not least, an audition in Hollywood!

Monologue.Transcription:
My past selves always leave plenty of records. Most of them are well-preserved,
some are even published, but a lot have gone missing and probably will never be found again.
I know that could happen to my writing too, but that won't stop me.

Deployment.Transcription: A combat mission? I love a new experience!

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: The wind blows in a rage.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Feel the power of the pen!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: The bio of a tuft of reed.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: A leaf bursting out of the soil.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Seize the day, trust as little as possible in tomorrow.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: That was wild! I gotta write a special report about it!

Insight.Transcription:
Hello, ma'am! My name is Reed, an editor of UTTU. My true form is a tuft of ...
Wait, you already know me, don't you? That saves me some time.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Hopefully, I won't have any regrets when my time comes.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Since I've renounced my role, you needn't address me by any title. Please, call me Cheng.
This is a beautiful place ... The lake mirrors the mountains, just as they do in my hometown.
A hidden paradise indeed.
My apologies for troubling you with a lengthy stay. You have my sincerest thanks!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
While on duty, fog was a nuisance to me—it blurred my vision, obscuring the trails I followed.
But now I walk into it willingly, for even the wrong path may offer worthy results.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I think I'll live simply for a time—sharpening my blade, growing crops in the Wilderness.
This world is unlike anything I've ever known ... I need some time to reflect on the direction my life will now take.

Idle.Transcription:
I had little free time as a constable, but the busy days gave me purpose.
I never considered that, one day, I would find myself at a loss for what to do.
I feel I need a walk. Please, excuse me, Honorable Mistress.

Greetings.Transcription:
Footsteps, light and steady, like a confident pony. Must be Mistress Vertin ...
Ah, just as I thought. What brings you?

Morning.Transcription:
So, when the short hand points at number seven, it's the Hour of the Dragon,
and when the long hand reaches six, one-fourth of the hour has passed.
Easy enough to understand—not too different from a sundial, in fact.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Good morning. I've just returned from buying groceries with Ms. Bunny.
Can you believe she procured a significant discount simply by handing the shopkeeper a piece of paper?
This "coupon" certainly is a marvelous invention!

Night.Transcription:
I heard crickets chirping when darkness fell, so I lit my lamp and tracked them down.
They're quite different from those in Huanzhou, yet still, they remind me of home.
Might the Honorable Mistress join me in a cricket fight? Though I warn you, I'm quite the competitor.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
"As fireflies hover low, I write this letter to Huanzhou ..."
Huanzhou ... Hmph. There is no returning there now.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
My mother often fretted over this mole; a fortune-teller claimed it would "bring misfortune and danger."
Hmph. This is my life—I won't let any divination decide its course.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Reforged several times, this blade now bears little resemblance to that which I received 20 years ago.
Still, looking upon it reminds me why I studied the blade.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: No, I have no particular fondness for deep blue. I simply wear it out of habit.

Hobby.Transcription:
Mr. Rabies may be a little slow, but he is kind and gentle—often spending hours watching over my crops.
What? Give him a bone as a thank you? That's no way to treat a friend!

Praise.Transcription: To offer shelter in tumultuous times is a truly noble act. You have my sincere thanks.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Mistress Vertin! Hurry, is there a measuring implement in the Suitcase? I believe I've just made my greatest catch yet!
Tonight, we feast on catfish—
and I shall tell the tale of the catch while we drown ourselves in drink!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
After months of study, I am able to chat enough in English without Getian's aid.
There are still times I can't find the right words, of course—though body language can solve that.
It is an honor to freely communicate with so many.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
As a child, I once knelt for three days in the ancestral hall for turning the leaves of a gingko tree to iron.
I didn't know it was a living relic until I had already stripped it bare. Thus I learned of balance.
Now, I pluck only a few leaves from each tree so that they might continue to live on.

Monologue.Transcription:
The past four hundred years passed me by in a moment ...
I do not know what this world has become or where my path will lead,
but one thing is certain—my blade remains bound to justice.

Deployment.Transcription: I won't disappoint you!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: You are in my jurisdiction!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Return to your positions.

Insight.Transcription:
I memorized every word of Huanzhou's laws, yet never found true justice among them.
They're of no use to me now.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I know I am but meager in the face of the evils of the world.
But I will not let it stay my hand—for the weight of injustice lies heavy in my heart.
And with your aid, I may lighten it—if only a little.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Oh, oh my! Thank God you let me stay here ... No, indeed, thank YOU, Timekeeper!
Look at this place! Isn't it the perfect spot for a frame? This is beyond even my wildest imagination ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
It was on an afternoon like this. An obscure artist sat by Lac d'Annecy.
The water was green and clear as the glass beneath the sunlight,
reflecting warm light across the model's hat, her brow, and her lips in a truly magical manner ...
And voila! I was "born" on the canvas!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
In my view, salons of the future will prefer brighter, geometric lines and make greater use of papier collé in their works.
Further still, their works will focus more on society itself; its mechanical factories and the alienation of labor ...
Oh, oh, am I blathering on? Pardonnez-moi, perhaps salons today are not so bad.

Idle.Transcription:
Excusez-moi, I hope you'll pardon the interruption.
I wanted to express just how much I adore you appreciating me! Your poise! So serene and elegant, like a goddess in marble ...
I can hardly tell who is really admiring whom!

Greetings.Transcription:
You, you're here! Come, come, have a seat ... How's your day?
I adore your hairstyle today, though it's covered up by your hat ...
Put all that aside, Timekeeper, please, would you speak with me a little longer?

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning, Timekeeper. Have you had breakfast yet?
I happen to have a spoon that automatically adjusts its edge to match the curve of your lips,
a cup that occasionally vaporizes liquid when angry,
and some damp Splintercat coffee beans from 1914 ...
Oh, you already ate?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Timekeeper, would you come closer ... a little closer, please ...
Right here! That is where the sunshine lights up your face without casting a single shadow from any angle ...
I want to seal that image in my mind!

Night.Transcription:
When people look at me in the tranquility of the night,
they'll find the extendable perspective of space within my two-dimensional image and notice the subtle design of the overlapping fragments ...
Everything is just as it should be!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
The salon in Paris never changes—
Those people with masks exaggerating and making fun of everything, yearning for a "true revolution" ...
I came to realize they only saw me as a means of storing their unwanted things ...
yet, sometimes my words found an echo ...

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Oh, you've gotten quite close ...
I understand it can be difficult to read a polyhedral face ...
However, there's a silver lining:
through Cubism I can express both my hope and helplessness in a multi-angular way ...

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I have experienced touch from many different hands.
Covered with pigment, with blood, or even darkened with ill intention ...
But none of them are like yours. Your fingers are both cold and soft ...

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Ou la la, could it be that you've captured the true essence of the world—
a reconstruction of reality, symbolizing the beauty of the unconventional ...
What? You just wanted to straighten my frame?

Hobby.Transcription:
Generally speaking, the ideal residence of any painting should maintain a humidity level of around 40%, a temperature of 20 ℃,
and a light intensity of 150 lux.
But for me, an ideal residence simply must include someone to chat with!

Praise.Transcription:
You didn't just provide a home for me,
but for every killer, con artist, and hyperthymesia patient who has sought refuge with you ...
You're a true collector!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Look what I found—A fedora from la Palais-Royal.
If you ignore the knife mark on the brim, it matches your outfit perfectly.
Please, it is best you don't know how I got it.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Life in the dark backstage of the club was at times quite invigorating.
There were at least three major thefts, and I believe even a murder.
At times I would hear Monsieur Pérez's cough and the rustling of the mice family and some sort of machine ...
What? You mean to say the mice WERE Monsieur Pérez?!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Mr. Taira of the Manus Vindictae always seemed to be a charming and old-fashioned gentleman.
Each month,
I see him applying oil to his crab face with his chelae usually at breakneck speed ...
And soon enough, he would return with a brand-new look—and by that I mean an entirely new body.

Monologue.Transcription:
I once simply accepted that my only purpose was to conceal evidence, murder weapons, or even someone's deepest secrets ...
You helped me to realize that I could say no ...
Maybe I should have long ago.

Deployment.Transcription: I-It's not my forte, but I will try ...

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Tu parles bien de la personne là-bas, n'est-ce pas ?

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: I am in the mood to wander ...

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: All that distress in the darkness ...

Attacked_II.Transcription: Things are looking quite dreary, mes amis!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Why don't we go somewhere a little more peaceful?

Insight.Transcription:
What changed my mind was never the Sharpodonties or Dust.
It was you—this place you offer, the kindness of your friends,
and the life you provide here with the chirping birds and the warm sunlight—all of it was you.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Oh! So all these things you've done ... you're trying to remove those indigo marks?
Good heavens, I must express my gratitude ... You really wish to bring back my true image.
Over the years,
I had begun to see myself as nothing more than a hiding place for unwanted things ...
I've nearly forgotten what it feels like to simply be ... me.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
If anyone here needs a lift, you know who to call!
I may not have driven much outside of Paris, but if I can survive those roundabouts,
I can handle just about anything.
Just tell me where to go, and consider it done.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Honestly, given all the horrible endings my family have had, odds are one of them met their end facedown in the snow.
All I know is that just the sight of snow puts me in the mood to hide under the covers; I wouldn't even drive—if I could help it.
Perhaps that feeling is one of my ancestors telling me to:
« Reste près du feu et réchauffe-toi, ma petite. »

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future? Like, a new life? Honestly, I'm not sure I'm prepared for that yet.
<Honestly, my dear, I've attended royal weddings that needed less preparation.>
As you can see, there are still many frustrating factors in play. Still, I think ... I'm looking forward to a change.
<And just what do you mean by that, pray tell?>

Idle.Transcription:
Actors, poets, scholars—they're usually talkative passengers.
But I've also noticed how often they drift into silence.
Most of the time, I stay quiet too, maybe because I never really understood what they were saying anyway.
What do you make of it, Vertin, my silence-loving friend?

Greetings.Transcription:
Bonjour, Vertin! I like your hat. I have one as well, though it seems they do totally different things for us.
It amazes me how something as simple as a hat can open up so many possibilities.

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning! Ah, I had the most amazing dream last night!
I was driving down a long, open road—clear sky, spotless windows, and the car was freshly cleaned.
I picked up a few people along the way, and they gave me sandwiches and apples in thanks.
I just kept driving, with no destination in mind, only the anticipation of the next mile.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Je me souviens, c'était le matin.
Papa a balancé le gros sac sur son épaule et Maman s'est agenouillée pour lacer ses bottes près de la porte.
« À bientôt, Adèle ! » ils ont dit, et je leur ai fait un grand sourire.
Je n'ai pu que leur faire signe au revoir tandis qu'ils partaient pour leur aventure funeste.

Night.Transcription:
Driving in the city is so much more exhausting than it may seem—you don't realize until you're in the thick of it, really.
Every night, I fall asleep the second I lie down. Insomnia? I hardly know the meaning of the word.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I've taken to keeping a journal lately. And writing postcards, too. Just a few words about the day.
Sometimes I find myself just repeating my old routines, like ...
like those postcards I used to receive.
I always hated how tedious and boring they were, until they stopped coming.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
These flowers? Well, it all began with a passenger I had once. She wore a flower in her gray hair.
Before she got out, she plucked a bloom from her bouquet and tucked it just above my ear as thanks for a lovely ride.
Since then, it's become a little habit of mine.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You're knocking at the door of Félicienne's room.
<It's hardly a mere room—it's a suite!>

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Two tenants sharing one body—it's a little cramped, really.
<I certainly would not mind if you choose to leave.>
I hope we can find a way to fix this soon.
<Hmph. On that we have a rare point of agreement.>

Hobby.Transcription:
Je n'ai jamais vraiment pensé à ce que je fais en termes de « loisir ».
J'aime bien l'opéra et la littérature, je suppose, mais c'est plutôt l'assaisonnement du quotidien.
Alors ... mon loisir, 'est juste vivre, finalement ?

Praise.Transcription: You have a sort of calm that few of your peers possess. I think you would make a good driver if you ever need a change of career.

Intimacy.Transcription:
You're one of the few people around who lets me ramble on about all the nonsense that goes on in my life.
I find most people prefer more heady subjects—literature, the arts, etc.
But there's beauty in the small things, too.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
That young lady runs her own ghost-hunting business!
I do believe I might propose a little partnership. I'll let her advertise on my car,
and then she can call me for all the shuttle rides her customers might need. It's a brilliant idea, n'est-ce pas?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
On dit qu'il y a une trentaine d'années, pendant l'Exposition de Paris, des gens du monde entier ont rempli les rues de Paris.
J'ai grandi en voyant beaucoup de ça, moi aussi.
On dit toujours qu'on peut trouver un morceau de chaque coin du monde à Paris,
mais moi, je préfère voir de petits morceaux de Paris éparpillés partout dans le monde.

Monologue.Transcription:
People rarely figure out what they're meant to do,
but the Taverniers were never given much choice except to follow the path laid before them.
Me—I wandered off that path; maybe because the only thing I've ever wanted is for my life to be my own.
Of course, what that looks like keeps changing. I suppose it defies prediction in some way.

Deployment.Transcription: Time for some teamwork.

PreBattle.Transcription: Will there be time for a nap later?

Cast_Arcane_Skill_III.Transcription: That's enough politeness for one day.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Up with a little spark ... and down it goes! Bon courage!

Attacked_II.Transcription: Let's not make a scene out of it!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Don't stick around for a fight you're bound to lose,
but if you win, run fast—
the police may be on their way.

Insight.Transcription:
Well, here we are, ending up in places we would never choose for ourselves.
But if nothing can be changed, then we must make the best of what choices we have.
Like bringing light into someone's day ... a small purpose I've found for myself.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Je crois que j'ai toujours su que le destin me rattraperait, que je ne pourrais pas l'éviter éternellement.
Maintenant que c'est arrivé, il est temps de rattraper tout ce que j'ai manqué.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Ah, the inside of the suitcase ... a place Matilda has often spoken of. It is an honor to finally see it for myself.
We have much to speak about, you and I—how fortunate that we have been granted the time to do so.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
This rainy season—in which the world is broken down, reshaped, and toyed with like wet clay—will be a long one.
Still, I do not find the uncertainty unpleasant.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future—had you spoken on it earlier, it would have been a dull, predictable subject.
Once, beneath the Sephirot's glow, I saw it as plainly as the past.
But now, with so much changed, I find myself just as curious as any to see where fate will lead us.

Idle.Transcription:
Silence often holds truths far greater than any words.
I appreciate you letting it speak—there are things which are more easily revealed to me in the quiet.

Greetings.Transcription:
Du chaos naissent les questions, et dans leurs réponses, nous trouvons l'ordre.
Pour ceux qui ne voient pas la voie du destin, la vie n'est qu'une mer en tumulte.
Mais en apprenant à la naviguer, on peut y trouver un sens.
Ah, je vous en prie ... entrez.

Morning.Transcription:
Another quiet visit? I do appreciate your attempts to bring some "surprise" into my life.
There are madeleines on the table—take one. Let your efforts yield at least some small reward.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Were the sun not to rise in the morning, dread would befall the world.
The constants of life console us, yet when given a life of constants, we soon grow numb.
We are all walking contradictions—and thus, it is never quite possible to wholly divine our futures.

Night.Transcription:
Mind the divination sprites—they have a habit of following diviners like myself.
They are not malicious, merely curious and willfully ignorant of house rules.
No matter how carefully I lock up the night before, the crystals are always in disarray by morning ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I slept in a suitcase last night. Words I never expected to speak.
I mean no reproach—the experience was ... refreshing. After all, novelty has ever been a rarity in my life.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Beyond the hair on our heads, Matilda and I share few similarities.
I suspect she would rather be remembered as a powerful diviner than simply as my daughter.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I often wander the fields in the Wilderness to feel the heavy ears of barley against my palms.
Ms. Bunny Bunny tells me that, when baked at various temperatures,
they may produce a variety of alcohols.
Though I admire her dedication to her craft, I feel it is best I abstain from her next tasting session.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Bien des Bouaniches m'ont dit : « Tu es un cristal d'une clarté rare,
par lequel l'énergie divine des Séphiroth s'écoule sans entrave vers le monde matériel. »

Hobby.Transcription:
Those who resisted the current and those who surrendered to it were both carried off by the river.
They were fragile back then, mere pebbles cast into the water, yet I found some joy in watching the splashes they made along the way.
But now, it seems, we may all find satisfaction.
For the river has lost its course, and what was once just a splash now carves a current all its own.

Praise.Transcription:
You are no stranger to the unknown—you have even made a companion of it.
It seems, with you, that I am the one with questions to ask.

Intimacy.Transcription:
The mist that hangs about the lake seems to send those who enter it into a temporary state of unconsciousness.
If only there were someone immune to its effects who could join me to witness the results of my divination ...
Well, Vertin? Would you grant me the favor?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I once saw music only as a metaphor for fate—
a pre-written melody played until our song's end.
But Ms. Voyager sees it altogether differently. To her, a natural minor might convey a tender concern, D major a bright joy.
I see now its quiet power, and how deeply it can stir the heart.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There are still those who sell tarnished crystals under the Bouanich name.
It is a time-consuming task to root them all out, but necessary if we are to preserve our reputation.
And in time, as the hazards of the false are made plain, the true crystals will gleam all the brighter.

Monologue.Transcription:
Rester fidèle à soi-même, c'est se rappeler que c'est le voyage, et non son terme, qui compte le plus.
Savoure les instants du chemin ... hésite aux carrefours, crains la route devant toi, doute de tes choix ...
Si un jour la Tempête s'éteint, ces jours me manqueront.

Deployment.Transcription: Let us see what we will achieve together.

PreBattle.Transcription: Many streams are converging in this place.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Dérive dans le flot des Séphiroth.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Prey caught in the woven net.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Sept en tout révèlent les Séphiroth.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Voilà donc ce que c'est ...
atteindre la fin, non par la prophétie,
mais par mes propres mains.

Insight.Transcription:
I once caught a glimpse of its true form—
a beauty so indescribable that, in its presence, I was made keenly aware of my flaws.
And yet, if mortal eyes may perceive it, perhaps it is not so far from us as I once imagined.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
To step into this "river" is to grow accustomed to groping in its waters, the body tattered and bruised along the way.
One emerges in a sorry state indeed—yet, perhaps this is what it means to be alive.

Lobby_Interaction_1.Transcription:
Pneuma, though captured in light, is a power which lies beyond our comprehension.
Through crystal, a diviner may focus that light, drawing it forth into this world as a single, discernible point.
And thus, we may grant a fleeting glimpse of truth.
So, choose the sphere of pneuma which calls to you, and let it be your guide.

Lobby_Interaction_2.Transcription:
The light has pierced the veil between worlds—and brought with it a prophecy.
Keep your senses clear. I am quite curious to hear what truths it reveals to you.

Lobby_Interaction_3.Transcription:
It is only natural to hesitate before the unknown.
There is no need to rush—the light will find its way to you, in time.

Enter.Transcription:
A steady point in the ever-flowing river—an island respite, where the weary may rest before braving the current again ...
There is no need to be concerned; I do not intend to pry into anyone's fate.
For now, I wish only to discern what course my own stream may take when we set forth again.

First_Encounter.Transcription: I am fully aware that I'm a guest here. So please, go ahead and conduct your identity check.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
