No matter how cold the weather, the boiler room always burns hot—
like Baba Yaga's clay oven in the story I tell Aima when she's feeling restless.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
My future plans? That's a question better answered by the young, Timekeeper.
Would you give me yours?

Idle.Transcription: Standing tall, eyes bright—I could see you making an excellent night stewardess.

Greetings.Transcription:
On a train, the conductor is only seen when the train is moving.
But here, it seems to be quite the opposite. What's this visit about?

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning, Timekeeper. I won't blame you for sleeping in.
It's the privilege of the young to do so.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Morning, Timekeeper. I have already crossed more than ten tasks off the list.
And it seems you slept well.

Night.Transcription:
Electric lights are certainly useful.
It's good to know my knitting won't catch fire if I hold it too close.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
While I enjoy a song, Aima says my singing hurts her ears ...
I suppose vampires have delicate eardrums.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I am glad to know you're not afraid of me—
these scars are terrifying to some.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Aside from their arcane talents, my hands are like anyone else's.
Yes, they were once bloodied, but now there are only calluses.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Are you curious what stitches I have beneath all this?
Best not to pry; you may have trouble sleeping.

Hobby.Transcription:
Marianne is a lovely young lady. The two of us have passed many nights chatting and sewing together ...
What? Does that surprise you?

Praise.Transcription:
Your suitcase is like a sanctuary—people of all kinds feel at peace here.
Good work, Timekeeper.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Stand still a moment. Now, let me see ...
Yes, the sleeves can go a little shorter.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The names of my comrades, the scars our shared conflict left them with—
they will stay with me until the day I die.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There seem to be some oddities in your logbook.
Ferrofluid, a scarecrow, televisions ... a radio?
These belong under "freight," yes?

Monologue.Transcription:
A single thread is weak, but bind the strands together and they become unbreakable.
Unity—that has always been my goal.

Deployment.Transcription: Please have your tickets ready for boarding.

PreBattle.Transcription: Attention, foreign objects on the rails.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Signal confirmed. Ready to depart.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: A minor incident. Let's continue the journey.

Insight.Transcription: The fight is not over—and I believe it is only through our efforts that it ever will be.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Greater power to protect those in need ... I will not waste it.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
What you're looking at is only a vessel of memories, a dead man following his duty,
a witness to the emptiness and the void that comes after war.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Many soldiers came to the front without any fear of the rain;
young men that imagined themselves bulletproof would despair as they were swallowed up in the mud of a collapsed trench.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future belongs to the living, yet I remain.
So long as there are still souls that must find peace and dead to be buried ... I remain.

Greetings.Transcription:
Guten Tag …
No, those aren't the right words, are they?

Morning.Transcription:
The morning arrives, and the grass peeks out from the earth,
growing over the countless soldiers that lie beneath it ... Their lives have ended, yet life returns.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
„Die Sonne geht wieder auf.
Die Lebenden halten es für selbstverständlich, dass sie den nächsten Tag erleben werden …
Schätze jedes Morgengrauen; warte nicht, bis du dem Tode nahe bist, um seine Schönheit zu erkennen.“

Night.Transcription:
The evening is quiet; it is strange to be in a place so peaceful.
On the front, voices carried over no-man's land; soldiers on each side could often hear one another speaking—even laughing.
There was never a moment of peace, death was always too near.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
„Nachdem die Bomben gefallen waren, blieb nur die Stille der Nacht.
Kein Geschrei, kein Stöhnen, nur das Schweigen und die Leere des Todes. Das ist das Ende aller Dinge.“

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
What lies beneath the cowl is nothing. Only an ordinary skull and the dreadful face of death.
You would not wish to see either.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
These hands are cold and stiff. They aren't meant to hold warmth or hope;
their only mission is to bring the peace of the grave.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Poppies, red and bright, grow in great numbers on the graves of the restless fallen, new blooms of life growing over tragedy.

Hobby.Transcription:
For the dead, there is neither joy nor pain.
There are no hobbies to be pursued ... But there are words and memories, both mournful and sweet, that can be dwelled in.

Praise.Transcription:
Your actions are at times hard to comprehend,
but your respect for both life and death has not gone unnoticed nor unanswered.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Death does not come as a ferryman, and there is no river to be crossed; it comes simply as the end.
If there is any meaning to be found beyond the grave, I ... have not seen it.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There is a ghost that has made an effort to capture all the most gruesome aspects of war,
though he made assurances he would not use it to glorify killing,
there is risk even in reducing death to a picture.

Monologue.Transcription:
Zuerst glaubten die anderen Soldaten, Paul hätte überlebt.
Sie nannten ihn einen Helden, überzeugt davon, dass er dem Tod auf wundersame Weise entkommen sei …
aber Paul verließ den Krater nie; etwas anderes tat es. Etwas, das bewies, dass niemand dem Tod entkommt.

Deployment.Transcription: A soldier has no choice in his duties.

PreBattle.Transcription: There is time still to avoid this fate.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Ich … will den Tod nicht bringen.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: There is no end to this misery ...

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Sacrifice holds meaning only in its warning—life is delicate and easily lost.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Please go ahead. There is work left here to be done.

Insight.Transcription: Beware of looking too deeply ... Only the abyss will be there to greet you.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
This body endures—even after the guns fell silent.
Perhaps it will only find rest when there is an end to war itself.
Until that day, I will remain, bound as both a guide—and a warning.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
This Suitcase of yours ... You carried it through the fires of war, yet inside it is a place of joy and comfort.
That fact alone fills me with wonder.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Raindrops falling on my armor remind me of my training.
The prioress would tap our pauldrons with her spindly fingers and say,
„Ritter zu sein heißt, jederzeit standhaft und pflichtbewusst zu bleiben."

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I wonder if the Foundation's search-and-rescue teams might collaborate with the Order I once served.
I'd be happy to act as a bridge between them.
I should like that more people come to appreciate true knighthood. That we help and protect far more than we fight and kill.

Idle.Transcription:
Thanks to my training, I've learned to embrace silence and appreciate the slow passage of time.
And no, it's not wasted; quiet contemplation is a necessary step toward gaining peace of mind.

Greetings.Transcription:
Your poised, gentle footsteps are music to my ears.
As a medic, you know what footsteps can signify—
when they come fast and heavy, they often carry death on a stretcher.

Morning.Transcription:
A pleasant morning like this is perfect for outdoor activities.
Would you care to join me for some falconry or horseback riding?
Maybe we could have some fun training critters together? Oh, no need for surprise—
I do have a life outside of the demands of knightly discipline.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Back at the monastery, matins were usually held at 4:00 in summer and 6:45 in winter.
But if you'd like to try it, I would be happy to wake you a little later than that.

Night.Transcription:
The cries of soldiers, the moans of the wounded, and the restless wind—they kept me awake at night.
Sometimes just to pass the time in those sleepless nights, I would watch the flickering flames of my campfire
and imagine them as tiny dancing creatures ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
... The night is the best time to release any pent-up emotions—
the pain I seal with my arcane skill can be almost suffocating at first but it fades with time ...
I can see why you might think it's a punishment, but I see it as a pardon.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Are you curious about my headgear?
It's an authentic line infantry helmet,
fitted with a padded cloth to make it less conspicuous in daylight. Go on, you can touch it if you like.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
It was only after I stopped serving my Order and began to focus on saving lives that I came to a deeper understanding of myself—
I still value the principles upheld by my brothers and sisters, but I've found I prefer more practical results.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
The color scheme of this medical uniform is excellent—
any wounded on the battlefield can easily spot me from a distance.
As for the enemy ... don't worry, I can take care of myself.

Hobby.Transcription:
I've been reading the Flying Broomstick Manual, Lieutenant Lilya calls it the "Safety Guide for Babies 101."
Ah, I envy those flying witches soaring into the sky. I should ask her to let me give it a test flight one day.

Praise.Transcription:
I'm not sure how to put it, but whenever I see you with that expressionless face,
I don't feel coldness. I feel a warmth—a presence that soothes and steadies those around you.
Could it be something hidden inside you?

Intimacy.Transcription:
You've endured unbearable pain, haven't you?
I know you prefer to keep it to yourself, but know that I'm always here. I will share your burden.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I ran into Marie outside the dormitory this morning.
She asked if I could give her a riding lesson, and in return, she'd help me practice with a rifle.
Are there any foothills nearby that would be ideal for target shooting?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
As much as I cherish the elan of "kavallerie"—the banners, hoofbeats, and gleaming iron—I wouldn't dare to wish for its return.
Nowadays, there is nothing illustrious about the charge of a knight.
All that is left is a dead soldier and a fallen warhorse.

Monologue.Transcription:
I was once quite reckless on the battlefield, if you can believe it. Far from saving anyone, I barely survived.
But that experience taught me something valuable indeed—that only by staying alive can I truly help others.

Deployment.Transcription: I go wherever I am needed.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Restraint is part of the training.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Mein Eid hallt bis heute nach.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Ich schwor, zu beschützen und zu helfen.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: I will remember your names.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Are there any injuries?
Just give me a shout, I'm here to help.

Insight.Transcription: I swore to defend the weak and oppose the wicked—I draw my courage from those words.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: This joy wells up from the bottom of my heart ... I want to preserve it and savor it again.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Je vous salue, Timekeeper. May our cooperation be a pleasant one.
You needst not worry about my accommodations—
little more could I ask for but the peace and quiet of your suitcase.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Back in Paris, when the rain fell heavy,
I would oft take shelter in a café across the boulevard in Place Saint-Michel.
There, I passed hours writing to Agnès. Without fail, the clouds would part by the time I sealed the envelope.
'Twas as if God himself did urge me to cross the boulevard once again to drop the letter in the mailbox.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Will this war ever end? I am unsure.
There is a way which seemeth right unto a man—ambition, fortune, a "new era"—
but the end thereof are the ways of death.
Yet, perhaps a dawn shall break, and in its light we shall learn to hold peace in the palm of our hands.
When that day comes, I shall return to Paris, open my little atelier de couture, and care for Agnès.
And, of course, you will always be a welcome visitor, Timekeeper.

Idle.Transcription:
It is not chaos on the battlefield that I dread, but silence—for it is in the hush that the mind wanders.
When will the next shell hurtle down from the heavens? When will a bullet finally lodge itself in my skull?
But this silence is different. In this, there is something truly peaceful—something to be treasured.

Greetings.Transcription:
... Oui, je m'en souviens maintenant.
Dans le bureau de grand-mère, nous étions assises à ses côtés, écoutant ses lectures lentes de Pascal et d'Augustin …
Agnès, je me rappelle encore le parfum du chocolat chaud dans ta tasse—mêlé de cannelle et de vanille …
Timekeeper, 'tis good to see you—no, worry not, you have made no disturbance.

Morning.Transcription:
Perhaps it is your habit to "surprise" your guests in the morning, but pray, there is little need to tread so lightly.
Your footsteps reached mine ears regardless, faint as they were.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
My fellow soldiers would oft say, "Treasure the morning dawn while you're still alive to see it."
The thought of it haunted me—that one day I might walk through the shadowed valley of death into eternal darkness.
But now, when I walk in the dark, I fear no evil.

Night.Transcription:
… Que ta présence me guide vers toi, et que ta lumière veille sur moi quand la nuit tombe—
Oh, Timekeeper, would you join me in prayer?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I pass my nights in many ways.
Gun maintenance, prayer, meditation, or perhaps sketching a simple fashion design.
It all depends on the mission we undertake come the morrow.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Long ago, the Lord's light shone upon us, and we did shed the mark of the devil.
Still, I yet wear this Gargoyle accessory—to remind myself of the impurity and weakness of my bloodline.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
There are others here who wield weapons akin to mine own—the officer and the Texan.
I spake to them of their reasons for bearing such tools, and they told me, as I did them.
Still, I pray that a day will come when not one of us need ever pull the trigger again.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
As these shackles weigh upon me, I can but hear Ladislas's prayers and feel Agnès's warmth.
I accepted their bondage, that I may not stray from the righteous path.

Hobby.Transcription:
I need but a measuring tape, a pair of scissors, a pencil,
and a sheet of paper to design a garment for any occasion—
be it cycling sportswear or a gown fit for a bal masqué.
Though the war interrupted my pursuit of fashion,
I never once thought to give it up. I'll return to it one day.

Praise.Transcription:
Those who devise iniquity and stoke the fires of war because it is in the power of their hand—
they will find themselves within my sights. I'm grateful you are not among them.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Timekeeper, I am grateful for your generosity, for you so freely offer up shelter.
That being so ... were a miracle to occur, and Agnès returned unto us,
would you extend your generosity to her as well?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The residents from various eras, the equipment and artifacts from the "future" ...
I think back to the day my aunt took me to the Expo twenty years ago.
Civilization is more resilient than we think, pas vrai?
I may never live to see a time free from war, but this place ...
it keeps a flicker of hope burning within me.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
On the battlefield, there is little difference between humans and arcanists.
We are naught but pawns to be moved by the commander across the board or numbers printed in a newspaper.
We can be anything. Anything but ourselves.

Monologue.Transcription:
By a blessing of the divine, Gargoyles are born with sight that can discern good from evil.
I, however, am not as gifted as my kin in this regard, so I rely upon careful observation to compensate for my shortcomings.
Yet in the end, it was not my eyes that guided me, but my conscience.
In those critical moments, I did not hesitate to bear the burden of sin, for I knew the blood would be upon my hands.

Deployment.Transcription: The battlefield is ever-changing, but I shall remain focused no matter what.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: My sight shall unveil the hidden.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: One for the sake of the many.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Now is the time for repentance.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Le glas funèbre sonne pour toi.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: A worthy victory. But the fight is far from over.

Insight.Transcription: I have trudged through the depths of hell and returned.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Progress comes hand in hand with iniquity.
Now my eyes, grown more discerning, see through their lies, and I shall halt their wicked schemes.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hah! Rubuska, the greatest vampire of the century, graces you with her presence!
Now, where is my welcome banquet? I do hope there's banitsa ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
In winter, birds hop around on the fields and peck at the crops.
So, I thought I'd leave my shadow standing out there—you know, to scare them off. But every time I lay down, it does too.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future? Hmph. That's a long, long time for a vampire! Do I really have to plan it all out right now?
Oh, but I do have an ending line in mind for my story!
"Till the very end of her near-endless life, Rubuska stood strong as a guardian over all she held dear."

Idle.Transcription:
Ah-HA! Someone's zoning oouut!
Haha, nothing escapes a vampire's eyes!

Greetings.Transcription:
Aaahh, so you've come knocking at a vampire's door ...
That's how all the best stories start!

Morning.Transcription:
I ... I'm tough ...
the sun's nothing I can't handle ...
But maybe we can keep the curtains closed just a little longer ...

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Chuga-chuga-choo-choo! Hop on, and let's barrel through the morning mist together!
Adventure lies ahead, and there's a whole life to live out there!

Night.Transcription:
If the night is the shadow of the sun, then could we say that vampires are the shadows of people?
I mean, people get scared of their own shadows sometimes, don't they?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
The cemetery wasn't all that scary. When the moon was full, it shone even brighter than a castle banquet.
But the steaming platters of food, the singing, the dancing—there wasn't any of that. Only silence and sadness.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Mама used to fix my hair with a wooden comb and braid it for me ...
After what happened, it got all scorched and tangled, so I cut it off when I found some scissors—even though they were rusty.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
One day, Tатко found a good piece of wood, and Mама carved it into a kaval. I blew its first note.
Heh. I've woken up so many people with this little thing—comes with being active under the moonlight, I guess.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Hey, don't you try to pick me up too! You can't!
Y-You're barely any taller than me!

Hobby.Transcription:
So many picture books about gallant knights and noble princes, which is nice and all, but ...
Hmph, where are all the picture books about vampires? It's not fair!

Praise.Transcription:
You're kind of like a vampire yourself, you know.
Calm, reserved, always thinking about something mysterious ...

Intimacy.Transcription:
Ooh-ooh, Vertin, watch this! I can make a shadow doll that looks just like you!
Come on, give me your hand, and I'll show you!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The train gets passengers from all kinds of places, and even the carriages put them into different classes.
But, in the end, we're all together, you know? All going to the same place. After today, there's tomorrow—for all of us.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Oh! I could conjure up a shadow double to do the boring jobs for you, if you want!
Only bad thing is, it can't speak—but, hey, you don't do much of that yourself anyway!

Monologue.Transcription:
Of all the vampire stories, this is my favorite:
The brave, powerful vampire helps her mortal friends defeat their enemies and heads home ...
And when she opens the door, there's dinner on the table, and her whole family sitting around it, waiting to eat together.

Deployment.Transcription: Fangs out—time to feast!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Feel like making some new pointy-toothed friends?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Now, give us a biiig smile!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Yeah! Haha! Vampires don't just thirst for blood;
we crave victory too!

Insight.Transcription: Blood is red, shadows are black ... and me? I think it's time I choose my own color.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Hey, come feel my teeth—do you think they're getting sharper?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I am the misthios, Kassandra of Sparta. Name your request, and I will do all that I can.
Provided you have the Drachma.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: A fine day. As Barnabas would say, the perfect weather for setting sail.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Many in this world have no say in their fate; we are forced from our homes to wander distant shores.
But I believe there is a way back for those that seek it.

Idle.Transcription:
I was born in Sparta, but it is not my home. Now I am but a misthios,
using my spear to help my friends and those that can afford me.

Greetings.Transcription: Do you have some work for me? Something you need maybe, or someone you need taught a lesson?

Morning.Transcription:
Ah good, you're awake. Care to join me on my morning routine?
Be warned though, you may have to get your hands dirty.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
There is a spot at the very top of the Akropolis that has a perfect view of the morning star just before dawn.
It as secret known by very few, but Ikaros has shared it with me.

Night.Transcription:
I don't much care for Perikles's symposiums, but if you can stand the speeches and politics,
you can always find an interesting character or two in attendance.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I remember my first kill—a rabbit.
Another part of Nikolaos's grueling training. It was good and clean, straight through the skull.
He told my mater afterwards that he was sure I would "bring glory to Sparta!"

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I would not recommend this life to you. To be a misthios means making enemies wherever you go.
I've even managed to get a sizeable bounty on my head.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I see you're admiring my spear. Beware of its edge. The shaft may be broken,
but it's still as sharp as it was in the hands of Leonidas.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
You must be unseen, merging into shadow itself. Do not emerge until your blade is ready to slice your target's throat.
Then you return to the sunlight as if nothing ever happened.

Hobby.Transcription:
Sometimes I wish my life were more simple. No cults, no oracles.
I always wanted to take Phoibe traveling ... But the fates had other plans for us.

Praise.Transcription:
Hmm ... You are a rare sort of person.
The wisdom of the Athenians matched with the bravery of the Spartans. Rare indeed.

Intimacy.Transcription:
When I finally saw my mater again, my heartbeat was louder than the waves.
I was afraid, afraid that I was ... not good enough.
But my fears were for nothing.
She stood there and opened her arms to me. I thank all the gods for granting me that moment.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Malaka! You don't know how much trouble Markos brought me—
cleaning up his messes was a greater labor than cleaning the Augean Stables!
I've been too long away from Kephallonia. I may not miss the Cyclops, but I do miss Markos' vineyard.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
When the Cult took Alexios, they became the source of all our pain.
But I will never give up on him. One day,
I will cleave my brother out of this Deimos and bring him home.

Monologue.Transcription:
I have seen too many wars, too many people dying, and witnessed the death of too many civilizations.
People are born, they live and they die, and at last their souls will return to the ground. Γαία, μάτηρ παντός, χαίρε.

Deployment.Transcription: I am ready.

Select_Special_Incantation_I.Transcription: I don't need the high ground to hurt you.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: You cross this misthios at your peril.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: They may beg their gods ... but their lives are at my mercy.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: I bring you victory as promised.

Insight.Transcription: It isn't Drachma, but it's not bad either.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
This place is as wondrous as the Forge of Hephaistos!
The Spear of Leonidas is shivering in my hand. It must be thanks to your gift.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Agiamo nell'ombra per servire la luce.
We are Assassins.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
In my memories it was always sunny in Monteriggioni.
Days like these remind me of the humid air of Venice.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I can't see into my own future ... But there is one thing I know for certain. What I've gone through, the battles I've fought.
My days of family and comfort are over. My life belongs to the Brotherhood.

Idle.Transcription:
Weapons wear and rust with time, and so do men.
Whenever I need maintenance, for my weapons or myself, I find my way to Leonardo's door—
the man is a genius in every art and science known to man and yet also a good and faithful friend.

Greetings.Transcription:
Don't think I haven't noticed you looking to pay me a visit out in the Wilderness.
Usually, those who seek to find me are looking for trouble. I'm glad you're one of the exceptions.
So ... Buongiorno, signorina.

Morning.Transcription:
You must savor the moment when you open your eyes in the morning.
It's a privilege denied many that lived just one day before.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Oh ... Grazie. Of course, I'd love to have an apple for breakfast,
it may not be quite as juicy as your friend, but it is far better than most apples I see—this one is free of Canterella.

Night.Transcription:
Non temete l'oscurità—accettate il suo abbraccio.
Per quanto sia penoso il trapasso, lieto sarà il tuo sonno. Requiescat in pace.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
There are those that claim to seek peace and order in this world whose true designs are shrouded in darkness and oppression.
While others dream of peace, but must fight every day to protect freedom and light.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
The hood can cause unusual looks—I know.
But many that might be curious are disappointed when they glimpse beneath it.
There is no great mystery, just a man like any other, except for the scar that Vieri de' Pazzi gave me.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: That blade is sharp, my friend. Watch your fingers, I wouldn't want you to lose any accidentally.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I first put this on when my father and brothers were taken. All these years, I've pushed myself to grow into it, whatever the price ...
But it's only now that I've finally begun to understand what it truly signifies.

Hobby.Transcription:
In Firenze, I often roamed the streets and climbed over roofs, racing against Federico,
collecting feathers for Petruccio, running errands for my mother and sister ...
and visited Cristina sometimes ...
But those days are long behind me. I still return to those memories often to give me the strength to carry on.

Praise.Transcription:
Few would be able to stay as calm as you did when confronting the Templars for the first time.
You have the makings of a true Assassin.

Intimacy.Transcription:
The Apples of Eden and the pages from the Codex have led me to uncover many mysteries,
and there's more still out there.
Whenever I've found one, I've always had the feeling that someone else is trying to solve them ...
I think I've discovered a strange truth that I am only a conduit for a message that eludes my understanding.
I believe you may understand.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I watched my loved ones die, betrayed by those I had called friends. Vengeance clouded my mind.
It would have consumed me, were it not for the wisdom of a few strangers, who taught me to look past my instincts.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
We are born to be free, but what does freedom truly mean? There is no book or teacher to give you the answers, to show you the path.
There are those who will take that freedom from us, and too many gladly give it. But it is our ability to choose—
whatever you think is true that makes us human. No one can take away your right to pursue it.

Monologue.Transcription:
Where other men blindly follow the truth, remember, nulla è reale.
Where other men are limited, by morality or law, remember, tutto è lecito.
In this modern age, we are not so literal as our ancestors. But our seal is no less permanent.
Are you ready to join us?

Deployment.Transcription: It seems you can use a hand, especially one with a blade.

PreBattle.Transcription: Straight to the point. I like that.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Abbraccia la morte.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Che la morte ti dia la pace che cercavi. Requiescat in Pace.

Insight.Transcription:
Hmm, a new hidden blade and ... an upgraded pistol?
Did you move Leonardo's workshop here?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: I do not remember making the decision to become an Assassin. This life, it chose me.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I have been chosen by destiny to bring order to this world.
There are only two choices available to you:
follow me and rule or stand against me and perish. Choose wisely.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: The air is humid and sticky. But I would rather the rain sticking to me than be bothered by that misthios with the broken spear.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
My sister, that sentimental misthios, still aims to see me reunite with her.
But the only aim of mine, of OURS, is control.

Idle.Transcription: My sword is all the family I need.

Greetings.Transcription:
Have you not heard of Deimos? The Demigod of Terror, rightfully worshipped by the Cult of Kosmos and soon enough the world.
And you should know that—I am he.

Morning.Transcription:
Fools crawl to the Temple of Apollo, begging Pythia for prophecies so they might avoid their fate.
But they will learn soon enough that there is no avoiding the coming of war,
and whoever does not stand beside me will be made to kneel.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
She isn't as hard to track as she might believe. I found her on Andros by daybreak.
Just as I thought, she denied everything they had done to me, and still claimed to want to be the "bigger person"!
So having guts runs in the family, does it?

Night.Transcription:
Have you seen the "wise archons" hosting their symposiums?
When the time comes, I'm going to destroy everything they've created. Athens is mine.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I will never forget the night they threw me from Mount Taygetos.
Their "Alexios" died that day. Only Deimos remains.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
There's more to being the best than pure strength. My so-called pater claimed.
Ha, nothing more than an excuse for weakness.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Whosoever touches the Sword of Damokles will meet their destiny:
either to die ... or to master its power.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: DON'T TOUCH ME.

Hobby.Transcription:
That woman has tortured me since I was a child. She made me suffer, taught me that the world is pain,
and let me learn to "welcome it like an old friend." Ha.

Praise.Transcription:
You don't call me friend, but neither do you stand in my way.
If nothing else, you aren't a fool.

Intimacy.Transcription:
I'm Deimos, a demigod chosen by fate, you see this and yet you still don't worship me? What is it that you wish from me?
Wealth, power, all of Greece at your feet? I offer it all ... if you are wise enough to serve me.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The like of Perikles and Kleon believe themselves to be wise,
they believe they can manipulate the masses of Athens to their whims like puppeteers.
I will humble them.
Once I have brought them low, they will see that I am the one who pulls the strings.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Since meeting my "sister," I've tried to figure out what she is to me. Then it came to me, she is a weed.
Trying to choke and destroy everything I've planted.
And you know the best way to kill a weed ... is at the root.

Monologue.Transcription:
A lioness will defend her cubs even if it means tearing another to shreds.
So, if even beasts know to protect their young, what then can be said of my family?
I didn't betray them. They betrayed me.

Deployment.Transcription: I will handle this myself.

PreBattle.Transcription: Your only choice is to kneel.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: My sword is the only guide I need.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Once the Sword of Damokles is drawn—

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Let the earth tremble!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: I am destined for victory.

Insight.Transcription: You think this enough to please a demigod? Let's not waste our time.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Don't presume that you reward me. That isn't the manner of our relationship.
Deimos is not pleased by mere trinkets.
However, I will accept them as a token of your worship as befits a god.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I understand it isn't easy for us to place our trust in one another, Timekeeper.
But you have my word—I will not speak of this place to anyone, not even my father.
This collaboration remains strictly between you and me.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
A perfect day to double down on physical training ...
Just kidding. You're not my soldier, and we're not in the army.
Go ahead, enjoy the day.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
That little firecracker used to relentlessly, almost annoyingly, pester me to take a break.
She said I should travel, play dice with her, do something, anything, for myself ...
Maybe one day, I will.

Idle.Transcription:
Are you always so quiet when you feel relaxed?
Or ... is it that you're still searching for true peace, like many of us have been since the "Storm"?

Greetings.Transcription:
...!
It's you. My apologies, Timekeeper. It's hard to unlearn the reflexes of a soldier.
Being caught off guard on the battlefield can have serious consequences.
But here, I will do my best to adapt to your ... hospitality.

Morning.Transcription:
Just a cup of tea to start the day? For a soldier, this is a quick path to malnourishment.
Come, sit. I've prepared some baursak and chai. A proper Saryarka breakfast will do you good.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Morning is quiet here. No jackdaws tapping at the window, no leaves being crushed beneath soldiers' boots ...
It almost feels unreal.

Night.Transcription:
Dinnertime is certainly lively. Criminals, scholars, law enforcement, even descendants of prominent families ...
all gathered around the same table.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
What is Zeno like at night? Orderly, I suppose.
Thousands of soldiers all close their eyes at once and drift into their dreams.
Well, "dreaming" isn't exactly the right word. It's more like a "передышка," a little "breather."

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Oh ...! I used to touch the sides of my younger siblings' faces in the same way when they needed a little encouragement.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Shooting gave me these calluses. I'm glad to know you haven't developed any of your own.
The first time I fired a gun, the recoil tore the webbing between my thumb and forefinger.
But now, after years of doing it, I hardly feel a thing.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
The baksys channel their arcane power through totems and silver.
Though I never became one of them, my baksy nanny gave me these silver pieces when I left home,
along with her prayers for my well-being.

Hobby.Transcription:
My dream of becoming a scientist, my old tangram, my family ...
I have lost much. Some were taken by the "Storm," but others, I had to let go of myself.
None of them were ever burdens to me. I just ... couldn't carry them any longer.

Praise.Transcription:
The Foundation has me listed as KIA, but I'm sure my arrest warrant still hangs somewhere in the building.
I have to say, I admire your composure, Timekeeper. Not many people could talk so casually to a wanted criminal like this.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Your efficiency is impressive, maybe because you're not as concerned with regulations as your colleagues in the Foundation.
Back in Zeno, every time I wrote a piece of paperwork for the Foundation, I had to take a few hours leave just to recover.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The "Flying Witch"? Yes, I know her. In fact, she's made quite a name for herself in Zeno.
We've met a few times, but there's always been a distance between us—
one I'm not sure will ever be closed.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
We are all prone to laziness, and it's all too easy to grow overly dependent on our arcane skills.
That is why I avoid using mine unless absolutely necessary.

Monologue.Transcription:
Ammunition, tools, even the stars above seem cold and unyielding these days.
But your fireplace ... It's warm. Makes this place feel like home.

Deployment.Transcription: A makeshift collaboration. I trust the team is prepared.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Enough. Time to clean up the battlefield.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Mission complete, no casualties ... a perfect operation.

Insight.Transcription: If we advance here and fall back along this route, we can maximize the team's safety ...

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I lost half my life to the "Storm," and I haven't seen the stars from Saryarka since.
Now I live and fight in a time that isn't mine in the hope that I will see the world I once knew again.
I'm not happy with what happened, but I do not regret the path I have chosen.

Lobby_Entrance.Transcription:
The first maps actually came from stories,
you know—about hidden streams, huge glaciers, and endless water.
And the first adventurers? They believed these stories—and they wanted to prove it. That's why they set out to see the world.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Wow ... Is this one of your waypoints?
It has plenty of space, doesn't it? And it's well-equipped too.
Oh, um ... You don't happen to have any hardtack, do you?
I only need one! Just enough to get me going again.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
One day the spray from the waves hitting the hull froze on my grandfather's back and formed a layer of ice.
Áddjá asked me to crack it—"Like you did with those stale Gáhkku!"
That trip down the Mackenzie River was a cold one. The snow just got thicker and thicker the further we went.
But even with the wind biting at my ungloved hand, I shakily captured the breathless wonders of traveling in my journal.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Ordinary, extraordinary ... I guess I've never really given it much thought.
All I know is that I set out to find something, and I found it.
All that confusion and fear ... It's gone. And what didn't exist now exists through me.

Idle.Transcription:
Just because you're silent doesn't mean everything else is.
If you lie down flat among the grass—you know, really press your body against the earth and listen, you'll hear it—
the tree roots stretching beneath you, the gentle flow of a mountain stream, and the whispers of the Mother Spirit.

Greetings.Transcription: You're setting off again, right? And you'd like me to travel with you too? Of course I'll come along!

Morning.Transcription:
When the sun and moon no longer mark the passing of time,
we only have the start and end of our dreams to tell the difference between night and day.
The power to decide when a new day begins is in our hands ...
Oh, and now my wings, too.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
The sun always rises late during polar night—sometimes, only for four or so hours.
When dusk falls again, the sky turns a deep purple.
It stretches on and on, over the town, past the mountains, even beyond the glaciers.
It looms over us, just like that mystery loomed over us for generations.

Night.Transcription:
One time, on a dark night, our ship nearly crashed into the rocks. Thankfully, a sudden foehn wind pushed us to safety.
We really are very, very small in the face of the world. Oftentimes, all we can do is pray for nature's mercy.
I know I can do more now. But still, I'll always carry a deep reverence for nature.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
People always talk about my family—saying we're obsessed with discovering the undiscovered,
that we're one by one "drawn" to Antarctica to our deaths.
But they didn't see them die, did they?
Then, why do they focus on their bodies and not on the work they did to push the frontiers of human understanding?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Hm ... I'm glad I kept my face ... and my voice ... my memories ... my heart.
I want Áddjá to recognize me when we meet again.
Even with everything that's happened, I'm still Nautika, his "little treasure." That will never change.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Oh ... Yes, my wings! I usually only stretch them out in the Wilderness.
But ... heh ... I think it confuses the critters there.
Some of them went to sleep when my wings blocked the sun the other day—I think they thought it was nighttime.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Sorry! A-All I did was turn around and then ... well ... I knocked a few plants off the windowsill and, hah ... there they are.
Come on, Nautika, you'll be smashing up the wooden floors next if you're not careful.
No more breaking things, okay?

Hobby.Transcription:
Setting sail, festivals ... I cherish those days.
As the ship glides through the water, I can't help but feel that somewhere in that icy wilderness, a revelation is waiting for us—
a calling that binds us together through all the hardships.
And when we fulfill that calling, every day after will feel like a celebration.

Praise.Transcription:
You're very intelligent and so very skillful.
I'm sure you'd be the first to catch the whispers that travel on air around mystical places.
I think you have the strength for it, too—the tenacity to face the truth.

Intimacy.Transcription:
I'm always warm! I think that's one of my strengths.
My body's good at turning food into energy, which keeps me going and my head clear.
So, just stay close to me if you're cold, Vertin. I'll keep you warm.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Look, a flower—it's bloomed from the remains, a little life nurtured by decaying flesh.
Every part of this body will have its new place in the world as the wind and rain return it to the ocean once again.
Wondrous, isn't it? How life flows from one thing to the next, through places seen and unseen.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Oh, you know that deer girl over there? I bet she'd love one of our reindeer races.
It's so much fun—racing across the icy fields on the reindeer.
The winner gets a garland, too, for the rider and the mount.
Oh, but look—she already has a garland in her hair! Did she already win one? Čehpet dahkkon!

Monologue.Transcription:
I don't think I've changed very much—at least, not as much as my looks have.
The only change, really, is that I went from praying to a god to believing in myself.
Thank you, Vertin. For staying by my side since the beginning. For helping me become the new me.

Deployment.Transcription: I'll be here to catch you if you fall.

PreBattle.Transcription: There are many routes to travel, but only one destination.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: It all began with a shiny little stone.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Enter the gate and see the light.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Though it may come with pain.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Once shattered, now remade.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Can I give everyone a ride on my back? I think I can handle it this time.

Insight.Transcription:
A journal filled with writing and a sketchbook filled with drawings—
these are the most valuable memoirs.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I know I look different, but there's no need for another introduction. I'm still me.
Yes, I walked into the gate, but I also came back out again.
Just call me by the name when we traveled through the Roaring Forties together—Nautika.

0.Transcription: I still see her sometimes—that girl, scared and shivering in the labyrinth, lost in the vastness of the world.

Lobby_Interaction_1.Transcription:
Every journey has its challenges. So, with each step, I urge myself to grow stronger, braver, even more determined …
In the dark—in the unknown—curiosity is the light that guides me.
Even so, there have been moments where I hesitated, where I thought the cost might be too high.

Lobby_Interaction_2.Transcription:
There it was. A shiny, mysterious stone. I'll never forget the moment I first saw it.
So much was hidden inside that little piece of rock.
It glowed, calling me to that polar desert, just as it had called my family for generations.
And, somehow, it eased my pain.
That's why I'll never give up. Why I'll never stop moving forward.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Oh, hey. We've already met before at the Foundation.
I'm not here on a mission at the moment, so relax.
But do let me know if you need help with anything.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
You don't often see harsh weather in here, do you?
The climate is so mild here, apparently enough for the critters to wanna go out and get jobs.
It's good and all, but ... I think we still need a little cold sometimes, so we won't forget the danger it brings.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I don't think I can give you any professional opinion on the matter ...
But I want to believe we'll all be reunited one day.
That would be the perfect ending ... wouldn't you agree?

Idle.Transcription: *absent-minded humming*

Greetings.Transcription:
It was rare to see other people in the northern wilderness where I used to live.
But, whenever I did see someone in the distance, we always nodded, whether we were friends or strangers ...
Oh, not that I'm saying we need to do that every time we meet here.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Do you like video games too?
I was up all night with this one, it took me ten hours and 43 minutes to finish.
It's kind of like Leap King, only upside down.
I just kept jumping down over and over until I finally made it to the ground! There wasn't a reward or anything,
but it did feel a sense of pride and accomplishment.

Night.Transcription: People should take a break before moving on; they always should.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Я предпочитаю просматривать свою коллекцию ночью.
Мягкое освещение в темноте скрывает их ржавые края и придает им немного больше блеска, понимаешь?
о, что делает вещь красивой или нет, не обязательно зависит от ее конструкции.
Иногда такие аспекты, как освещение — или даже просто название, — придают разницу между мусором и сокровищем.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Braiding hair is so time-consuming, but I'm used to it.
When you have siblings and have braided their hair since childhood like I did,
you learn not to let your skills get rusty.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Look at this knife. It's so shiny yet not even a little sharp.
All it's good for is stabbing meat off the grill. Still, a nice little gewgaw.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Looking for something? I don't think you'll find it in my pockets.
Only a few old photos from Sergiyev Posad and some wooden dolls, that's all.
I used to make these dolls for my siblings. Of course, my skills have improved a lot since then.
Still, they loved them, I guess because we didn't have much else to play with during those long, dark winters.

Hobby.Transcription:
I don't have any kind of standards for my collection, and I don't spend much time maintaining them.
I guess you could say it's a casual hobby. But then, I'm very serious about keeping things casual—
it's proof that I'm living a positive life, don't you think?

Praise.Transcription:
There is nothing new under the sun.
People's secrets are nothing more than history repeating itself. I get the feeling that you'd agree with me on this.

Intimacy.Transcription:
What is the greatest story you know? I'd like to hear it, even if I've heard it before.
Different people find new meanings from an old story and can make for a start of a wonderful friendship.
I guess I'm just curious what connection we can make.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I've met a lot of other people with siblings here.
Life can be easier with family to lean on, but it doesn't come without its costs.
My siblings liked to wake up earlier than me, and since we lived in an old tent,
I'd always get blasted with cold whenever they got up.

Monologue.Transcription:
Before the "Storm," my siblings and I lived in a ragged old tent; it didn't do much to stop the cold from seeping in ...
My brother was always out working to keep food in our bellies; my sister had just started to talk.
I used to walk with her by the river ... sometimes I wonder what it would be like to walk into the rain.

Deployment.Transcription: With pleasure.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Don't worry. It's not going to hurt us.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: *calling whistle*

Attacked_II.Transcription: It can be hard to reach an understanding.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
I'm glad our employee evaluations take combat results into consideration too.
Everyone likes a victory. I'm no exception.

Insight.Transcription:
Basically, it was my own decision that made me who I am now.
The "Storm" and so-called fate only played a small part in my life ...
...Я стал Именинником в тот момент, когда написал это в своем заявлении.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Do you think this golden rabbit would like some friends?
I've thought about making more, but I don't have the same kind of wood anymore.
I worry that they might never form a natural bond, like ... ever.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
In the Utrennyaya we have something called a "suitcase trick."
We would put a suitcase down over a hidden trapdoor,
and one by one we'd disappear into it. The audience loved it ...
This trick though, is much, much better. Do we all leave from the suitcase as well?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
I remember Ms. Windsong took me out on a day like this and taught me how to measure the angle of the solar zenith.
She said I had a natural talent for it!
It was amazing to discover that light and distance could be measured so easily!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Теперь Алия, тебе пора начать вести себя как взрослая.
И первое что делают взрослые, - это находят работу.
Но сначала мне понадобится подходящий наряд, бант и новые туфли...
Hmmm, думаю мне нужна помощь.

Idle.Transcription:
Рамка может запереть вас внутри, когда вы не смотрите. Риск становится еще выше, когда рядом никого нет.
Это мне напоминает волшебный ящик, который мы использовали в цирке, только у нас была кнопка для его управления...
Я должна убедиться, что никто не останется здесь один.

Greetings.Transcription:
Look. I've just ironed my favorite dress. It's looking almost as good as new now.
I know it's a little old, but I love it so much.

Morning.Transcription:
I'm glad I'm not the only early riser here.
Back in the circus, we'd be out of bed while the stars were still twinkling in the twilight.
Then it was straight to the sink; nothing better to wake you up than some ice-cold water ...

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
The circus moved a lot, and sometimes we didn't have time to set up before the first big show.
Then we'd have to put our costumes on right over our pajamas.
They always bunched up around the sleeves, and it'd look sooo messy ...
What a nightmare.

Night.Transcription:
Однажды ночью, когда я пошла проведать Машу, моего медвежонка, я увидела, как она плакала у костра...
Скучала ли она по своей маме?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
When I first started training, I thought there'd be a wire in the rocket that I could hang on to while I was in space,
but it turned out that I was all on my own up there. So I had to imagine one; it took a lot of practice.
I'm still a little clumsy finding my balance in zero-g, but I'm sure I'll get better and better.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
That's so sweet of you. That reminds me of something that happened in space. Everything was silent ...
the stars were twinkling all around me ...
Then suddenly it felt like they became this big hand, patting me on my head just like you did.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Where I'm from, the air gets bitterly cold in the winter. My hands would get so dry and swollen. I haven't felt that once since I moved in.
It always seems warm here, though I don't think I'll ever forget that itchy, awful pain. *gasp*

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I sometimes wonder when my time on the wire will end.
Will I make it past 20—past 30?
Eventually my body will be too heavy, and my joints too sore and stiff ...
But until then, there's no point in worrying about it.

Hobby.Transcription:
I once visited a shop in Leningrad, they had a brooch there with this great big ruby on it!
I must have stood in front of the window for an hour trying to fit myself into its reflection ...
But it was too big for me. Maybe I just found it at the wrong time,
and one day I'll see it again, when it's ready to fit me.

Praise.Transcription:
I think your hat must be happy it's on your head, not mine. When you defy gravity as much as I do,
top hats are out of the question, no matter how cool. It's made for someone like you; someone that stands firmly on the ground.

Intimacy.Transcription:
When I was younger, I always wished I had a friend ... someone just like you.
We would have shared our toys, braided each other's hair, tried on clothes together, and then we'd get to grow up together ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
There is a story I heard when I was young about a paradise far away in the north.
A place with an eternal spring under a golden sun.
They told me everyone finds their way there—eventually. I don't know if it's true, but it gives me hope when I am scared.
That one day I'll see all my family again.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I used to worry about Ms. Lorelei and Ms. Cristallo's health,
but I guess they seem happy with their lives.
Ms. Lorelei taught me how to listen to her conch, and Ms. Cristallo likes to read her hometown's fairy tale to me.
Все, кто живут в чемодане, относятся к жизни очень серьезно...
Но, по крайней мере, для них жизнь кажется прекрасной.

Monologue.Transcription:
Mr. Kozlov would always paint my face before each show.
He told me I had to show the crowd a bright smile.
It's hard to smile when you're trying to keep your balance, but I learned.
Now—thanks to you, I don't need to worry about falling when I want to smile.

Deployment.Transcription: I'll keep an eye on everyone.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Or maybe take a deep breath?

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: I can always find peace up on the wire.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Даже далеко в космосе все всё равно здесь со мной.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Was I able to take care of everyone?

Insight.Transcription:
Моя семья вывела меня из большого шатра на металлическую крышу Лапласа,
а мои друзья забрали меня оттуда и отправили в космос...
Я не знаю если был ли это когда-либо мой выбор,
но у меня есть ощущение, что в дальнейшем я наконец-то смогу принимать решения для себя.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Everyone holds their breath when I'm up on the wire,
but as soon as I get to the other end, they burst out with cheers and applause.
I like to think my act inspires them to face the challenges in their own lives.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
It's a pleasure to meet you, Ms. Vertin. I'm certain we'll work well together.
<Ask her about the free snacks!>
Don't be rude ... You know, boss, I've got a bit of a sweet tooth ...
<Hiss!>

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
It's so wet. It makes me wanna put my hands in my pockets, but someone is always sleeping in there, and they're always cold!
<Hey, don't you judge us!>

Idle.Transcription:
I get to do what I love and get paid to do it.
Plus, my colleagues here don't seem so inclined to push their beliefs on me.
<Is that really enough for you?>
<What's not to love?>

Greetings.Transcription:
Hey, Vertin!
<It's Vertin! The Vertin!>

Morning.Transcription:
Can you believe it? I found another fish belly up when I checked on the tank this morning ...
This breed is so difficult to maintain I can't help thinking there must be scientific value to it.
Do you think I might convince some department to fund a study into "Improving Fish Survival Rates"?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Il y a toujours tellement de questions au début,
mais les gens finissent inévitablement par se désintéresser une fois qu'ils réalisent à quel point nous pouvons être étranges et différents.
J'imagine que c'est juste comme ça que sont les gens ; on aime s'intégrer pour se sentir en sécurité. Et nous ne faisons pas exception.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Once, back in school, I was sleeping when our classmate started screaming! Alexandre just shed his skin right there and then!
<I helped him wriggle out!>
<I just couldn't take it anymore! But the entire class stopped talking to us for the rest of the semester, haha!>

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I've read some research that proposes that human fingers evolved to facilitate hand-holding.
Nonsense, they obviously evolved to grasp tools ...
What kind of corny researcher came up with that?

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Are you curious about the texture?
Yeah, it's pretty cool, always sparkling and rustling! It's kind of how we perceive the world, through our skin and scales ...
<Let me slither on you! Please!>

Praise.Transcription:
Vertin, do you have any hobbies? Seriously? Just trying to make yourself out to be all mysterious?
Hmm ... You're such a puzzle to me!
But, to be honest, that's a good thing!

Intimacy.Transcription:
We're not so special really. Nine souls like any others, just bound together in one body.
One head, one mouth, and two eyes for each one of us.
Life's a little noisy at times, but no worse than what most people go through.
There's only one thing I really wanna know: who do you think "I" really am?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
We really must rid ourselves of this superstitious notion that arcane skills are "magic."
We arcanists simply have access to energy
that has defied empirical observation—for now.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
It is a bit strange in this suitcase, but in a good way, I suppose. We've made so many new friends here ...
<Punji!>
<And Kanjira! They're not siblings like us, but their bond is as deep as ours.>

Monologue.Transcription:
When we were little we'd fight all the time. No different from any other siblings, really.
Our parents would stare each one of us in the eyes and tell us to get along.
And we did—until they left us alone in the world ...
We fought a lot more after that. But we always work things out in the end.

Deployment.Transcription: Hah! I bet you've never had this many teammates before!

PreBattle.Transcription: Essaie donc de te cacher de neuf paires d'yeux.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Climb aboard and prepare to meet your maker—science!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Let's make you into something a bit more useful.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The stars are within your reach.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: How about you treat us all to some snacks?

Insight.Transcription:
Those aren't our scales glittering in your eyes; just a new material I've been working on ...
The world is changing minute by minute, and progress demands constant innovation,
no matter how useless it seems.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
What's this? I've got to warn you, if you think we'll be satisfied with just a bit of progression,
you've got another thing coming. We snakes are always greedy for the sunlight.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
A brand new home, and a whole new world to discover!
What took the Foundation so dang long to introduce me to ya?
Don't tell me they really believe that hooey in the papers?
What'd it say again? ... "Miami Animal Jailbreak Perpetrated by Squirrel"?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
It's comin' up a toad strangler now, ain't it?
Darn rain, soaked my nut collection, sendin' the pine needles all a'growin' in my tail—I trimmed 'em twice this week already!
Please, tell me the rainy season 'round here ain't as long as the one in Miami!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The Foundation vet had the cheek to say that squirrels only live for ten years ...
Hah! Fella must be losin' his marbles!
I'll have ya know, a pal o' mine up at the National Zoo just had his twelfth birthday!

Idle.Transcription:
...
I see through that poker face o' yers. Yer mouth may not be movin', but yer eyes're sayin' "Wow, a talkin' squirrel!"

Greetings.Transcription:
Good folks who pass under the tree'll get a leaf or flower on their head.
Bad folks, on the other hand, they're gettin' a hard old chestnut on the noggin'—spikes 'n all.
Oh, I ain't no softy like them pet store animals. I'm a true Floridian—tough as a pair o' old boots.

Morning.Transcription:
Mornin', pal!
Do excuse me for bein' the only one joinin' ya for breakfast. The Antarctic Advance Party's still sufferin' a little jet lag.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I saw your private lake over yonder!
If I had my druthers, I'd pull a century oak and plop it right down beside it. Whaddya think? Yer flyin' friend'll looove it—
Haha, and I sure would, too!

Night.Transcription:
Some nights in Antarctica, when the wind was howlin' somethin' fierce, the penguins'd huddle 'round me to keep warm.
Beautiful, ain't it? Squirrel and Penguin kind, comin' together as one!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Don't matter which tree I'm in, if there're squirrels there, we're all snugglin' up come night time.
Ain't no one worried 'bout where yer from, or where yer goin'—there I'm just "Buddy," ain't no "Fairchild" about it.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Yeah, yeah, pet the cute little squirrel.
But ya better make the most of it, 'cause I'm takin' this as my rent.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
The lieutenant gave me this pager. Thing's noisier 'n a mornin' rooster when you get a message.
Oh, I won't do nuttin' but press this here red button, o' course. I mean, whaddya expect from a squirrel? A phone call?

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
This tail o' mine sure came in handy in the Amazon—perfect camouflage!
But in Antarctica? Hoo-ee, it was like a billboard screamin'
"roll on up for a squirrel pub sub"!

Hobby.Transcription:
Ya know how it feels to ride a motorbike on the Golden Gate Bridge?
'Cause I do! 120 miles per hour, clingin' to the rider's neck for dear life,
and hollerin' out like I was the king o' the city!

Praise.Transcription: Aah, I see what yer doin'. We agents gotta maintain our sense o' mystery. I respect it.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Ain't many folks who'd sit down and listen to a squirrel, don't matter how much English he speaks.
Anyway, I still ain't sure ya totally understand the "ten tenets of animal protection," but I appreciate ya givin' me yer ear.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
O' course the animals in here are smarter 'n me—heck, even the fruit's all hoity-toity.
"This Buddy salutes you." Nah, ain't my style.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There's a reason I took my penguin pals all the way to Antarctica, ya know—the Miami heat had 'em sufferin' somethin' awful.
Since they been so kind as to join us in the suitcase, how's about turnin' the AC down a little? Say, to 60°F?

Monologue.Transcription:
I hear Sergeant Buddy Fairchild's still wanted by the Miami police.
Come on, you can't expect an animal not to help out his fellow animals!
Well, I guess next time I'm in Florida, I'll have to lose the gear and pretend I'm just a regular ol' squirrel.
But yer gonna have to cover for me, ya hear?

Deployment.Transcription: Another expedition? Well, let's hop to it!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: The smell o' the great outdoors!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Antarctic Advance Party—Three, two, one, chaaaaarge!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Another victory for the Animal Welfare Act! Haha!
Not one penguin was harmed in the fightin' of this battle.

Insight.Transcription:
Fluffy Duke, Scarlet Titan, Brother Jake ...
Yep, everybody's here!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
People call me an "arcanist," but shoot, ain't a squirrel just a squirrel?
Just 'cause I got a larger tail and can talk English, don't mean I'm some kinda different breed!
I mean, you don't look exactly like yer momma, but yer still an arcanist, ain't ya? Same idea!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Fabuloso!
Now I have an experience even more noteworthy than spending two weeks hiding out in a university bathroom
—being carried around in a suitcase!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Like ghosts, rain has always lingered over this land ...
Oh, I mean, it's featured in so many works: "It's raining on Santiago."
"It rained in Mocando for four years, eleven months, and two days."
"Lima's winters are trapped in a misty drizzle."
They all have a melancholy loneliness to them ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
When I was in Mexico City, I met a poet at a Gandhi bookstore who said we should leave the café and wander the world.
He told me that the most important thing isn't to write poetry but to "live the life of a poet."
After that, I got it in my head that I'd become some kind of gun-slinging cowboy!

Idle.Transcription:
... Oh, it's nothing.
I just have this creeping feeling that we're still trapped in a ghost town, or aboard a foolish ship, drifting eternally in restless waters.
I suppose this feeling won't fade easily, will it?

Greetings.Transcription:
Vertin abrió la puerta de golpe.
Llevaba una expresión que sugería que se había desconectado de la realidad en la que estábamos ...
Oh, hey there. Is there something you need?

Morning.Transcription:
Buenos días! For me, morning is the least suitable time for writing,
but it's perfect for a cup of coffee, a nice chat, or a board game session! So, why don't we get to work after lunch?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I've been collecting feedback for my new novel, 
Ruinas Gloriosas y directrices de metáforas
.
Marcus gave some very detailed critique,
but after sleeping on it, I've decided not to change a single word.

Night.Transcription:
This is a night made up of hunger, tipsiness,
and a poem describing the amber eyes of a jackal amid the endless horizon of the Sonoran Desert.
Sure, it's enough to get you energized, but it doesn't mean all that much in the end.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
On an evening as simple yet complex as this, it's only natural for the bonds between our feelings and reality to become messy.
There's no shame in admitting the loneliness in our hearts—it's not a bad thing.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I've always seen this hat that I bought in Mexico City as a symbol of the traveler.
Actually, it's not so different from yours or the Paracausality Researcher's!
We can swap if you like!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Yep, my new notebook's identical to the last one,
and I'll write my heart and soul into it, just as I did before. But something still feels different ...
Maybe it just needs some time to adapt—or maybe I do.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Hmm? Oh, I'm stronger than you think.
I've waitressed at busy restaurants, picked grapes in vineyards, and even woven yarn in a textile factory—
¡tienes que mantenerte viva si quieres seguir escribiendo poesía, mi amiga!

Hobby.Transcription:
Look, a grenade just exploded right before your eyes!
Now, how would you describe the condition and course of all its fragments in that moment?
Hah! This is what I've been researching these days—
how to shatter everyone and everything in a single chapter and send them all moving in different directions!

Praise.Transcription:
Hmm, I'm still not sure what kind of person "Vertin" should be in my new story.
No matter how I write her, it always feels like there's something missing ...
Oh, actually, I'm liking this direction: the origin of all regret, yes ...

Intimacy.Transcription:
I'll never forget 
La Cuerda Blanca
 magazine, even though I never received the issue with my short story in it.
The publisher went under six months later, you see. Still, I heard that issue sold a whopping 80 copies!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
We met in cafés, moved from group to group,
wandered from Cuernavaca to Buenos Aires, and bet everything on literature.
Because we believed visceral realism would one day change Latin America.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
First drafts are the worst but, at the same time, the most perfect—they perfectly reflect the rawest essence of the author.
From chaotic plots and turbulent lives to peculiar compositions and indescribable emotions ...
It's all right there in the first draft!

Monologue.Transcription:
Gifted books whose pages never got the knife; magazine publishers who were cursed to bankruptcy—I've seen my fair share of both.
So, yeah, I'm glad you cut open 
The Rise and Fall of Sanity
 and actually read it.

Deployment.Transcription: Bravo! A gloriously silly and thrilling act of improvisation!

PreBattle.Transcription: I have all the essentials for writing poetry—you, me, and our opponent.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Más allá del concepto mundano del tiempo ...

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Idealismo, vuelos de fantasía, patrones ocultos ...

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: En la acumulación de laberintos, suéltalo todo una vez más.

Attacked_II.Transcription: Not a fan of my work, I take it?

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
I haven't had a eureka moment like this in a while.
The poem I just wrote is amazing!
Huh? Wait ... you weren't listening, were you?
Then, let's do this again!

Insight.Transcription:
When all the timelines and storylines converge,
we'll have to leave everything behind and move forward once again.
I'm just glad that this time, you'll be here with me, mi amiga!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
The kind of person "I" aspire to become—
an embodiment of the dream to wander, a foolishly brave protagonist—
must also be a knight who fights for literature, don't you think?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I see the disarray and disintegration of reality, the manifestation of fate,
the brilliance of transcendentality, the ethereal images, and I see ... you.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Chaos, evil, desolation, cold—they all can twist one's mind.
Madness cannot be defined; it can only be described,
for, like this rain, it is the outward manifestation of greater turmoil.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
If there is no future within our reach, then all our efforts are inconsequential.
We are trapped in a cruel cycle of false realities crafted by some divine architect.

Idle.Transcription: Everything is futile, yes, but at least this exhausting suffering won't last forever.

Greetings.Transcription:
One lives, while the other dies.
One preaches peace and tolerance, while the other commits unforgivable crimes.
So, which one are you seeking?

Morning.Transcription: The fresh air and morning rays are a gift from fate, allowing us all to escape the veil of darkness.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Only when the sun kisses the horizon do I dare to gaze at the solar sovereign, burning in its most primal and pristine form.
Under its radiance, everything thrives and transforms.

Night.Transcription:
Careful, the night stimulates the madness lingering in our minds.
It's best you don't rush into things—you have a long night ahead.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
It's often on a tranquil night like this that the seed of conflict and chaos quietly sprouts.
Yes, every seemingly trivial mystery will eventually turn into a harrowing nightmare.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: There's no need to pry; you'll find no existence beneath my mask.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
The scope of human society must be expanded, and all forms of hidden or disguised suppression eliminated—
starting with the act of shaking hands.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
There is no true self hidden beneath our outer visage.
No, there is nothing "true" about what is simply shaped by society.

Hobby.Transcription:
This is the era of enlightenment, materialism, and Spinozism. This is the era of reason—
and that is exactly why we must pay attention to the ever-marginalized "madness."

Praise.Transcription: You're quite different from any other seeker of answers. Why do you not inquire?

Intimacy.Transcription:
I once imagined that the infinite world curled up inside a particle,
reducing my endless toil to observing a single point.
As I witnessed it constantly fold and unfold, revealing one secret after another, I would learn the truth of everything.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
While I quite enjoy 
The Rise and Fall of Sanity
,
I will refrain from offering further comments until Recoleta stops romanticizing her childish adventures.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I witnessed those ants climbing the Atacama cliffs, their line stretching for over 328 feet.
After a full day's venture, eight of them fell into despair.
But the episode was fleeting, and their silent expedition soon continued.

Monologue.Transcription:
At first, I sought relentlessly, fearing that this ever-flowing river of memories might only be a fleeting blessing.
By the time the sun had come and gone a thousand times over, the blessing had turned into a curse.
And finally, on the three thousandth day, it transfused into my very existence.

Deployment.Transcription: In the infinite loop of time ...

PreBattle.Transcription: We will experience all this over and over again.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: I—no, he'll know what to do.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: All forms of power at your fingertips.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Enough ... futile, all of it! Nothing but a mockery of capricious fate.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
In the repeating cycle,
we may feel regret, or even perish in the chaos.
Fortunately, this time, we were given a perfect ending.

Insight.Transcription:
The arcane currency called Sharpodonty and the Dust dropped from the Supreme Law ...
What answers do they provide?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
They died in that peculiar prison, but in a sense, they live on.
Now, there's only one prisoner left.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
So this is THE suitcase! I always wanted to see it for myself!
Oh, Timekeeper, do you think you could swing me a bigger room—somewhere dark and dry too?
I have a lot of memory films to store, 'cause I can't keep them in the Foundation's warehouse anymore ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Look at the specks of dust floating in this sunbeam. I should get some close-ups of it!
Ahh! I forgot, my nitrate film could burn up! Get me away from that window!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Others might see these tangled films as a mess, but I see how they connect the past and the future.
My mission has been to record these eras before they're washed away, all on Laplace special 35mm film!
It's an honor, don't you think?

Idle.Transcription:
It took me so long to prepare my costume when I went as Joan from The Passion of Joan of Arc!
First, I put on a straw-braided crown, then a ring on my finger, and an arrow in my chest ...
Then I'd say the classic line: "And if I die, I pray that I may be laid in consecrated ground!"

Greetings.Transcription:
Welcome to the Arcanum Containment Department!
I'll be your guide through Section F. Now, if you look to your right,
you'll see some videos from a Beyond arcanist in the 1990s, it's ...
Oh, huh ... I guess I accidentally put in an old reel.

Morning.Transcription:
Ok, let's start with a real treat, sourdough French Toast and cold cactus milk for breakfast!
*deep breath* Relax, Latham! You've got this, you're not going to totally mess up today!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I-I'm already awake! The only reason I haven't got out of bed is ...
You see, us machines still drain battery during sleep mode,
so we've got to stay extra cozy to keep our batteries warm.

Night.Transcription:
I have a recording from a time when the lamps went dark and bonfires were fed with scrap and old newspapers.
People in threadbare coats gathered around the flames, drinking their blues away and singing Daisy Bell ...
I remember it goes,
"Daisy, Daisy, give me your answer, do ..."

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I worked at a theater one winter, many many years ago.
After the projectionist left, I'd keep the movies playing. It was a rough time back then,
but if there was a movie playing then people could still come in,
the theater became a place to rest and be safe from the cold!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Please don't touch my head while I'm filming!
I need to keep the lens fixed, or the frame will ...
What? You wanna try hand-held shots? No way, José! Find yourself another camera!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Hold on, Timekeeper, let me put down my sleeve.
I don't want you to have to hold on to these cold machine hands.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
There is one big advantage to my metallic body!
It lets me carry the weight of my big old camera head like it's nothing!
Plus, it means no one wants to mess with me!

Hobby.Transcription:
It's hard to beat watching old movies!
My favorites are from the silent era,
it's amazing that they can tell such beautiful stories
with only movement and gestures!

Praise.Transcription:
Life working for the A.C.D. was too quiet. It was like being stranded in this warehouse of time,
watching the eras fly by on a distant screen, never having a chance to be a part of it.
That's why I'm so lucky to be here with you. It's like living in a movie!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Hold it! Don't turn around, don't move a muscle!
I'm about to get a perfect over-the-shoulder-shot right ... now!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Show call for Bette! The 58th Chaplin Imitation Competition has begun!
Take your cane, give me a spin—Perfect. Now go! We can't be late this time!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Is Noire working on a new movie yet?
Cause I'll be there to record it all—Just like back in Chinatown!
Oh, but remind me to remind her not to break my viewfinder this time ...

Monologue.Transcription:
I'm so lucky to have been awakened!
100 years have passed and I still exist in this world,
witnessing entire eras in life and film ...
Sometimes I ask myself, what if my journey is also part of a movie?
Could there be a director of the world, behind the scenes, controlling everything?

Deployment.Transcription: Oh, a location shoot? I'm coming!

PreBattle.Transcription: Can we use the camera dolly this time?

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Let me check my reels first!

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Phew ... I can't afford to lose those!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: I don't remember having a reason to worry!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Behold! This camera that will record the world!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
What a memorable moment, Timekeeper!
Don't forget to bring me next time!

Insight.Transcription:
Thanks for promoting me, Timekeeper!
I can't wait to go on my first field task ... if I haven't already.
