Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
People will say that you can waste film, but I disagree, every moment is worth recording!
Even the motion of a nameless wildflower should be preserved!
See, just a shot like that can carry the memories of an entire era!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
A small world compressed in a suitcase, the changing daylight and background scenery ...
I like this setting. Isn't this very much like a scene from a movie?
The moment our two protagonists meet each other for the first time?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Let a bit of rain fall on the scene at just the right time, and those raindrops will fill the space of any spoken words.
And of course, if any of my crew catch a cold from standing in the rain, I'll pay their medical bills.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I'll keep making films till the day I can't say "action!"
Aha! Perhaps, after that they'll make a film about me—a biography, about the aging director in her twilight years.
I hope there will be a few interested in my life.
I've said it before, movies can be about anything and anyone, including me.

Idle.Transcription:
In a way, you remind me of the big shots I met in Hollywood.
Always busy, always asking you to "wait a minute" before running off.
Luckily, those big shots tend to fall on the "big" side, so my puppets can always catch up.

Greetings.Transcription:
Action! You're in my scene.
In fact, the camera was rolling the moment you stepped into my room. You would've known if you'd read the script in advance.

Morning.Transcription:
Aa Sing! And all you other extra Kelefe! Stop dawdling around and get my wheels moving.
I've adjusted a line for today's shooting; we need to get there fast ...
What do you mean, LATER? We're going, NOW!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Back in Hong Kong, when we ran low on inspiration, Teresa would take us to Sam Mun Tsai to see the sunrise.
She said the reflection of the fishing boats on the waves was like echoes of the sun ...
Come to think of it, I haven't been there for many years.

Night.Transcription:
It'd be a waste to spend the whole night sleeping.
Why not join us for a game of Mahjong? It'll be a learning experience; you can pick up some Chinese from reading the tiles.
Don't worry, Ms. Moissan is a great teacher; you'll catch on quickly with her help. I'll see you later then ...
Finally, we have enough players!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
When I filmed the autopsy scene in The Mystery, I approached a medical examiner to act as a consultant, but he kept turning me down.
He would never have agreed if his young daughter hadn't spoken up for me—thanks to the "Ms. Olivia" puppet I secretly gave her.
After the first screening, Yat Yut Weekly called me a psychopath. I wish.
A psychopath would have enjoyed the shoot instead of throwing up their guts on the way home.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I know many celebrities buy outrageous insurance policies for their bodies,
their voices, hands, even their faces. Some people suggested that I insure my head like that, and honestly, I've thought about it.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I make puppets; I even give them flexible limbs and adjust their joints
so they can emote like real actors and actresses, performing exactly as I require.
Now, I've given my puppets an even more important job to do—to push my chair around.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I didn't appreciate what I had when my body was healthy.
I acted like I never needed sleep, or maybe I didn't allow myself to; everything was about the next scene.
Then karma caught up to me at the prime of my life—
it was only after losing my legs that I started to learn how to take care of this container for my soul.

Hobby.Transcription:
I've been thinking about why so many people swarm into the movie industry.
It can't just be for the money; one box-office bomb will drop you down to your last dime;
nor for the fame; the paparazzi will ruin your reputation before you ever set foot on the red carpet.
I think, ultimately, it is the "desire to express oneself" that draws us all in, like moths to the limelight.

Intimacy.Transcription:
... I admit the makeup will take some time,
but you can use the time to meditate or even just take a nap—I think you're long overdue one of those.
I just really want you to be the star of my next film. I promise it won't be too much trouble. Why not give it a try?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I'd be lying if I said I don't want to have a star of my own on the Walk of Fame.
But one can become so obsessed with chasing that star in the ground that they lose sight of themselves.
To truly shine as a star, first you need to widen your horizon as broad as the sky.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Isn't that girl the little "tiger" we met in Chinatown?
A great officer and a great performer.
Yes, she's untrained, but you can tell she tried to embody her character rather than just reading the script.
A real diamond in the rough, I'm telling you.

Monologue.Transcription:
Rehabilitation feels like a blow to one's dignity. It forces people to reveal the most fragile and flawed parts of themselves repeatedly.
But that's not why I refuse it. No, I choose this as a reminder that
I should've watched The Reunion of the Three Swallows when I had the chance all those years ago.

Deployment.Transcription: Battlefield documentary? A bold new genre for me.

PreBattle.Transcription: Aa Sing, Aa Zing, get moving!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Break a leg; we're ready for the finale.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Aa Zing, pick yourself up! Let's go!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Three, two, one, action!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Cut!
You should be proud. I almost never do just one take.

Insight.Transcription:
The movie industry is rapidly moving away from traditional film reels towards digital technology.
I often wonder what lies in wait for us next.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I'm not making films to earn fame or bask in the spotlight, but to tell the stories I want.
Still, it's important to reflect on myself now and then—the camera knows me better than anyone.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Number 007405, Liang Yue reporting for duty. Ma'am, please allow me to handle any investigations,
from surveying crime scenes to hunting down perpetrators.
Oh, you want to be friends? I see. Then I will adjust my mindset.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
There it is—the smell that comes when the rain hits the dirt.
It affects us, I think, bringing back ... unpleasant memories.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Ms. Poitier once asked me, "What kind of officer do you want to be?"
My answer was simple: I want to be an officer that can look into the victim's family's eyes with no regrets.

Idle.Transcription:
I used to struggle with meditation. If so much as a fingertip trembled, Father would scold me.
But when I started meditating on the balcony, I could hear the radio broadcast from next door. "Da-di-da! Welcome to the show!"
Then it became the highlight of my day.

Greetings.Transcription:
Hello, ma'am. I'm writing a report on the critter brawl at Dodger Stadium.
The first thing we learn as Vigiles is to always stay alert and always stay informed.

Morning.Transcription:
Back home, my mother would wake me up at five a.m., saying things like "the early bird gets the worm."
But five a.m. at the DAA is wide awake: coffee brewing, sirens blaring, and Chief Elden scolding.
*sigh* I suppose my mother had nothing to worry about.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
When I was little, I would run in the park before sunrise.
The world was sound asleep until the sunlight grew enough for the streetlights to shut off.
And as the sky grew lighter, so too did my breathing.

Night.Transcription:
I was born on the day of the full moon.
That's why my mother named me Yue.
Later, I realized that no matter how far from home we are, the same moon always watches over us ...
I have to go find a place where I can see the moon.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
It wasn't easy to arrest that woman, taking her away from her child in the middle of the night.
All I could do was pay a visit after the case closed and help the kid finish the house of cards they'd been building together.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Long hair must always be neatly tied up so as not to obstruct the line of duty.
You wouldn't want hair in your face when you're chasing a criminal.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Of course it can make calls. See?
I just seldom use it as a normal phone in case I disturb Qiangliang's rest. But I guess that's better than never hearing from it again—
I'm just glad to have the chance to upset it at all.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Hang your clothes immediately after taking them off, and iron them before wearing them.
Whether in your daily clothes or ceremonial attire, you should always look neat.
My family elders say that a competent successor should be responsible, and that starts with the little things.
We don't have any rules like that here, do we?

Hobby.Transcription:
In my hometown, people loved to go to the video room. I did too, but I had to choose my timing carefully.
On Wednesday's after 9 p.m., my parents worked the night shift.
That was when I'd sneak out to the Youth Palace with two Jiao in my pocket
and squeeze onto the bench to watch Detective C07.

Praise.Transcription:
I think the Vigiles training should include a class on how to work with your supervisors.
Your style of doing things is quite different from Chief Elden's.
I must thank you for your kindness, ma'am. It made my first day much easier.

Intimacy.Transcription:
These are the glass marbles I collected behind my father's back when I was little.
I believe they could be considered a collection from a different era, just like your computer collection, right?
Then ... ma'am, may I add them to the shelf?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Ma'am, may I ask for a few days off?
I wanna go back to the Vigiles Bureau for a while to practice arcanist criminal profiling and critter geographical mapping.
While Qiangliang's power may be able to expel physical evil, it can't banish the evil in people's hearts ...
and I believe the latter may be the bigger problem.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I heard someone humming the song, He Ri Jun Zai Lai, back in Chinatown.
I never thought I'd hear that song all the way across the Pacific Ocean.
Their humming was much slower and ... gentler than the original.
Whoever was humming it was probably missing someone.

Monologue.Transcription:
I was taught that "true justice is impartial; it follows reason, not bias." I thought I had steeled my heart—
that I was able to be truly impartial.
But now that I've wavered, I've realized that no one can totally remove their bias.
I'm glad that I learned this before it was too late.

Deployment.Transcription: Always ready to go.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Qiangliang, please lend me your power.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Arise Qiangliang, swift and fierce!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Case closed.
I'll be sure to write a report and put it on your table—
and please don't forget to check the previous reports too, ma'am.

Insight.Transcription: To this day, the spring thunder in Jingzhe echoes in my ears.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I still feel the weight of expectation on my shoulders, yes,
but is it burdensome? No, it's encouraging. Someone has to fight for truth and justice, so let me be the one.

Lobby_Entrance.Transcription:
The seeds we plant determine the fruits we harvest, just as the choices we make shape the outcomes we face.
No matter where our future takes us, we must never forget where and why we planted these seeds.

Voicelines.Transcription:
Qiangliang may be fearsome, but it's not ferocious.
I can feel that it's open to your touch. You're welcome to give it a try next time.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Thank you for letting me stay here!
Hope it's not too much trouble for you. I'll move out as soon as I find a place to settle with my people ...
Somewhere we can really call home.
Really? You're letting me keep the keys?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The smell of the salt in the air always worried us—it meant the tide had started to rise.
When I was little, we used to wait for the tide to go down and see who could find the most beautiful shells.
But once we grew up, we just worried about how long our tidal barriers would hold back the waves ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Perhaps I'll make more friends in the future.
We'll race paopaos, build pebble castles on the beach, and make "Sea Mother's Eyes" together ...
Though our home has been taken by Mother Sea, I hope I can keep alive the memory of those beautiful islands.

Idle.Transcription: You're so quiet, like the rocks on the beach. What are you thinking?

Greetings.Transcription:
I'm so glad to have you here—
no, I mean, I'm so grateful you let me stay here!

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning! I've been up since dawn—
no time to rest when there's so much to be done.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
We used to head out at dawn, singing along the beach and pulling up the fish nets we left the night before.
The sun would spring over the horizon, and the coral shine like jewels in the water.
Even now, something deep inside still wakes me up around the same time.

Night.Transcription: Will there be a guiding star in the suitcase watching over us every night too?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I've cleaned and seasoned all of the fish before sunset!
Now to light a bonfire and roast them over the crackling flames. Oh, what a mouth-watering smell!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
The arcane-preserved flower wreath on my head keeps my hair clean and tidy.
Though sometimes it attracts butterflies, and other times, bees ...

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Your hands are so soft and smooth!
They're nothing like mine. I have strong "Nukutai hands"—
rough from working with fishing nets, sand, wood, and oars.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Even though we're far from home, my Spirit Shell stays shiny and its patterns remain clear.
Something must be keeping it that way—maybe it's my wish to rebuild our homes or my determination to stay strong.

Hobby.Transcription:
Everyone feels nostalgic sometimes.
But what does "home" mean to others here?
I should ask around—I'm sure their other stories will help me understand what we need to build our new home.

Intimacy.Transcription:
It'd be wonderful if we could all go to the beach,
sit by the fire, toast coconuts, sing songs, and share our stories …

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I've heard so many stories about pirate raids.
"Pirate radio is all about peace and love! Peace and love!!"
Ms. White Rum just seemed sad, "The glory days of pirates are over."
I didn't know there were so many different kinds of pirates ...

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I never used to understand why some people would get on a ship and leave home, never to come back ...
But now I'm slowly coming around—they must have their own reasons, good or bad ...

Monologue.Transcription:
The elders trust me to lead our people, and everyone believes in me.
But why was I chosen for this important task? Why not someone else?
I don't see what makes me any different ...

Deployment.Transcription: So many people here! Feels like trade season again.

PreBattle.Transcription: Stay behind me! I'll keep us safe.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: We'll find our home. One day.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: We did it! We made it through another storm!

Insight.Transcription:
Thank you for your generosity! How can I repay you?
Perhaps some hala fruits, or some red snappers—oh, how about a starfish from the coral reefs?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
One evening, we were knocking the fruits off a tree that Kamuta was napping on and woke him up.
As I sat on that branch, watching the sun sink behind the ocean,
I knew it would rise again to bring another peaceful day.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Thank you so much for bringing me on board.
I, Barcarola, former musical director of the "Free Breeze," am at your service!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Listen closely. Do you hear that resonance coming from the sky?
... No conventional instrument could reproduce such remarkable sounds.
Lucky for you, the unconventional ones happen to be my specialty.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I've been composing a special piece.
A melody like a sea breeze that flows and extends endlessly, adopting every sound and sentiment.
A song like that ...
Yes! That will be a song worthy of playing forever.

Idle.Transcription:
Oh ... Scusè, I didn't mean to interrupt you.
The best musical compositions always include silence and rest, after all.

Greetings.Transcription:
It is sweet of you to be so quiet when you come to visit,
but you needn't be so worried about interrupting—
I will be more than happy to incorporate your footsteps and knock-knocking into my performance.

Morning.Transcription:
Buongiorno ... So begins another beautiful day on our voyage together.
But first I must find my cuccumella and brew us up some caffè …

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
It was on the quiet nights in port that I could never fall asleep.
I found myself anticipating the vibrato of the ship's whistles, and the deep legato of its horn.
I wanted to be lulled asleep by the rumbling bass of its engines, and the rocking meter of the open sea ...
Though, I have no such trouble sleeping here!

Night.Transcription:
I often think about how the sailors would sing during their time off.
They never cared about the key or pitch of their voices, or even if their instruments were in tune.
They sang out to the top of their lungs for the love of music;
for joy itself. It was inspiring.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
There's a peculiar rhythm in the words we use to say good night. Soft and pleasant wishes that soothe the soul into rest.
Well, Buonanotte! Sogni d'oro!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Basta! Has nobody ever told you it's rude to tap someone's head like that?
If you want to tap something, I can lend you a tin drum.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Wait a moment. Please be patient during the intermission.
The performance will continue as soon as the musicista and her instruments finish their break—
unless—do you have something for me to sign?

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
See? I'm fit as a fiddle, all thanks to my adoring fans and my Crackling Box.
Life as a star didn't make me soft; I'm probably in better shape than I ever was in Cremona!

Hobby.Transcription:
On the "Free Breeze," I met people from all around the world.
The way they spoke and the music they sang always made me wonder:
What must life be like where they're from?

Praise.Transcription:
Your command is precise, polished, and poised—
you would make for an amazing conductor!

Intimacy.Transcription:
I very much enjoy visiting others here in the suitcase.
Each one of them brings their own rhythms; music from different cultures across time and space ...
You know what? We should prepare a concert—no, that's too small! Let's arrange a world tour!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Sul mare luccica, l'astro d'argento.
Placida è l'onda, prospero è il vento.
Venite all'agile, barchetta mia.
Santa Lucia, Santa Lucia.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
If you ever consider remodeling your suitcase, I would be happy to assist you in improving the acoustic environment.
With the right design, we could make this a place fit for beautiful music.
Naturally, we might want to add some sound insulation so that a certain rock star here can be as loud as she likes.

Monologue.Transcription:
I wonder what the people back in Cremona think about me. I never told anyone about my music or my job on the "Free Breeze."
I wonder how Papà and Mamma would react.
Would they invite me back like they would all those virtuoso violinists?
And if they did ... would I go?

Deployment.Transcription: The performance is about to start. Please sit back, relax, and enjoy.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Saxophones and ... a bandura? As you wish.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Hmm ... do you have any requests?

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: We're always well-prepared, aren't we, Crackling Box?

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Listen to the melodies of wind and waves.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Now for the crescendo with fortissimo tutti!

Attacked_I.Transcription: This is a breach of "Free Breeze" passenger etiquette!

Attacked_II.Transcription: What an awful racket you make!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: *hums a melody excitedly*

Insight.Transcription:
Oh, would you do that again?
I've never heard of such a peculiar sound before. Oh, what if I combine it with—
come on, do it again, pleeease!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
There may come a day, long after I'm gone,
after even the dust of my home has blown away in the wind,
when my Crackling Box will transform into something unimaginable ...
Still, I will never regret this decision.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Procedural info, risk assessment, voluntary participation statement, ah, and the all-important consent page.
Just sign here, and we can get on with the experiment.
Haha! I've been waiting for this day—we all have!
Oh, don't forget to sign here too—we need it in duplicate, standard procedure you understand.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Glare? From my head? I'm sorry, I had no idea!
A quick coat of paint should do the trick, though some of our colleagues are quite particular about maintaining appearances ...
Ah! I suppose I'll just have to avoid direct sunlight for now.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The Earth's churning core maintains her magnetic field, and the isolines of magnetic declination drift over time.
Maybe she's sending us a message, waiting for us to decipher it.
Who's to say this giant floating rock isn't an Awakened?

Idle.Transcription:
Alright, I understand—breaks are important. *sigh*
These meaningless administrative tasks are rather draining, even for me.
Thankfully, I don't need as much rest as my fleshy counterparts. I'll get the job done while you unwind.

Greetings.Transcription:
Ah, you've made it in!
Actually, the lock opens to any code. But the ticking timer on it—that's what gets people scratching their heads.
Most locks with a timer attached have a self-destruct program, you see. One wrong try, and you're locked out for good.

Morning.Transcription:
There's no better way to start the day than with Laplace's monthly journal.
In fact, I've annotated a few of the more fascinating papers. I'd be very interested to hear your thoughts on them.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Don't mind me.
I'm just recording the routines of the suitcase's inhabitants for future use and, well, because I'm curious.
It's going to be a long process; it could take years to gather enough data to create an accurate profile.
Don't worry, your routine is far from the most extreme I've seen.

Night.Transcription:
While I have no need to eat, I still sit at the dinner table during our ten-minute dinner break and chat with my colleagues.
That's right, ten minutes is more than sufficient for any Laplace employee.
Frankly, the Foundation's people spend far too much time eating meals.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I've noticed that intellectually stimulating activities are more effective in team bonding.
That's why I've put this together: 
All Problems and No Solutions: Laplace's Greatest Questions (Bound Volume)
.
According to my observations, more than 90% of readers experience an increased heart rate when working through it.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Madam Lucy pointed out that physical features such as a large head often evoke friendly responses from human colleagues.
I've traveled in other containers too, a thermos, a glasses case ...
Oh, but the worst by far was a cola bottle. The syrup at the bottom almost trapped me in there. I felt like a bug stuck in tar.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Ah, yes, body language! I was just reading about it a few days ago.
Hand contact is often perceived as warm and friendly, and it's an effective way to show support. A very useful technique indeed.
Especially since, whether through choice or circumstance, many of our researchers struggle with communication.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Since I don't have any limbs,
this body was designed to replicate human architecture and hold a suitable number of appliances.
I learned the hard way how important it is to have every tool on hand—especially after the "iron and three toasters" incident.

Hobby.Transcription:
Hobbies? I used to write "work" in that column of the staff member survey until someone pointed out I was causing the team stress.
So, to show my genuine intent to encourage a positive atmosphere,
I've changed it to "attending to my colleagues' feelings."

Praise.Transcription:
Clear communication is crucial to the success of any team, and I must say,
it's almost a miracle how well you've got everyone working together despite their different backgrounds and perspectives.
Your leadership is exceptional.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Because of my *ahem* enthusiasm, I have to transfer to a new one of these every now and then.
The process is horribly uncomfortable, but X seems to think it's the perfect time to indulge in his "sense of humor."
Could you be there next time? I could really use some backup.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Oh, haha! No, no, I'm not in a wrestling match with the speaker.
Quite the contrary—I'm getting a delightful massage
from the piano concerto it's playing.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
What would happen if I placed a giant magnet at head level?
Well, theoretically, I'd get pulled toward it and smack the edge of my tank ...
Wait ... That gives me an idea! Come on, grab that notebook, and I'll walk us through the setup.

Monologue.Transcription:
I spent quite some time figuring out how to "rest" and what it really means to be "lonely."
I still struggle to take breaks, and loneliness ... well, I suppose I don't mind it all that much.
Of course, I wouldn't seek to be alone, but I've definitely learned to appreciate solitude.

Deployment.Transcription:
Yep, I'm taking all the equipment.
Can't pass up the chance to collect firsthand data in a real battle!

PreBattle.Transcription: Battles can be just as informative as codes; you just have to know how to read them.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Alright, time to crack some codes.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: A perfect algorithm—one that can only exist in theory!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Enumeration is a last resort ... But sometimes, it can work a miracle.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Another perfect combination of reason and passion!

Insight.Transcription:
Ferrofluid—a substance that's fluid in form and constant in its magnetic nature.
As you can see, no matter how I shift and change, I never lose the essence of who I am.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
This isn't as tricky as I thought. All I have to do is tackle the problem in front of me,
solve it, and move on to the next.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Good to see you again, mate!
See this outfit here? It memorializes a great adventure.
I thought it fitting as I'm headed on a new journey with you!
I'm ready and willing, just as always!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
For the rangers, heat and dehydration were often more of a danger than the crooks we were after.
Even so, there's nothing more relaxing than basking in the warmth of the sun.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
What we are now undertaking is nothing short of extraordinary.
Whatever the outcome, it is sure to be the greatest adventure of my life.

Idle.Transcription:
Ladies and gentlemen, my name is ...
Ladies and gentlemen, I'm Brimley.
Ladies and gentlemen, I'm Brimley!
Ladies and gentlemen, the name is ... Brimley.
No, that won't do ...

Greetings.Transcription: Ranger Brimley salutes you.

Morning.Transcription:
A real ranger ... attaches equal importance to all honors.
Being entrusted with an early shift ... is just one of them.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I've finished my daily patrol, and here's the report, should take around seven minutes to read through.
Would you care for me to read it to you?
I'm in need of a bit of practice anyways if I'm to be a proper spokesperson.

Night.Transcription:
It is customary to don a nightcap before bed ...
Though, I suppose you can see why I choose to ignore that particular tradition.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Oy ... That's your last warning, mate! You're under arrest! Charge!
Oh, no ... I was sleepwalking again, wasn't I?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Back when I was first in London, I was under the ever-present threat of ... mildew.
I had to remind Arthur whenever we went out on those all-too-frequent rainy days, that I was not in fact waterproof.
Then I left for Australia, no fear of rain out in the outback,
though I had no one to remind me about it either.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You might think the lack of hands or appendages would make things harder for me as a ranger.
Not so! The key to riding lies in mutual trust and a deep spiritual connection, not in how you hold the reins!
I admit having hands would make things easier, though.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
The wool that makes up my body has a fantastic quality softness and flexibility.
It's allowed me to reshape myself to fit my new identity.
I can't say who the craftsperson was that made me,
but I should like to send them my sincere gratitude.

Hobby.Transcription:
A true ranger must be loyal above all to their steed!
They are our partner and closest friends, with whom we must entrust our lives and must trust us with theirs in return.
Well, um, now I know mine appears to be just a stick horse, but it still counts for something.

Praise.Transcription:
I believe that credibility far outstrips the importance of eloquence or rhetoric in a qualified spokesperson.
And in that case, mate, I'd say you're well and truly talented.

Intimacy.Transcription:
When I was first awakened in London, I spent a long time considering who I really was and where I belonged.
I admit I did some immature things while trying to find a place I fit.
But I've changed now.
I know that it takes more than just to say "I'm a ranger" to be a real ranger.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Ah, "Oliver," I should be glad to hear the name stuck. Both Arthur and Margaret loved that name.
The world has become disordered and cruel since the "Storm,"
but I take heart knowing one good thing came despite it.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
It's not as hard as you think to juggle my roles as both a spokesperson and a ranger.
I often think up my speech drafts and key points while out on my daily patrol.
Sometimes I invite my colleagues over to plan while I groom my stick horse.
All in all, I'd say I've managed just fine.

Monologue.Transcription:
Once a slouch hat, now a fedora. You can change the appearance, but not the heart.
I will always be that cheerful ranger committed to justice.
And no matter what, I'll still be made from that pure Aussie wool.

Deployment.Transcription: I'll provide as much support as possible.

PreBattle.Transcription: We have just begun to fight!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: For justice!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Just as any true ranger would!

Insight.Transcription: A new adventure awaits. Onwards, like a ranger, like a true warrior, onwards!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I've pursued many adventures and changed with each one,
but my pursuit for justice has ever remained the same.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hello. Call me Flutterpage. I used to live in Millwall with my mum and dad and sister ...
But that don't matter no more, does it?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
London's always changing its weather.
Mostly it's foggy, and so smokey it'll make your throat sore; then it rains a lot, which pains Mum's knees ...
And sometimes—not too often—the sun comes out,
then everyone goes around sayin' "Lovely weather we're having, isn't it?"

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I got a lot of questions, but most of 'em seems even the adults don't know.
So I suppose I best figure them out myself.

Idle.Transcription:
Hmm, she ain't lookin' at me, I don't think, just starin' off into space.
Can she hear me right now? Hard to tell, she could be pretendin'.
Sometimes I act like I can't hear nothing when really I was listenin'.

Greetings.Transcription: A gust of wind from the door! I thought it was my arcane skill, but turns out it's you.

Morning.Transcription:
I'm glad I woke you up.
Without a knocker-upper, people spend much too much time in bed and get themselves in a mess of trouble.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
It's always trouble rightin' my hair in the morning. It gets knotted up with all my strips.
I know I can untie the knots one by one, but it's such a pain. I usually just grab the scissors and go a choppin'.

Night.Transcription:
It's past time I went to bed, but I could wait just a bit longer ...
'Cause I can't let you stay up too late, otherwise it'll be too hard to wake you up tomorrow.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Fancy going out tonight?
We could climb up the bell tower and catch a bit of fresh air. The roof's sure to be stone-cold and damp,
but we'll hear the insects chirpin' and dogs barkin'.
If the wind gets strong enough, I'll take you into the air and we can fly up through the clouds.
When we get back, we can snuggle up to stay warm.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I like to cut my own hair.
But every time I done it, Mum always says I tangled it up so that it looks like a bird's nest ...
Course, she says it like it was a bad thing.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
This is a proper useful pole. It helps me hang clothes and wake up my clients.
It could even make for a handy slingshot—
Well, maybe not so handy for me,
'cause I'm too short to use it.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Someone said I ought to fold up my strips before puttin' them in my pockets,
but that don't make no sense, does it? What if I need them fast? I can't bother with unfolding them in a pinch.

Hobby.Transcription:
I feel like some questions ain't got no answers in mind, but that's fine, ain't it?
Just like getting lost in the fog, sometimes you got to wander a bit before you find your way out.

Praise.Transcription:
You're so cute when you nap on the sofa, all scrunched up like a little kitten.
Huh?  Was I not supposed to look at you?
What's the difference if you were sleepin'?

Intimacy.Transcription:
Mind if I follow you?
Oh, not that I ain't followin' you right now. I'm only standin' here to ask if you mind.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I like to dive in the laundry basket to hide from my mum and dad,
and you hide in the suitcase to avoid the "Storm."
No worries about it. No shame runnin' from what we can't handle.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
To "die" means the ones you love can't see you anymore.
Don't matter much whether you're the one who leaves or the one left behind. You never get to see each other again.
Now I'm so far away from home and never returnin' again ...
Does that mean I already "died" once?

Monologue.Transcription:
Each morning, I watch folks gettin' up through their window frames, then they come right back to them at night.
Just like the old fairy tales, they all have the same beginning and the same end ...
But I ain't goin' to be like them, that's why I want to fly away—to find another end for my story.

Deployment.Transcription: Just ... stand with the others, like this then?

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: The wind blows through you, and through me!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Yes, I got this, I can do it ...

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Higher than the bell tower and even the clouds!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: That weren't even as tough as waking up an old factory man!

Insight.Transcription:
I've always got new questions poppin' up in my head,
just like there's always more paper being put in my basket.
Hmm ... Do I got to learn maths so I can figure out why?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I suppose I'm really more like a bed sheet than a bird.
A sheet spends its entire life in three places:
first, stuck in the laundry; second, snugglin' up in bed; and third, hangin' in the air on the clothesline.
The last one is my favorite place to be.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
So, you all live in a suitcase, eh?
Of course, I understand that the Foundation
has more urgent needs than finding a proper place to house their employees.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The curtains—Draw the curtains!
Aye, yes, I know it's "Hag Lifestyle 101: Dwelling in Darkness."
Well, I admit, I'm no exception to the rule.

To_the_Future.Transcription: There'll be no cure for what ails this world if we can't even hold the Uluru Games.

Idle.Transcription: Just as well, keep silent. Smart move, no need for disturbing one another with idle chatter.

Greetings.Transcription: Enough sniffing about me like a mole. I haven't any tea or cake for guests.

Morning.Transcription:
You skipped breakfast, have you now? And I suppose you think the "great" Timekeeper is immune to stomach aches?
Don't be daft! Go on and don't come back till you've finished an omelet.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I was practicing. If you were wanting to watch, come earlier next time.
I won't be waiting.

Night.Transcription:
Critter riots, geological hazards in the Wilderness, and children at each other's throats before bed.
The noise from other rooms seems to be from either one or all of them.
But, sure, sure, what am I worrying about, eh? I'll get used to it, or else soon enough I'll be deaf.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
You won't be finding any bedtime stories here. I intend on a peaceful night, silent—boring, I think you might say.
But ... if you insist on boring yourself, stay.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
What will she say if I pat her on the head? I can see your mind working.
Well, there's your answer. Congratulations.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You're no baby anymore. Don't tell me you need someone to lead you by the hand.
What? You're a little tired?
Sure, fine, take my hand, little troublemaker.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Yes, I'm still standing, as you can see.
So if that's what you're on about, save your empathy for someone who needs it—not me.

Hobby.Transcription:
So, I'm the first "special" competitor in the Uluru Games.
To be sure, there will be a second, a third ... I'll not be special anymore.
But they will remember me, not for my broken leg, no, but for what I can do.

Praise.Transcription:
No offense is a statement that can only come before offense,
but few are smart enough to understand that.
... You're one of the few.

Intimacy.Transcription:
If you've nothing better to do, come give me a hand.
You can prepare the materials, brew the potion, or ...
burn this old miserable witch like Hansel and Gretel, if it takes your fancy.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
That buzzie little ankle-biter must run on curiosity—just an ounce of it can drive her flying across the whole street.
The government ought to think about replacing coal with barrels full of curious runts like her.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There are only two instances in which I believe people truly capable of empathy.
In praising good weather and in complaining when it's turned dreadful.

Monologue.Transcription:
I'm cold, grumpy, mean, and hateful. I'm a dusty old house, a rotten bit of wood.
Anyone fool enough to try to get close to me is fit for the sanitarium, you'd say.
I'm convinced Flutterpage does it only out of mad curiosity, but what about you? What's your angle?

Deployment.Transcription: You can return the favor to me later.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The same shadow, from the same light.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: You're not half-bad.

Insight.Transcription:
You, you've no need to waste these trifles on me.
... But still, thanks and all.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
This new outfit is for my next appearance.
Now don't go assuming I'm showing it to you
because I think you're someone special to me. It's nothing of the sort.

First_Encounter.Transcription: Olá, kid! It's me, Duncan, your old friend!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Ah, such great weather—perfect for a game of football! Who's up for a match?

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I've long dreamt about the day when every kid can escape the favela,
every old-timer can enjoy their twilight years, and everyone can live with their head held high ...
I know, I know. It'll probably never happen, but a man can dream, can't he?

Idle.Transcription: Don't worry about it; it's good to zone out and clear your head every once in a while!

Greetings.Transcription: Come on in, friend. Door's always open!

Morning.Transcription: The sunlight in here feels so real. How does it work? Special light bulbs or something?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Wonderful morning, não é? Fancy some fresh bread?
I cobbled together an oven using parts I found lying around—
wait, do you smell burning?

Night.Transcription:
Back in the favela, blackouts were pretty common in the summer.
Folks would head to the rooftops to cool off.
We'd count the ships along the coastline, see who could catch the most bugs,
and play music and sing under the candlelight ... Ah, those were the days!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Psst, do you know what the scariest thing about standing guard at night is?
No, it's not dozing off while on duty—
it's waking up to find yourself blanketed in your superior's coat.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I asked the kid at the barber shop to give me a haircut and color to make me look younger,
and you know what he said?
"As long as you're young at heart, no style or graying hair will ever make you look old!"
Hah! Not much of a businessman, is he?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Don't underestimate these hands of mine. They can craft exquisite handiwork and,
more importantly, sneak in a goal behind the ref's back.
Just have to be ready for a fight if your opponent notices.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
These badges caught your eye, huh?
The puppy's called Coco;
I scooped him up from a shell crater and brought him back when he was just the size of my palm.
And this little bunny's Mira; give her a carrot, and she'll hop for joy.

Hobby.Transcription:
That spinning wheel in the lake looks like it could use a few repairs.
Do you want me to handle it for you?
Wait, what? It's dangerous there? Well, now I'm curious!

Praise.Transcription:
Hah, to think you'd have such fine taste in tech!
Three TVs, each with different imaging formats, and several classic computers—
all in great condition too ...
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.

Intimacy.Transcription:
The landscape outside the window looks vast and inviting.
I bet there are plenty of great fishing spots.
Why don't we head out one day and drop our lines together?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
After retiring, I spent some of my days playing football and coaching kids in the favela.
You know, a couple of them actually made it into a professional club.
Just goes to show, where there's a will, there's a way.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
A silent weapon and a musical instrument—my flute serves as both.
Zeno's Brazilian branch used to craft some seriously impressive stuff.

Monologue.Transcription:
I had a family many years ago.
I know they're watching over me, keeping me company, and reminding me
to treat both friend and foe with fairness and love.

Deployment.Transcription: Skip the warm-up. I'm always ready to jump into the action!

PreBattle.Transcription: You don't want to get on my bad side, kids.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: I never get tired of this one!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: As long as you hit the target!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Watch and learn, kids!

Attacked_I.Transcription: Come on, put some power behind it!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Our courage and determination brought us victory.
Everyone, you have my respect!

Insight.Transcription: Hah-HAH! I feel lighter! Stronger!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Once, a gang of critters tried to take over the favela. They were pretty contemptuous ...
until I gave them a beating and taught them a lesson or two on how to treat humans.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
This place brings back memories of my old house ...
Say, does this place have a retirement wing?
Then it'd be a one-stop nostalgia station for me! Haha ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The drumming of the rain reminds me of many dreadful things.
Perhaps it's the sadness of it, or the cold. I cannot help but recall the lies, the deaths, betrayals, and all that's been lost ...
But somehow, I like it, all of it, the sound, the sadness, and the memories.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Don't worry about me!
One of these days, I'll start winning again. It's like they say: "If you want to win, you've got to get used to losing."

Idle.Transcription: It's hard to shake off old wounds, even after they've healed. The memories always come back.

Greetings.Transcription: Oh, finally! Thought you'd forgotten me or something.

Morning.Transcription:
You ever try coffee from the Magdalena River Valley?
I used to work on a coffee plantation there. No?
Well let's fix that! Come on, give it a try.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I'm jealous of people who don't dream.
It's not just the nightmares; even when I have a good dream,
it just means I'm going to wake up to the same old reality. Still, I love my bed.

Night.Transcription:
I heard someone say I keep getting assigned to field missions because I never stay awake for night duty ...
Come on, you know that's not true ... right?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Could you tell me a story? You travel to so many more places than I do ...
What are they like?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I always used to wish I was taller, especially when other people looked down on me.
Now, I guess I've learned to appreciate it.
At least this way, I never look down on anyone.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Some alchemists try to turn lead into gold. Me? Nah, not my style.
Now goldfish, on the other hand, or golden butterflies, or golden beetles!
I'll whip them up anytime ...
Golden rabbits? That's silly, whoever heard of a "golden rabbit!"

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Hey, I'm tougher than I look, you know! Not even Zeno's brutal training could knock me down.
Oh, my grades? You mean like school? Aha ... Let's change the subject.

Hobby.Transcription:
... Haunted by past memories, always pursuing new enemies ...
Life is just a series of games—to win all you need is a little luck and a little strategy. Too bad I'm short on both ...

Praise.Transcription:
Some people might get lucky and find their way home before the rain comes,
but the unlucky ones have to face it alone ...
Or they would, if you weren't out there holding an umbrella for them.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Things are a bit stale around here! How about a game night!
We can play chess here, some card games, everybody could bring snacks and drinks to share!
How about I bring some Bandeja Paisa, Carimañolas, and Chicharrón? Hmm ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I was stationed in the 60s, and now I've visited the 90s.
In both eras, I saw homeless kids barely surviving on the streets.
We've had so long. What's holding us back?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
It's not fair! Even when I cheat, I still lose!
Who knew that a lucky coin could beat loaded dice?
As long as Lady Luck is at that table, I'm out!
Ugh! It's like this, every time!

Monologue.Transcription:
I never regret my choices.
I can't—doesn't matter what happens, or how much I've lost.

Deployment.Transcription: So, one at a time or all of you at once?

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Get ready! This is going to be a crowd-pleaser!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Stay put! This'll hurt longer if I miss.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Wait for the pop!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: That's what it's all about! Life-or-death battle and victory!

Insight.Transcription: Thank you for your support. I hope one day we'll find the answers I need.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
You've got to let go of the past, carry the memories worth carrying ...
The best is yet to come!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Listen well, matey. I'm not one of those jabbering ship toys you find in a water park souvenir shop—
I'm the real deal.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
On days like this, when the clouds part and the sun's rays bathe my mast, I'm taken back to my earliest memory.
I was in the calm of the eye of the storm, with the sun blazing just above.
It felt so near—like I could snatch it by hoisting my mast just a touch higher.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I pondered smashing this bottle
and rotting beside ol' Captain Anne's remains in the briny deep.
But when I spied that dolphin toss a drifting bottle ashore, I had a revelation—
it was time to venture where I couldn't before ... land!

Idle.Transcription:
No need to worry about me, captain ...
I'm in good hands, good company ...

Greetings.Transcription:
Oi, shove off!
No staring while I'm changing my bottle water!
Argh, well, since you're here, give me a hand and help me tie this sailcloth!

Morning.Transcription:
No need to panic, matey …
I-It's crystal clear why your bookshelves are dancing around—
Quickly, pour the rum out of my bottle, or I'll be feeding the fish before you know it …

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Yo-ho-ho, rise and shine, lads and lasses!
We have a whole world to plunder, so let's start by seizing this fine morn!

Night.Transcription:
Every time we pulled off a grand raid,
ol' Captain Anne would haul the crew to a pub in Nassau and they'd drink 'til dawn.
And there I'd be, sitting daftly at the dock, dreaming about what it felt like to be drunk.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
One time, ol' Captain Anne got captured.
We didn't know which cell she was in, so we blasted every window in the place.
Later, we learned that she was already sneaking her way out,
and all our ruckus nearly got her caught again!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Oh, don't fret about me; I don't feel cramped at all.
When I'm in this bottle, it becomes a part of me.
You wouldn't feel cramped in your own hide now, would you?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Watch closely, matey! When spun at high speed, my anchor rivals any wood cutter.
I made a pretty penny at the lumberyard with this trick, you know!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
All my shipmates are long gone, save for what's left of ol' Captain Anne.
Hah, at least she still has one hand on deck, even after getting locked away in Davy Jones's locker.

Hobby.Transcription:
Did you know, if you perch on the highest cliff of Tierra del Fuego,
you can spy the penguins on the ice fields to the south?
And if you wander through the rainforest, you'll see a ship swallowed by a maelstrom!
Now that I've seen these places for myself, I know for certain that the lads who spun these yarns were only telling tall tales!

Praise.Transcription: You can take the helm. I trust you.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Tell me, how long would it take to reach the horizon if I climbed out of this window?
Is there a vast ocean beyond? You must take me to see it.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Ahem ...
If a notorious pirate claimed to have hidden no treasure before kicking the bucket,
would you believe it?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
A few birds with beaks bigger than bananas often kept me company on the high seas.
They were always hungry—for food and for a fight. I thought their kind had gone extinct.
Imagine my surprise to see one of them in these quarters of yours!

Monologue.Transcription:
To lay low, I brewed up a slew of daft aliases: Anne Brotherhood, Grog Blossom, Duke Dodo, and the like ...
Once I realized I no longer had to run, my creativity dried up, haha! All I wanted was to swill rum 'til I burst!

Deployment.Transcription: Ahoy, matey! So, is this a challenge finally worth my time?

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Time to blow off some cannon smoke!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Keep an eye on the bottle and ol' Captain Anne for me, will you?

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Send them to Davy Jones's locker!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Ready! Anchor down! Ram the prow into their flank!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Yo-ho-ho! Ship's in fine shape,
and the bones have got nary a scratch, either!

Insight.Transcription:
Alas, who else but you, with a heart as gold as any treasure,
would show such generosity to an old pirate such as myself?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I've seen the globes you've got nowadays. Clearly, there are scarcely any uncharted lands left on this planet.
Still, as that boisterous mate of yours said,
a true pirate never forsakes their quest for legendary treasure—never.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
So this is it; there's really a room for me here?
After so long, it's nearly beyond belief that I might have a place of my own now
to decorate as I please and share with my friends—a home.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
This is only a gentle sprinkle compared to São Paulo in the summer.
The water would get so high that you'd just as well swim as walk to work.
And the Heartfelt Home always took a thrashing.
Old Winter and I would have to mend the fences over and over ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Pardon me, did I hear you say "the future"?
No, no, I'm excited to hear about it, but, uh, I am still a part of it, right?!

Idle.Transcription:
How many miles must I go, till I see you again?
A hundred, three, five and more ... no matter the distance, I'll make my way back to you.

Greetings.Transcription:
You said it yourself: This is my room.
And I may do with it as I please.

Morning.Transcription:
Well, well, don't you look like you've just had an adventure—rough night?
Or did you just have a little too much fun?
Wait! You didn't have a party without me, did you?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Good morning, Master.
I do hope you enjoyed your dreams last night, I certainly did.

Night.Transcription: Perhaps ... you might consider leaving your door unlocked at night.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Oh! That feels so lovely. Oh, oh there ... and just a little scratch behind the horns too ...
Would you possibly tend to my tail as well?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You mean this old thing? We go way back—
She was the only thing I managed to bring into that wind-up toy with me.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
What is it? Is there blood on my dress?
Oh, I promise I've been good ...

Hobby.Transcription:
Ah, what glamorous times those were! Food everywhere, all delicious, of course.
And party after party, with new people and new excitements each day ...
All accented by the sweet aroma of desire.

Praise.Transcription:
I must say, as a host, you are most generous and kind—too much so, I say.
It beggars belief that you ask for nothing in return for letting us stay here!

Intimacy.Transcription:
They told me you went to great lengths to negotiate for my freedom. I'm ever so grateful to you ...
Master, are you really this kind to everyone here?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Succubus learns to pay close attention to their prey—
their body, their personality, their presentation, and their deepest desires.
All this to say, I've encountered a most peculiar person indeed ... one that defies all my prior understanding.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I simply cannot live next door to Argus anymore! I am serious!
Do you realize she still points that gun of hers at me each and every time we speak?

Monologue.Transcription:
I find myself conflicted about my sister. At times I feel the deepest affection for her, yet there is still anger.
As time goes by, I find I think less and less about her.

Deployment.Transcription: Your every desire is my command.

PreBattle.Transcription: Which of these darlings shall we attend to first?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Sweet dreams.

Attacked_II.Transcription: I look forward to punishing you!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Finally, it's just you and me, master ...

Insight.Transcription: Ah, this burning thirst ... yearning for another taste of that sweet, flowing breath of life ...

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I remember those nights when fireworks lit up the night
and people danced under a rain of petals until the breaking dawn …

0.Transcription: Oh. So you're not interested, after all. I thought you were going to sing ...

Lobby_Interaction_1.Transcription: Hmm? Oh, I see! You must be quite the singer yourself, right? Come on, sing us a song!

Lobby_Interaction_2.Transcription: Ah! Master, stop! You're going to make me fall on stage!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I'm Barbara, an editor at UTTU magazine. It's an honor to join your team, Ms. Vertin.
Umm ... may I take a look around?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Ah, fair weather like this reminds me of the grasslands.
The green grass shines gold under the sunlight,
and the warm breeze quickly dries my washing.

Idle.Transcription:
Did my question offend you in any way?
I was given the silent treatment like this quite often when I was still a greenhorn interviewer.
Oh wait ... do you take "transitional naps" too?

Greetings.Transcription:
*gasp* Oh, it's you ...
You patting me on the shoulder so suddenly triggered my genetic memory of being preyed upon ...

Morning.Transcription:
As someone born with sheep genes, I only need four hours of deep sleep to be fully energized.
Meanwhile, for most humans and arcanists, chronic sleep deprivation can lead to anxiety disorders.
That said ... could I have a cup of pecan coffee?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Ms. Vertin, I learned from a colleague's report about a mammal species endemic to the East.
Unlike sheep, they have dark rings around their eyes ...
just like yours right now.

Night.Transcription:
I, too, have trouble sleeping at times.
Usually, I think about endless grasslands and drifting clouds ...
Umm, no, I don't count sheep;
imagining myself endlessly jumping over fences would be much too nerve-wracking!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
My allergy to chemical fiber can only be mediated by listening to country music,
but sleeping with headphones on might eventually damage my hearing.
I've tried playing music on the radio, but my neighbors always complain about the noise.
Is there really no perfect solution?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Uh-huh, you guessed it. I'm listening to George Strait's album; it saved me from my last asthma attack.
But honestly, I don't know much about him ...
To me, all country musicians seem to have the same healing effect.
Oh, please don't tell Ms. Argus that—she might get upset!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Whenever I go to shake someone's hand, they always seem a bit surprised.
But my hands are just like anyone else's—they can hold a pen, an umbrella, a cup—
oh, I can even use chopsticks.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I've never let my appearance shake my self-perception.
However, when I'm in a hurry, I sometimes imagine myself turning into a real sheep, running lightly on four feet,
just like Ms. Jessica.

Hobby.Transcription:
Well ... Beady Buddies are indeed cute and soft,
but the craze for these colorful toys is just an artificially hyped commercial ploy, a speculative bubble for hoarders—
baa! Is that Royal Blue Eliot the Elephant? This was discontinued ages ago!
What? Ms. Vertin, are you giving it to me?

Praise.Transcription:
Sensibility and rationality—most people think you have to choose either one or the other,
but in you, I see a possibility for coexistence.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Oh, please don't hurt this little creature. After I found it, I specifically kept it in the corner.
You see, the ghost spider usually hangs silently on its web, occasionally catching other little pests ...
And, well, it can do much more than that.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
This peculiar head wasn't part of my two human mothers' plan,
but it's the reason my sheep mother remains in people's minds.
She was the one who gave birth to me, in fact,
but people only remember that because of my sheep's head.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
My sheep mother never knew how to stand on two feet, but she always offered her back to support my weight.
This allowed me to learn to walk on two legs, and it helped the researchers realize that I should live like a human.

Monologue.Transcription:
When I was trapped in the motel, I remembered my days at the research institute.
Back then, the entire world was a small room with a locked door—all I could do was dream and wait.
Fortunately, I now have many ways to open the "door" myself.

Deployment.Transcription: If possible, I'd prefer to write rather than fight.

PreBattle.Transcription: My interviews don't involve combat ... I'm not sure if I can win the fight.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: I will be the protector of your sleep.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Open your heart and embrace your dreams.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Let me be the shepherd of your dreams.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Such a ... fresh experience. I better record this in my journal.

Insight.Transcription: I feel as if my dream's been turned inside out.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: A wider, greener grassland, just like in my dream.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
It's such a pleasure to see you again.
Hmm ... I see there are children here—if you're in need of a babysitter,
I'd be more than happy to look after them.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Back in town, everyone would be busy on a bright day like this.
The harvesters roaring as they reaped the wheat, stacking it pile after pile.
Of course, no one ever paid me any mind.
Shame they were too occupied to enjoy my stories.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Naturally as mankind keeps on progressing, fear will also take on new forms.
But, it always comes full circle. Doesn't matter what era; some fears stay the same.
Folks will still be afraid of falling from heights, of many-legged insects and slithering snakes,
of being naked in public, and of having their long-hidden secrets revealed.

Idle.Transcription: Patience is a virtue—always has been.

Greetings.Transcription:
Now, should I put the playhouse near those books?
No, that might just put folks on edge ...
How about the greenhouse? That'd be a fine choice ...
Or next to those Nixie tubes? The light does fit the hallway ...
Oh, hello there.

Morning.Transcription:
The motel sign says "Free Breakfast," but I never prepare it—
our guests are never in the mood to eat after a night's stay.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Oh, you're awake. I heard you talking in your sleep and thought I'd check on you ...
Relax; your door was open before I came in.

Night.Transcription:
Whatever sort of reputation it has, a place to stay gains a special allure when night comes around.
The thought of a nice room and a soft pillow draws them in like moths to a flame,
no matter what's hidden under the bed.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Oh Vertin, talk about clumsy parenting.
When it's late at night and a child won't stay asleep, what you ought to do is stomp up to their door,
make sure they hear those footsteps, then wait just for a while.
Ha, trust me, it's a surer thing than hiding a snake under their pillow.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Back then, my fingernails were always dirty.
I'd scrub them raw with a rough brush until they cracked and bled.
Pa would get angry; suppose he saw my actions as a kind of childish protest.
Mom would be silent, but she'd leave the door open for me the next day—
I learned to do the same for my guests.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Simple, soft, soothing—the perfect get-up for a maid and the perfect excuse for me to knock on a guest's door.

Hobby.Transcription:
I've never stopped wanting you to get the allure of fear.
Naturally, the more time I spend with you, the better I understand how to manage it.
Everyone's got their weaknesses, even a tough-as-nails, hundred-eyed giant.

Praise.Transcription:
Who would have thought a person without fear could exist in the world?
But one is already enough.
If there were more, it'd get boring.

Intimacy.Transcription:
So, I heard there's a "Comic Knight Festival" here; no harm in adding a "Campfire Horror Story Fest," is there?
You know how I love fear.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
At least I was more considerate than those antagonists in those horror films—
all my guests checked out in one piece, after all.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Sometimes children would gather to tell scary stories,
they'd try to up the ante, telling the ones they overheard from adults.
I loved it; one of the only times I felt like I was a part of the conversation.
Until ... they decided they'd rather cancel the meet-ups than have me along.

Monologue.Transcription:
They say survivors often feel guilty, that seeing violence ought to make you fear it.
But however many times I go back to those blood-soaked memories,
all I feel is ... freedom. Exhilarating freedom.

Deployment.Transcription: Our rooms are always open for new guests.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: What's that up on your shoulder ...?

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: A bloody handprint on broken glass ... classic!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Knock knock, room service.

Attacked_II.Transcription: You'd really do that to a poor little maid?

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Perfect service ... just like always.

Insight.Transcription:
More ghosts? Or more skeletons?
No, it ought to have a touch more mystery, for that fear of the unknown.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Oh, this sensation ...
It reminds me of the day I walked out of that red door ...

First_Encounter.Transcription:
We meet again, boss.
Nah, this ain't the time to catch up.
I'm gonna take a nap first.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Rain or shine, I hated winter when I was young'un.
Hah ... I didn't have no warm clothes, you see.
So either way, I was shivering.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future? Well, that depends on who you are. For the farmer, it's the next planting season;
for the hunter, it's the breeding season; for the mechanic, it's the warming of the engine ...
For me? Well, there ain't no guessing.
This other eye of mine'll go blind sooner or later.

Idle.Transcription: Heh, while the living stay silent, the dead would die again for a chance to talk.

Greetings.Transcription:
Got a job for me?
If you're looking for someone, just gimme something they've used before. I'll find them.

Morning.Transcription:
Would you look at the time!
I guess you're fixing to be the second mouse who gets the cheese, huh?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
You still feeling groggy?
Then come join me for some target practice.
Believe me, the sound of this baby'll wake you up.

Night.Transcription:
Is that disco music?
I don't know why y'all love dancing to that stuff so much. I ain't fond of those laser lights, neither.
I swear they're gonna make me go blind in my other eye, too.
And, believe me, I ain't the only one who feels this way.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Got a few jobs: a missing man to find, a thief to catch, and some debts to collect.
No need to wait for me, boss. Ain't no guarantee I'll make it back.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Just an old scar. Nothing special.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
My index and middle fingers are crooked 'cause the doctor set them poorly.
Some kid thought he could escape by breaking them.
Hah, guess he didn't realize I could still pull the trigger with my ring finger, huh?

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Huh? Thinking of switching up your style?
You got it. I'll take you to Wriggler when I've got the chance.
They've got the best outfits for bull riders.

Hobby.Transcription:
Jay's just as good as Johnny; I'll give him that.
He's quick-witted, got a good sense of humor, and offensive when he needs to be.
But you can tell from his jawline that he's got a big tongue, and I find that somewhat irritating.

Praise.Transcription:
You've got your own "Kayla" to find, I can tell,
and you know what you need to do to find her ... Good.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Vertin, let me show you round Texas next time we go.
I don't want that creepy motel to be your only memory of my home state.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Everyone in the suitcase has smooth, pretty faces. Like they ain't never had to worry about life.
I know, I know. It just seems that way, is all.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I've tried all kinds of drinks: tequila, vodka, whiskey, moonshine ...
I ain't much interested in any of them.
Ain't nothing but mouthwash in the wild.

Monologue.Transcription:
Along the Rio Grande, at night I walked with care ...
In Palo Duro, I saddled up, and the wind blew through my hair ...
A beautiful and dangerous land, but I'll never go back ...
For it's only in my dreams, my dear, that I'll walk that Texas track ...

Deployment.Transcription:
I usually act alone ...
But fine, I'll try to get along.

PreBattle.Transcription: Just tell me when you need the job done.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: You can run, but you can't hide.

Attacked_I.Transcription: Ugh, you're a hard nut to crack.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Don't act surprised. It's just another day on the job.

Insight.Transcription:
An aspen tree split by lightning in a storm will one day be riddled with woodworm.
Then, under the layers of bark, there won't be nothing but an empty heart.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Brush away the dirt, wipe down the parts, and apply lubricant.
Regular maintenance is the key to a well functioning weapon.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
This place is quite different from where I used to live,
but I assure you, I'll get along with it in no time.
Trust me, I've had plenty of experience with "migration."

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
What fine weather! Perfect for going out. On a day like this,
I'd be more than happy to sit in a coffee shop and have a long chat with a potential business partner,
even if we never reach an agreement.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future is a fitting display window for our dreams.
Even in the pouring rain, as long as we can glimpse it,
we can wrap up our coats and keep moving forward.

Idle.Transcription:
It's quiet. Like those many moments in that store window.
How fine that I can now break the silence.
I have this graffiti to thank for that. See? Change can be a good thing.

Greetings.Transcription:
What are you looking for?
I might be able to help.

Morning.Transcription:
Do you ever read the morning newspaper?
Aside from keeping you up-to-date on world events, it calms the morning rush and helps you seize the day.
Newspapers are so cheap that even the poorest man can afford one.
I must say, I enjoy the satisfaction on people's faces when they read them.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Since we don't have eyes, many awakened arcanists, such as myself,
are mistaken for being awake when we're actually sleeping. I've been rudely woken up many times.
But on the bright side, we can secretly catch a wink or two whenever we like.

Night.Transcription:
Five orders for handmade dolls just came in.
I've told the ladies to get on with making them.
Sadly, little George will have to give up on his "beer bottle wind chime" idea. I haven't sold even one of those.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
This plastic body of mine isn't sensitive to temperature,
as I just discovered when I scorched myself standing in front of the fireplace.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Oh my! Hey! Look out!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I have a number of hand models in my collection. That way, I can screw them on to make a variety of gestures.
Like this, and this ... Hey! Wait a minute! This one's rather rude ...
J must've put it here!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Darn. My leg's stuck ...
Could you kindly give me a hand and move me next to the window?
I assure you, I'm far lighter than I look.

Hobby.Transcription:
A gentleman's outfit is how he reflects his personality. Jackets look neat, and a suit is more mature.
Of course, the combination of color and style is key.
I say that losing your sense of style is worse than poverty. What do you say?

Praise.Transcription:
You have a way of getting things done cleanly and precisely.
I can see why the Foundation appointed you Timekeeper.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Are you available now?
I believe that red-haired Russian had good intentions,
but she's painted a face on the back of my head ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The exchange rates of the drop and sharpodonty are more volatile than those of any human currency.
I suppose that's down to the fact that their value isn't regulated by any authority
but rather is tied entirely to the social standing of arcanists at any given time.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Have you ever looked at a mannequin in a store window?
I mean really looked at it. You see, it looks clean and fashionable from the front,
but around the back, it's folded and pinned together.
It's just like our world. No, this isn't a matter of good or bad. It's just the truth.

Monologue.Transcription:
I don't represent humanity or arcanists.
I'm the observer and the observed. A symbol of the times.
But there are people who need help, Ms. Vertin,
and there are things we can do to help them.

Deployment.Transcription: The "market" arises where social division of labor appears.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: In this era, I speak. And my voice will be heard.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Every contributor gains something. That's business.

Insight.Transcription: Thank you for your patronage.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I see you carry a suitcase.
Are you a wanderer too?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The sky and the soil communicate through raindrops,
just as people do through tears.
The raindrops nourish the soil, and the tears nourish the soul.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
My journey is endless.
I have walked, and I will keep on walking.

Idle.Transcription:
Breathe in ... and out.
Accept new energy and release the old.
The universe is within us.
We are one with the Earth, revolving around the sun in an endless cycle.

Greetings.Transcription:
You're right on time. I was just about to start my meditation practice.
Come. Have a seat.

Morning.Transcription:
I wonder what breakfast is like in other places.
Sputnik said she happened to know that astronauts eat beef from a toothpaste tube.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Not now, Vertin ...
I just ... came back from the club …

Night.Transcription:
The club's always vibrant at this time of night.
There's so much emotion—such irrepressible energy—like the music is a gust of wind, and we're all swaying in the breeze.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Your aura. It's calm. Silent. But it's not passive.
It holds a quiet rebellion—a little bird fighting for freedom.
You've said many goodbyes, haven't you, Vertin?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Dyeing my hair completely changes my energy.
A calming ocean blue, a rich honey gold, a flaming red ... Right now, it's like a cloud on my head.
So, when I sleep, I often dream of flying.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
People's energy waves intersect when they make physical contact.
Like this ...
See? Those ripples were created by our handshake.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
On my journey, I've received many things, including these scars.
The manager asked me to paint over them,
but I see them as cracks in the porcelain, allowing the colors of my life to spill out from within.

Hobby.Transcription:
Romantic ...? I'm not sure it is.
Wandering isn't a farewell or a reunion. It just ... is.
We wander for wandering's sake. It's a way of life.

Praise.Transcription:
I'd never thought to travel by suitcase before.
It's so convenient.
Every time I step outside, I find myself in a new place.
I've never seen anything like it.

Intimacy.Transcription:
A bird flew into my room. Can you hear its unique chirping sound?
You mean it's the SmokeGard 800 ...?
Oh. I'll put out the incense.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The even ticking of a clock could never capture the ebb and flow of real life.
It's too rigid.
No, life is a dance. Sometimes it's a manic disco, and others it's a leisurely waltz.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Suffering is an inevitable part of life.
I think back to when I was huddled on that park bench, weak and hungry, too depressed to even meditate ...
I know I can't remove all the suffering in the world, but I can at least do my part.

Monologue.Transcription:
Vertin, you can walk when you want to walk and rest when you want to rest.
Your burden's heavy, yet you keep rushing into the next thing. Slow down. It's okay to take your time.

Deployment.Transcription: I'm here to help.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Like cupping the moon in the palm of my hand.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: I am the waves in the ocean and the stars in the sky.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Now to preserve this memory in our dreams.

Insight.Transcription:
It feels like I've been in a daydream,
and now that I've awoken, my past looks hazy.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
My journey is recorded on my shawl.
Between the tassels and the warping of cloth lies the texture of life.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
You mean, this-this whole place is yours?
Boss, I know some rich jerks that would pay through the nose just to build a house here.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Whoa, you've really hit on a sweet spot here! Even the sun is almost as good as in Cali! Better maybe ...
But, eh, one question? Where does this window attach to, even?
Someone's gonna get hurt leaning on this thing.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Everything is possible now, huh?
Polly's got a new face. She always said that blue ribbons fit the color of her eyes.
Not like her eyes in that photo.
*sigh* Hope she's happy up there.

Idle.Transcription:
September evening, racing through the golden city ...
You'll be back, so you said to me ...

Greetings.Transcription:
Wanna catch a ride with me?
Usually no kids allowed, but I'll make an exception this one time.

Morning.Transcription:
A big house, fat stacks of cash and all the luxuries of gangster living ...
Yeah, I'd trade it all away.
'Cause I got this peaceful morning sunshine and nachos with guac to share with friends. That's real living.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Ew, urgh.
Bring it on, J, you can do this, it's just a raw egg ...
Come on, gotta stay in shape ...
*puke*

Night.Transcription:
You don't know how fiery this girl gets!
This forge really gets all my passion.
Wanna have a look yourself? ... No worries, it's no trouble if you get a bit closer?
Dangerous? How?
Well, she does run hot, you might get heatstroke.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I don't touch garlic, carrots, celery, broccoli, green peppers, not even mustard,
and I'm still alive and kicking!
That junk has gotta be bad for your health!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Old-fashioned?
Nah, it's called classic! ...
I spent half an hour fixing this up.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
It's an iron-clad rule of alchemy, destruction is a form of creation.
You gotta smash rocks to find ore, hammer metal to hone an edge.
If you want to create something, you gotta destroy another thing first, see?
I burn and hurt my hands a lot during forging, and now I've got tough calluses for protection.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Oh, the badge?
Nah, it's nothing special.
I just give it out to my friends, thinking that'll make us a team, you know?
Says "I'm looking out for you."

Hobby.Transcription:
This bowie knife was made from meteoric iron, quenched in the blood and fat of a jaguar.
Handy whether you're slicing throats or clearing brush from a path, or carving up a steak.
You can do anything with a knife like this.

Praise.Transcription:
You don't act like the rest of these pencil pushing weasels.
I appreciate that. Keep doing what you're doing.
