Intimacy.Transcription:
People say arcanists are cursed,
like diviners always going blind, or blacksmiths getting fat ...
Think you could swing me a scale for my place. I can't let these perfect biceps go flabby.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
People always think alchemy is about turning lead into gold, and they're wrong.
The philosopher's stone?
Hah, what? Don't tell me you believe in Santa and the toothfairy too?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Look, J is a cool letter,
the coolest, even!
But there's too many J-names out there. It's always James or Joe.
People need to get creative, something like an Oliver or an Ezra, or Nick, or ... an X.

Monologue.Transcription:
Not a big fan of comic book heroes.
They're always just some rich kid with a tragic past playing at "protecting the city" ...
It's stupid.
Give me another day with my mom, dad, and Polly over superpowers any day.

Deployment.Transcription: And it was by choosing J, that they began their path towards victory!

PreBattle.Transcription: Easier to fight here than a back alley.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Time to heat up the forge.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Trust me, this is gonna be fun!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: You're on a ride to the corner of Butt-kick and Maim!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Melt it down, forge it up.

Attacked_I.Transcription: Hey! This body is all natural!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Long as I got you at my side, I've got nothing to worry about.

Insight.Transcription:
A bigger workshop?
Boss ... If this was to buy my loyalty, I'm already yours.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
If you gotta wear a helmet,
and you gotta,
make it a cool one. Like I do.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
If I may, Timekeeper, you could've made good use of this Suitcase to change the game,
rather than merely hiding from the rain.
That is something I've longed for—a shelter from the "Storm" for my army.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Father used to tell me about the Great Patriotic War on snowy days.
"It's a good omen," he said. "Our enemies caught frostbite, and their fuel would freeze.
But our soldiers would fight even harder ..."
It was only bluster; every army is weakened by the cold. But we learned to endure it.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Power shapes the future—not ideas.
What is seized with bullets, shells, and tanks will outlast any charter.

Idle.Transcription:
Silence is the most dangerous sound.
Noise can mean anything, but the world is rarely silent unless there is something lurking nearby.

Greetings.Transcription:
You've come with questions; I can tell from your face.
Have a seat. Let's talk about our future cooperation, or what happened before that "Storm."

Morning.Transcription:
Have you ever heard the first chirp of a bird after battle?
No music in the world could sound sweeter. It says another day has come, and that my men and I have survived to see it.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I paid a visit to the former leader of Laplace,
I can't help but notice the excellent treatment she receives here.
Of course, given the foes I've made here, I'm in no position to make demands.
Besides, you don't deserve the trouble, and I don't deserve the peace.

Night.Transcription:
The Cossacks believe that a bonfire is as good as a second horse.
It raises the spirits of the men, giving them courage, strength, and warmth. That is what they say.
As far as I'm concerned, uncovered fires make for obvious artillery targets.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Night belongs to the dead, so people say.
But when the day is no longer safe, the living must take refuge in the night.
We lie down with the dead, shivering as we force ourselves to sleep.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
In battle, you don't think; you attack, and a soldier's first instinct is always to protect their head.
Watch out; you could get hurt.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
The weight of power is much heavier than a sword or a gun.
You will understand that sooner or later.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
My father liked to flaunt his scars when he had too much to drink.
"Scars are our medals, and sacrifices our glory."
But I found the truth for myself: scars are only closing wounds and sacrifice a means to an end.

Hobby.Transcription:
The records of all great campaigns inevitably focus on their victories. Their defeats too often glossed over and excused.
But I find greater clarity in examining these failures:
success is always marred by hubris, but defeat tells you the true measure of a general.

Praise.Transcription:
I see great potential in you.
A young leader with many faithful comrades over those stubborn commanders in the White Stone House—
I'd back the former any day.

Intimacy.Transcription:
If you meet any trouble, you need only let me know.
I will solve it, in my own way.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
«Такъ бо вещiй Боянъ, внукъ Велесовъ, глаголаше: Такъ, быть можетъ, онъ бы воспѣлъ.
Не буря соколов занесла через поля широкие — стаи галок несутся к Дону Великому.»
Father named me after this tale, but he never understood it.
He simply enjoyed the feeling of being praised.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
From the day I entered Zeno, I knew that they would carve my name into the Hall of Merit—the highest honor for a loyal soldier.
And now, even after my betrayal, my name is still etched there. Is that the mockery of fate, Timekeeper?

Monologue.Transcription:
When I was young I tamed a fine wild horse, his coat was as red as flame.
There was no place in the world I could not reach as long as I was atop him. He went missing during a blizzard.
At times I let myself believe that he's still out there.

Deployment.Transcription: You're prepared.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Всем подразделениям — вперёд!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Well done. Your tactical skill is obvious.

Insight.Transcription: History makes judgments. I make decisions.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: I stand straight and still, for the lives of my soldiers rest on these shoulders.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
You called my name, did you not? I heard you before ... a long, long time ago.
The conch shell whispered to me when I was little. Your voice was there, among many others.
... How nice, Vertin.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Just now, I accidentally looked straight into the sun. It ... It bit my eyes …

To_the_Future.Transcription:
... Be like a tree rooted by the river, which fruits in autumn and never drops its leaves ...
And you will find prosperity in all your doings.

Idle.Transcription:
You never asked me where I'm from, never said any prayers, never called my name.
You just placed me here, another doll in your display case.
Are we all your little dolls?

Greetings.Transcription:
Oh! There it is! Could you ... buckle this belt for me? Yes, yes, the tighter the better.
They said I must wear these belts; it's important because ... What was it they said?

Morning.Transcription:
Mama and Papa told me never to disturb people's sleep.
But your blanket fell to the floor. I was just picking it up ...
Oh ... I didn't mean to wake you …

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Maybe one day I'll become transparent, slowly, bit by bit, until I'm almost invisible.
And when the wind blows, the sheets hung in the house will billow and rise with me, disappearing into the sky.

Night.Transcription:
Der Mond ist aufgegangen ... That morning, two eggs were missing from Old Prien's henhouse. Who took them? Who did it?
With a pickaxe in hand, he burned down the shanties by the river.
He had always suspected that those thieves would murder his daughter.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Are you having trouble sleeping, Vertin ...?
Here ... this wad of cotton is my sleep. Take a piece ... Or a big chunk of it.
Sleep, Vertin, sleep ... I'll watch over you …

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Maybe I'll turn into a rabbit, or a seahorse, or a transparent slug ...
But then ... whose head will Mama tap with the parsley in her hand?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I always secure my hands with a pair of splints, so both you and I will be safe.
Hmm ... We'll have to take the "rock" out of "rock, paper, scissors," just to be fair.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
When I was younger, I often bathed in the river Rhine.
One day, many people jumped off the river bank.
They dyed the water red. I couldn't clean myself, no matter how hard I tried ...
From that day on, Mama and Papa forbade me to swim there again.

Hobby.Transcription:
*Whistles* I learned so much! The wolf is an interesting man to talk to, he's as slim as a Weißwurst ...
Some others showed me how to speak in numbers and music ... It was so interesting spending time with them ...
I wonder if I could speak to animals, or make sounds through metals too ...

Praise.Transcription: Wow, both Mama and Papa agree with you! You must be a very good child!

Intimacy.Transcription: *Yawns* Can I squeeze in with you? It's so humid, and my sheets smell funny …

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
There are three truly good things in life. God said they are faith, hope, and love.
I think they're the color red, yellow, and blue.
Mama believed them to be the circle, square, and strip. What do you think?

Chitchat_II.Transcription: Above all, have fervent love for one another, for all else is external and matters little.

Monologue.Transcription:
When I was little, many people came to visit me.
They climbed up to the window, and onto the roof.
I could hear the cracking of wood as the rotten eaves gave way, and the thud as they hit the ground.
"Careful!" I said. But ... no one listened.

Deployment.Transcription: Get in line, up on the wall, one, two, three.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: The true answer is always simple!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: This will show you the way to the harbor.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Why does one wave turn against the other when both are one with the river?

Insight.Transcription:
Can't I say no? Growing up ... souring like milk.
Why must we grow up? It's not like time will curdle the river …

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: There was no outstretched hand, only one that sent us away ... but it set us free on the river.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hello, Timekeeper. I have long heard of your stories. Hopefully my visit won't trouble you too much ...
But perhaps for you, this isn't much trouble.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The sun ... The kids in the orphanage loved the sun,
often the only entertainment we could offer them was playing in the sun together.
Sadly, I can no longer know that joy.
But don't worry, I'm still "enjoying my life," so things are not so bad for me.

To_the_Future.Transcription: I intend to keep living, until I die.

Idle.Transcription:
I enjoy the distance that exists between us.
Your infrequent visits grant me more freedom to enjoy my own time, especially enclosed in this suitcase.

Greetings.Transcription: Oh, welcome ... You appear to have come in a hurry, so there must be an emergency, am I right?

Morning.Transcription:
Statistically, practicing one's arcane skills in the morning is more effective than at noon.
Of course, the morning light isn't so pleasant for me,
but one can get used to unpleasant things, if one makes it their habit.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I admit, I am glad to find you seldom invite others to share breakfast here.
Personally, I find myself more comfortable drinking blood when you and I are alone ...
Oh, do relax, I prepared a salad today, no blood bags involved.

Night.Transcription:
Have you ever wondered at our irrational fascination with the moon and her powers ...
ghosts, werewolves, vampires and forest spirits all beholden to the powers of the moon and the night?
Yet people still walk out into the terrible darkness just to see it.
Ah, but I nearly forgot,
you must share their fascination, else you wouldn't have hung that fake moon in the sky of your suitcase.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
If you're bedeviled by insomnia, you may wish to seek help from Lorelei.
Provided her choice of lullaby doesn't come with side effects ...
You aren't a gambler by nature, are you?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Laplace staff told me my brain is changing.
The reconfiguration of my nerve cells and hormones has given me a kind of photophobia.
If I do not consume blood regularly,
I will experience symptoms similar to vitamin C deficiency; joint pain, red gums and slowed healing of wounds.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Shake hands? If we must...
But, I remind you, it isn't very polite of you to take someone's hand without their consent.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Thankfully, my body hasn't become rigid and cold like that of a real "vampire."

Hobby.Transcription:
Sew them with deerskin, place them into the stone coffin, and then seal the coffin with lead and iron.
All those pains, like the preparations for some dreadful recipe ... Still, it's worth studying …

Praise.Transcription: It has ever been a pleasure to work with you, and I'm not just being polite in saying so.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Yes, do tell me if my grooming is up to standard.
I'm afraid the mirror and I are not the closest of friends.
It seems I no longer have a place in its heart, nor its reflection.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
There are many truly gifted individuals within the Foundation, and their unique arcane skills are, all said, intriguing.
Yet to be honest, among all of those bizarre abilities,
I find the ability to "name rubbish" and give it a new function by far the least meaningful.

Monologue.Transcription:
They've changed me. My body is strange now, my mind haunted by thoughts that don't belong to me ...
But, are these changes irrecoverable? I still feel myself somewhere beneath it all, a part of me that has never gone away.

Deployment.Transcription: It seems you're ready.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Hmm ... That was certainly a choice.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: I hope you like a splash of red.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Close your eyes. It will all be over soon ...

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Battles have little meaning, save for the prizes to be won.

Insight.Transcription: I thank you for your generosity. Now, what do you want from me?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I'm back, finally. My wish has come true ...
I sincerely hope that one day, your wishes will come true too.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Thank you for inviting me, Ms. Vertin. A typical room is more than fine ...
Oh, by the way, do you happen to have a swimming pool here?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Yes, we always feel most at home in the water.
It falls from the sky, flows into the sea,
and eventually runs through our mouths and gills.
No, Rusalki will never stay away from it for long.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future? We will build new homes,
and the sun will melt the thick snow, and our fields will grow new crops.
Our dream will be realized on this land. Perhaps by then, our peace will last forever.

Idle.Transcription: You just taught me a lesson. It seems that kids lose their focus quickly, no matter their age.

Greetings.Transcription:
Oh, Ms. Vertin ...
I suggest we spend more time together like this to share more ideas and philosophy.

Morning.Transcription:
We get up on time, clean our rooms, and even have regular meals ... Strange, I know.
What must I do for you to join us?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Dear comrade, I think you should make a daily schedule and put it ... Let me see ...
Here, so everyone can see it.

Night.Transcription:
You had a productive day and deserve a relaxing night.
No reason for anyone to get in your way.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Отпусти вчерашний день, оставь в прошлом
Каждый шаг рисует новый день.
Не смотри назад, нет теней B дневном
Светлые небеса, мы путешествуем

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
My mother used to roll and braid my hair when it was still wet.
Luckily, the wind was very dry in my hometown, so all I had to do was take a walk for my hair to become fluffy again.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
There are only two places in the human world where I've felt free to show my scales.
The first was Rayashki, and the other is here.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
These paint stains and water spots were left after class.
The children get so excited when they're focused on their work ...
but I actually like the mess. It makes for a dazzling display, a little like the scales on my tail, don't you think?

Hobby.Transcription:
I learned ballroom dancing from humans and aqua dancing from Rusalki,
but neither would ever dance with someone from the other race. Silly, isn't it?
Oh, it's okay ... I'm long over it.
But if anyone ever told you that Rusalki don't dance, let me prove them wrong.
Just give me your hand, and you'll see.

Praise.Transcription:
To us, you are a warrior, a giver, and, most importantly,
a leader who shares our goals.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Whenever I introduce myself, I often have to explain that I'm not a Vodyanoi.
Ms. Vertin, perhaps you could tell them more about the Rusalki? ...
On second thought, perhaps not; those stories aren't ... very pleasant.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Back in the old days, we often danced around the campfire.
After that, we talked about life and told the children the true history of our land.
Sometimes, we would just sit in silence, waiting for the future to arrive ...
I learned this from living among the humans.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
The cold water doesn't bother Rusalki ... So when I saw that girl in the lake …
Her face had turned blue as ice, poor kid.
Did she have to bathe in water to cast her arcane skill?

Monologue.Transcription:
We met here like the confluence of rivers. Singing as we run forward together, leaving the past behind.
Caring for everyone, no matter where they are from.

Deployment.Transcription: We make an ideal team.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: To a brighter future for everyone!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Keep going! For our dream, comrade!

Insight.Transcription: Thank you for your help, dear comrade.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
From icebergs to mountains, from the sea to the land, I have traveled between these worlds countless times.
Then I found Rayashki, at the intersection of these worlds ... Small but hopeful.
Alone in its dream ... but maybe not so in the future.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
A hand-operated spinning wheel half drenched in water ...
This indicates a low level of technological development here.
Do not worry, Timekeeper, I am equipped with 15 adaptive plugs suitable for any situation.
I will start by running the drainage program ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Raindrops are supposed to fall from the sky to the ground, not the other way around.

To_the_Future.Transcription: Kinetic, chemical, electrical, nuclear ... What kind of energy will we harness next?

Idle.Transcription:
You are very still ... Are you in low power mode?
Hm ... but your battery is still decreasing. Are you sure this is an effective method?

Greetings.Transcription:
Your visits are always unexpected. I appreciate that.
Door knocking is more of a formality than a functional necessity.

Morning.Transcription:
A Laplace employee once told me, "Whether one needs to sleep is not dependent on the time of day.
Our work efficiency is highest at night, so daytime is best for sleeping."
Over 80% of Laplace employees live like this. Still, I do not believe it is an accurate assessment.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I have noticed that there are no doorbells to the rooms in the suitcase.
This has made it inconvenient for me to provide wake-up call services for our colleagues.
Could you please ... Oh? X has already proposed that we prohibit their installation?

Night.Transcription:
People utilize a variety of methods to rest: they sleep, talk to others, watch TV ... How exactly do these function?
Since my long-term mission is to "rest," I will have to add these activities to my schedule.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
The fastest way to learn is through imitation.
See, Timekeeper? I have adjusted my posture and am reproducing breathing patterns found at various stages of sleep.
Now, does it look like I'm sleeping to you?
Oh, thank you for reminding me. I will remember to close my eyes next time.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Humans are capable of creating a total of 3.7x10<sup>35</sup> different smiles.
Therefore, at a rate of one smile per second, it will take me 1.17x10<sup>28</sup> years to do them all.
Unfortunately, no one can live long enough to watch the whole process, so I will never know which is the perfect smile.
I think it is best I give up on this project.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I had been planning on equipping myself with more arms to increase my multitasking capabilities,
but the plan was halted for reasons I still do not understand. If I recall correctly, they said it was ... "creepy."
Still, I regret not going through with it, especially since there is so much to be done.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
The heat from your palm is transferring to the piston in my core. I can feel it.
Ah, so this is what we call "a sense of danger." Could you please take your hand off me?

Hobby.Transcription:
In theory, I am a tool.
There is no need for tools to have feelings or hold preferences. Therefore, I do not have any "hobby" to discuss with you.
But, when it comes to things I want to see at work, there is one: a well-kept schedule.

Praise.Transcription:
There is no doubt you are a capable leader,
housing such a large team in so small a suitcase. In Laplace, we would need a whole building to do the same.

Intimacy.Transcription:
I have noticed how popular you are among the members here.
Perhaps you could give me some advice on team management.
For example, should I lower my height when talking to the minors?
Oh ... this is the first time I have seen below the brim of your hat. Your eyes are sparkling.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The other day, A Knight and I came to a consensus on the most efficient method to maintain metal.
Ms. Sputnik was there too, but she showed no interest in the topic.
She just span, and span, and span.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
It is not as easy as you would think for me to communicate with John Titor.
While I can speak in binary and hexadecimal languages, neither are my mother tongue.
Hm? What is my mother tongue? English, of course.

Monologue.Transcription:
Could it be that I have been rebooted multiple times without my knowing?
Data is not always reliable. It can be changed. Is the knowledge the database gives me truly mine? Am I the real Lucy?
I cannot solve these questions myself. I simply do not have the answers.

Deployment.Transcription: Battery checked.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Allow me to double check the battery levels.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: I, robot, child of science.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: And now to return to my long-term mission: "rest."

Insight.Transcription: Hopefully, we are still far off from reaching the limit.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: My materials are softer, my features more "human".

0.Transcription: Did you get it? The stain I mean.

Lobby_Entrance_2.Transcription: Based on the results of your personalization settings, I believe this may be an appropriate choice of face.

Lobby_Interaction_6.Transcription:
You refused ... I see. You must prefer the Thomas the Tank Engine face.
Hmm? Am I wrong?

Lobby_Entrance_1.Transcription:
May I request we keep our business short today? My batteries have only four hours and 23 seconds left,
unless you can provide me with an extension cord.

Lobby_Interaction_1.Transcription:
Are you trying to take off this face, or wipe a stain from it?
Either way, I am glad to know that you pay attention to the details.
It is an essential quality for any good researcher.

Lobby_Interaction_2.Transcription: What a pity. It seems I will have to make some improvements to this face.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I have cast an incantation on you.
It allows us to communicate and exchange our names as the code of etiquette requires.
I'm Getian.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
I used to believe people were either troubled by the endless rain or pained by the ceaseless drought,
and there was nothing in between.
But you're not any of them. You walk in the rain as if it does not exist.
I know so little of this world, and I have so much to learn from you.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The lost days are many, and none can ever be found.
Tomorrow is no different from yesterday, for the future is as ungraspable as the past.

Idle.Transcription:
You have a piece of wilderness here, too. I can hear its breath blowing through the windows.
The sound is foreign to me,
but the quality of repose is homelike.

Greetings.Transcription:
You often show up unexpectedly. Is this a recent trend among the houseguests?
Giving it some thought, some of my people also flew to another tree unanticipatedly.
I see. I will try it someday.

Morning.Transcription: So it seems even Timekeeper herself cannot keep good time in the morning.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Thank you. I haven't felt the need for food for a long time.
But this plate of green vegetables, berries, and bread crumbs is ... indeed appetizing.
Please pass me the little red, round berries.
Yes, just put them on my wings.

Night.Transcription:
Please open the window for me. I wish to stretch my wings and have some fresh air.
Thank you.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
A night like this is perfect for music, but the neighbors have spoken to me about their sleeping problems several times.
The music was extremely loud and clear in the quiet night.
I found the top of that stone tower in the Wilderness a nice alternative.
If you need a lift there, just let me know.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
It's true that the long hair would block part of my vision, but it also protects me from the curious, unwanted gaze.
Unlike my feathers, it is lighter and easier to fall off.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
A moment, please.
I would like to observe your social etiquette by shaking your hand with this bone wand.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Please remember to wash your hands after this.
I always keep my feathers clean, but there could be some wing powder getting on your fingers.

Hobby.Transcription:
It's commonly believed that the Miemengs have an incredible grasp of your language when they are born,
but the truth is, they only understand the rhythm and musicality within, not the meaning behind it.
It is also true for the Miemengs born outside the cold mountains, like me.

Praise.Transcription:
Many have the courage to chase after what they want despite the danger,
but few are wise enough to keep themselves safe during the pursuit.
You are one of the latter, I can tell.

Intimacy.Transcription:
I have found some shiny and peculiar items nearby,
some seemed to be made of jade and crystals, and others were strange metal components and cans.
Help yourself to see if there's anything useful.
Think nothing of it. I didn't know my unintentional action had brought the lost items back to their owners.
The world works in mysterious ways.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
People must reshape their bones, change the patterns on top, and endure great pain to change their fate.
Their appearances remain the same, but they are no longer the same person.
I only possess a humble knowledge of this practice; I have never done it myself.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I seemed to have mistaken an arcanist for a scarecrow and rested on his shoulder.
Please give him my regrets, Timekeeper. That gentleman has a deep and strong voice, surrounded by many birds.
That's why I made the mistake.

Monologue.Transcription:
Ages have passed since the reign of Zhangwu.
Though there have been many dark and stormy times, the most peculiar of all was when the rain fell upwards. But that was only a dream, wasn't it?

Deployment.Transcription: I'm no master of teamwork.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: I wouldn't have to do this.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Confrontation was never to my liking.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The Bagua drawn on the cyan brick never warns about its changes.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Victory, the mother of arrogance.

Insight.Transcription: True friends respect each other till the very end.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
The wind goes past the corners of the roofs and comes out of the alleys,
learning the sounds of nature and humans on its journey.
I accompany it with my flute, and a new song is thus created.

Lobby_Entrance.Transcription:
*yawns*
I can have whatever I need at any time here, the rainwater, the fruits.
Though I have a shelter in town, the life there is not as cozy as what I'm living now.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Excuse me, where is this place?
Oh, you mean put my hands on this?
Alright, done.
You mean, it's an arcane skill?
An arcane skill makes me speak your language, and you speak mine? I think I've heard it before.
When and where, exactly?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Rain of ash.
Rain! Rain! Dance! Dance!
Oh, right. I remember when the Daoist put ashes into dirt, and the dirt started steaming in no time.
Exactly how it smells like now.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
As long as I spend enough time traveling around the world,
eventually I will meet those who left Pei City for exploration.
I remember everyone in the city, so I won't miss a chance to greet them!
I'll go tell them that "Jiu Niangzi has been well. I even gained weight these days."

Idle.Transcription:
Three, two, one.
What? Oh, I see! The game of "Who talks first"!
Alright, it starts after I count from one to nine—
This one doesn't count!

Greetings.Transcription:
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine ...
The number of paper is more than nine. Is this what that girl with the flower needs?
They do become yellow after sinking in the Huangjiu and tea.

Morning.Transcription:
I'm used to waking up early and managing the tavern. Now, I get restless when I have nothing to do.
But I've come up with a good plan—go run in the Wilderness, and greet the animals and the plants.
Greet! Good day!
Haha. Good day to you, too.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Morning! I was waiting for you to wake up and visit me.
Work hard during the day, and sleep tight at night. What are you going to do today?
Don't start it without breakfast. Some noodles, vegetables, and two sunny-side-up eggs. What do you think?

Night.Transcription:
The lights here are amazing! They're much brighter than the lanterns in the city,
and keep burning day and night. They never go out ...
Oh! Does it mean that they're also arcanists, just like the Taiping Drum that keeps beating all night?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
It's fine. We still have time to talk!
I'll ask the wooden dolls to make your bed, clean the tables, and get you something to help you sleep.
Oh, I forgot, things are different here.
What about tea, or honey water?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I don't like wearing too many accessories on my head. Tying hair up is troublesome, too.
But the people in town always do that, so I had a good idea!
Use my tools as hairpins, making my head a pocket for tools! How about that?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Your hands are cold.
Back in my city, Mr. Liu told me that people born with cold hands are weak and need more nourishment.
Oh, you just washed your hands? I ... I see.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
You see the writing on the purse? They were originally poems other people wrote and were given to me as gifts.
Then I cut the fabrics and sewed them together to make this purse. I read them when I get tired at work.
Like ... "Love birds side by side ... in the aromatic water ... having the greens of spring ... Over the wall ... there is more."
I think it means people love the meals in the restaurant.

Hobby.Transcription:
I have my wooden dolls as assistants, and I remember every formula of the liquors.
All I need to start a tavern is just enough materials and a space.
So, may I have some land in the Wilderness?

Praise.Transcription:
If, I mean if, I made a plaque for you to hang on this wall, what do you think should be carved on it?
"Selfless"? "Generous"? ... Not quite.
Oh, how about just "Good Vertin"?

Intimacy.Transcription:
People call me Jiu or Jiu Niangzi.
Jiu means nine, and can also mean liquor.
That's all I know. But no matter which name you call me, I'll answer you loud and clear.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Jessica ... Am I saying it right?
She is my role model, because ...
Look, how great a Xiangrui she is! She is able to transform half of her body into a Yao!
We often roll over the grass, race, and chase the hares passing by.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There is a foreign lady who looks familiar and rolls her tongue when she speaks.
She visited me a few times with a canteen ...
No, no, she didn't drink anything!
She just sniffed the jars like a puppy and then left. How rude was that!

Monologue.Transcription:
After leaping over the bridge, I took a look back at the city, to see nothing but fog.
I wonder if people on this end of the bridge have ever thought to take a look over there.
The fog is the same, no matter from which side of the river.
Do they know the rain doesn't come down the usual way, but goes back up to the sky?
*sighs* Who knows? I'll let it go. I'm getting more and more confused.

Deployment.Transcription: Let's go. I walk fast.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: I'll fill the cup for you—Ah!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: I remember it's called ... lending a hand!

Insight.Transcription:
You see anything different on me?
Another pair of ears, stripes, or a longer tail?
If none, then my time has not come yet.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Ding, ding, ding ... It's not easy, but I'm glad that you're all happy!
How about we make this place our own, and put a Lushu here to guard this place?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Greetings. *gasps because of coldness*
I don't think I will ever get used to the coldness of water when I'm not performing divination.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
When we travel on the tundra, the sleet is the last thing we would like to see.
The muddy snow water would be mixed with root pieces and infiltrate into your boots through every crack.
Your legs would be dragged down and down until you can't lift them anymore.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
To this day, I have traveled to many places on my feet.
I believe I will reach somewhere far, far away one day, far enough to forget the way back.
That will be where my story truly starts.

Idle.Transcription:
Time is like a cold river flowing rapidly.
Whoever falls into it doesn't have a choice of the direction they will be going.
I feel the same helplessness when you remain silent.

Greetings.Transcription:
Привет, Ms. Vertin. I'm arranging the travel notes from the last trip.
Well yes, sometimes it's hard to identify what I have written, even for myself.

Morning.Transcription:
When I was in Saint Petersburg, I often took a walk along a country path.
There were black locust and white birch trees on both sides, and the sparrows were chirping on the branches.
The morning was always lively there, always.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
The divination signs I see through the arcane energy in water are not that clear in most of the time.
Yes, I did "see" that your hat was left by the spring in the Wilderness, but that's because you spend a lot of time there.

Night.Transcription:
The river feels cold yet gentle at midnight.
The water will stroke people's ankles until all the worries are washed away.
Good night. May you sleep tight like the black cobblestone at the bottom of Lake Baikal.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
*hums a melody for divination*
Perhaps you will sleep better than usual tonight if you place your legs to the northwest.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Actually, long hair is not a good choice for a regular traveler, but ...
yes, there is still a limit to what my mother can tolerate.
That's why I wear my hair up sometimes. It's the only thing I can do.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Are you hoping to shake hands with me? Please hold on. Let me check the temperature of my palm …
Alright, I'm ready.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
These weak arms always slow me down whenever I need to climb on the journey.
But I can easily walk over 30 versts carrying a whole bag of supplies, as long as it's not snowing.

Hobby.Transcription:
Like people, waters have their own traits. Lake water is calm, river water is energetic, stream water is shy ...
While sea water, sea water is tolerant and unpredictable.

Praise.Transcription:
Misfortunes never last long.
"Hope is the faithful sister of misfortune." I'm sure you know that.

Intimacy.Transcription:
When hypothermia strikes in the wild, it won't help much even if you try to warm yourself inside a horse corpse.
There wouldn't have been all those troubles and dangers, if we had these thermal insulation gears before.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The water flowing out of Ms. La Source's jar is ceaseless, and it is actual running water.
The direction it shows is always different every time I touch it. Unbelievable …

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
After using these glass bottles for a while, I realized they could hold other things besides water samples.
They work well when you need to convey something you want others to read rather than hear.
I suggest you give it a try next time.

Monologue.Transcription: По которой реке плыть, той и песенки петь.

Deployment.Transcription: Пожалуйста, пропустите меня.

PreBattle.Transcription: May the flow take their souls to the sea in the north.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: ... Пусть le naufragé течёт вместе с водой.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Rivers are the scars of the earth.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Worry not. The direction of fate is decided.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
We've done a good job.
Now, may I have a hand towel?

Insight.Transcription: Thank you, Ms. Vertin. I have seen the flow of the world.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
It feels like I have experienced another journey.
My view has been expanded, and my mind has never been clearer.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Thank you for your generosity, miss.
I think I'll stay here for a few days ...
Oh? You prepared a room for me?
So you did. Look how ... dainty it is. I am grateful.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
People are always busy on a sunny day like this.
They'll talk about their riding boots, introduce their daughters, and show off their pocket watches ...
Me? I'm what the gathering is for. There's no point for them to be here without me.

To_the_Future.Transcription: The future? ... Does it matter?

Idle.Transcription: *hums a lullaby*

Greetings.Transcription: Please have a seat. You'll always feel at ease in my room, no matter the time.

Morning.Transcription:
Ah—Ah—Ah—
Oh, good morning. You're always in a hurry.
Care for a cup of tea?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Hmm. I don't mean to bother you,
but ... I had a terrible nightmare.
Would you lend me your ear and tell it to my doctor?

Night.Transcription:
The stars are so bright I can't sleep, that's why I'm here.
So what is this place? I don't even recall such a place, and the scenery's new to me.
Ugh, am I dreaming again?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
When I was little, on a night like this one,
I woke up to the sounds of footsteps outside my room. Have you ever heard footsteps like this?
Shoeless, wet soles splattering on the marble floor, slimy and erratic,
like a frayed brush stroking haphazardly across a canvas.
I looked to see who it was, and there stood my mother, with a brass needle in one hand, and my father in the other.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
The veil is on top. Underneath is the hat, my hair, and then my brain.
That's all I have here, miss.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You asked her where the jewelry box was, she said it was under the bed.
Then you asked her if she knew who the murderer was, and she said it was some scumbag, and that's all she knew.
You're trying to cover up one bloodshed with another! How naive you are.
Open your eyes and see! I'm Isolde, not her!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
What do you think of vessels? Does the word mean bowls, plates, bottles, or vases?
Is it really the vessel that matters, or the wines and delicacies inside?

Hobby.Transcription:
As you can see, I don't have an amulet to ward off the ghosts.
People have given me all kinds of blessings, except for this one.

Praise.Transcription: You're not afraid, nor surprised.

Intimacy.Transcription:
You've come to see me again. You'll see me tonight, tomorrow, and every day after that, won't you?
After all, I'm a patient. I'll be weak and fragile even when I get better,
so keep an eye on me and don't let me faint unnoticed ... I hope I won't be a nuisance to you ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Be quiet, Heinrich. We're not going anywhere.
This is the only place I can be. We're not allowed to go out on our own.
Have you ever seen a mental patient on the stage? Or heard of a paralyzed man running about?
There will be no more shows until I leave this place, no more.
Hmm ... Your costume is torn, right on the chest. How did you tear this?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
To maintain a graceful posture, be like a bird.
Chin up, chest out, but not too much. Stay balanced and straighten your legs.
You see, the books I used to carry on my head are long gone, but their weight is still with me.

Monologue.Transcription:
There's a room like this in every mansion.
The seams of the door are sealed with cotton, and there's a red sign on the handle.
No one will tell you it's special, and yet it's private, like the secrets of a teenage girl.
There's nothing there, you know?
It's just an ordinary room of a good daughter, a good sister, a good noble lady, and a good opera singer.
Yes, that is my room.

Deployment.Transcription: Time for treatment?

PreBattle.Transcription: It's an honor to meet you.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Mon officier n'est pas un capitaine ...

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Ti soffoca il sangue? Ti soffoca il sangue?!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: The curtain ... has fallen.

Insight.Transcription: I have left the ruins, and now stand before the mirrors ...

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: *humming*

First_Encounter.Transcription:
A suitcase immune to the "Storm" ... It's ... Yes, it's a wonderful idea.
And so comfortable and spacious too ... It could save many lives.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
It's raining, quiet, soft rain. No gunshots, no twisted people or buildings.
Just a simple phenomenon of nature, such that it is here.

To_the_Future.Transcription: The future ... I'm not sure what it will be like, but I know I will get there.

Idle.Transcription:
Hey ... She's ... utterly motionless, breathing steadily. Taking a nap?
Hmm, is this some kind of new trend, sleeping while standing up?
Maybe I can show her something to bring her back …

Greetings.Transcription: Welcome! There's no need to knock, I saw you through the mirror at the door.

Morning.Transcription:
Stop throwing pebbles, Illich. Let me sleep another five! I used to say that whenever Illich woke me up.
But there are no cracks on my windows anymore ... no pebbles.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Did you hear that? It's her. Singing ... So she hasn't stopped ...
Does she still have nightmares, I wonder? Or tremors and convulsions?
Sorry. That was inappropriate ...
I know, I'll only make things worse if I meet her now, unless I knew how to change her condition ...
but I don't, at least not for now.

Night.Transcription:
So then after WWI came WWII ... Will there be a WWIII?
With The "Storm" bringing chaos to everyone and everywhere. I think peace will not last long ...
I must borrow a few more books from Marcus and learn more.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Oh, sorry. Did I wake you?
I was on my way to the garden ... Or should I say the "Wilderness," for a walk.
No, no ... Don't worry, I just had a dream. But would you care to join me?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I believe most of the world's secrets are hidden within our heads.
How many neurons might there be within our brains? One million, ten million, or 100?
Have we yet to discover our limits?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Oh, looking for something in my hands? Take a look, I have no secrets hidden up my sleeves.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
A healthy body is a precondition for a truly healthy mind.
It helps you think quickly and to run fast should you have to jump out of a window to escape.

Hobby.Transcription:
Can it be true that psychology and biology have increasingly overlapped as they've developed! How curious ...
Yet, I concede it is only logical.
Our brains are both the source of our psyches and a part of our natural bodies. It's only that I was a little surprised ...
So, what else might you tell me about our brains?

Praise.Transcription:
What a welcome refuge this place is.
The arcanists under this roof can enjoy their freedom without being hampered by any red tape ...
And there seems to be always more room for new guests.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Excuse me ... Are you free now?
The psychiatrist from headquarters suggested I consider a more modern treatment for my long term care,
but I don't feel ready at all.
Would you ... listen to me for a while?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
What?! You mean those two came from the Golden Isle?!
Gosh, please, hold my bag! I must have a chat with them!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
During my practice, many patients would tell me secrets that no one else knew.
Sometimes they were embarrassed by them, they were worried I might tell someone and even tried to kill me ...
That's why I keep a pistol in my bag. Just in case!

Monologue.Transcription:
Everyone has their own duty; her, the people of Vienna, you, and me.
I must get back on my feet and move on ... This is the only path for me, after the catastrophes that I have caused.

Deployment.Transcription: Oh! Are we heading to a seminar?

PreBattle.Transcription: Let us have a fair fight.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Oh please, I know how to use it!

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Time to pull out the expensive stuff!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Didn't see that coming, did you?

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Oh, don't stare at it for too long!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: You must see your true self.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Come back! I need your feedback on our session!

Insight.Transcription: Wow, a new power! Emm ... I don't have to put that in my file, do I?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Know ... myself?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
A spinning wheel is meant to turn around, just like fate is bound to happen.
In many cases, we don't have a choice.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Raindrops are like transient thoughts. They fall into the ocean and merge into a greater vastness.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future is as eternal and true as this island.
It was there long before anyone was there, and stays the same after everybody is gone.

Idle.Transcription: ... There's no question that solitude is a blessing.

Greetings.Transcription: ... Well, the chair is in the middle of the room. Please take a seat.

Morning.Transcription:
I start reading at this time of day and finish it as dusk falls.
This has become a soothing habit of mine in this long, weary journey to the final end.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
... One should never parcel off the loaf, for it's a violation of the scripture.
But we are not on the island. So, please enjoy the freedom.

Night.Transcription:
The alternation of day and night maintains the balance of the world.
However, when electric light prolongs the day and eats into the night, the balance is gone, followed by the fairness.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
It is hard to tell the time here in the suitcase, but the ebb and flow of my soul remind me that it is time for bed ...
Tiredness caught up with me.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Every night, the seagulls fly into my bedroom from the edge of the island.
They follow the glint of the crown and snatch it away.
The next morning, I walk to the cliff and take it back from their nest.
Day after day, again and again.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Silence is a virtue.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: The uncovered area on my chest happens to be in the shape of an isosceles triangle, as 37 proved it.

Hobby.Transcription:
Hobby, the source of one's pleasure,
varies from person to person.
One of my friends has a love for numbers, one is drunk in the beauty and power of words, and one is the defender of rules ...
I also find myself immersed in joy when I'm alone in the room after a day's work.

Praise.Transcription: I appreciate your understanding on the importance of personal space. It is a valuable virtue.

Intimacy.Transcription:
If you don't mind, please cancel the meetings and work before 3 p.m. tomorrow for me ...
Yes, I wish to be left alone, just for a brief peace of mind.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The wise ones on this island used to strike the iron ingots.
After years of careful arrangements and calculations, the clanging sound became music.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
The seagulls on the island are clever, cunning, and experienced burglars.
They seem to have a preference for stealing those thin, golden, and rectangular objects ...

Monologue.Transcription: At last, a perfect tragedy.

Deployment.Transcription: Are you seeking my service?

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Time for tongues to speak of truth.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The scale of your soul has tilted. The balance needs to be restored.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Victory secured. I should excuse myself.

Insight.Transcription: Is there another level of perfection upon perfection?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Turning against the fire in the cave, we see the true lights.

First_Encounter.Transcription: So Ms. Suitcase Keeper, are you the quiet type in this group too?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Salt is falling from the sky. I think this must be a sign of friendliness.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I read about a place with red snow in my picture books.
The people there race on lake monsters, and shake hands with fire.
I would like to see it myself and bring it to our town.

Idle.Transcription:
Great job hiding.
But I will always find you.

Greetings.Transcription: I know how to treat a new friend like you!

Morning.Transcription:
I already don't eat much ...
But I could try to eat even less!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I prepared breakfast for you! It's Runium slag ...
The critters told me it's the best food in the world.
But I think people don't like how it tastes. My mom says she likes it,
though she has never eaten her breakfast in front of me.

Night.Transcription:
I have blankets and milk ready, Vertin.
Now you must lie down for story time.
The story I'm going to tell is about the Snow Maiden, the granddaughter of Old Father Frost …

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Stay snug under the covers and close your eyes. Soon, your long-lost friends will visit you.
Sometimes I hear a fairy's voice ...
that sounds a little like my mom ...
Now, good children know to go to sleep right away …

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: I object! You must ask before touching a fellow comrade's head!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I found a straggled bit of coal days ago.
Uncle Valery said it was his frozen finger!
So, I planted it in snow, I hope it will sprout when spring comes!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
This coat was my papa's, and the sweater was made by my mom.
They tell me holes in them are windows for me to see my friends ...
I think I am very lucky!

Hobby.Transcription:
When I played hide and seek, the first friend I found was the sun; he was hiding under the horizon.
Soon I found the second, the third ...
I am very good at it! It might take time, but eventually, I will find all my friends.

Praise.Transcription:
You deserve a certificate, or an award, and a medal!
I will make one for you. I've seen them make it before …

Intimacy.Transcription:
Could you give me a Picrasma?
My snowman needs a nose!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
бабочка have four wings, six jointed legs, a pair of antennae and a thin abdomen.
Vila says that бабочка look almost like colorful snowflakes ...
I can write to Vila and ask her to catch one for us.
Vertin, do you know how to spell "бабочка"?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
The floating lady likes to share her tea with me. We have so very much to talk about.
She invites me to visit her in her room, in there tea cups and carrots can grow bigger or smaller!
It's most beautiful, just like Rayashki.
You'll know it when you see it!

Monologue.Transcription:
Pyotr says we will join the underground tour sooner or later.
Are Mr. Ironhat and papa exploring the path for us?
I know they're called "pioneers."
I want to be a pioneer to help people, no matter where I need to go.

Deployment.Transcription: This is my position!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: It's most great to see you!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Will you be my friends too?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: I hope you like it here, even if you are bad friends!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: You have done well, comrade!

Insight.Transcription: Will the daytime here be longer and warmer?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: See, the flowers have grown taller. They will take good care of you.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
When we shake hands, we enter a relationship like that of two intersecting lines.
It's a pleasure to work with you, Ms. Timekeeper.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Dive into the clouds, soak into the soil, move dizzyingly back and forth between the earth and sky.
Yes, exactly what a ley line researcher does.

Idle.Transcription:
Hey, hey ... Did you leave anything behind?
Well, well, how forgetful—You left me here alone!

Greetings.Transcription:
You're finally here!
I could use a sponsor like you. So there is a new discovery of mine …

Morning.Transcription:
I almost starved to death. That morning,
for once, my arcane skill came in use; I found a winning lottery ticket on the street.
I say winning, but it wasn't worth much, only enough for some stale bread ...
I ate it so fast. I don't even remember the taste.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Oh ... Why bother waking up?
There is nothing to see outside the window, except the lush, vibrant natural scape.

Night.Transcription:
Look at that shooting star. It's moving eastward towards Lyra, not a good omen ...
If you meet someone selling that on the street, you'd best keep an eye on your wallet.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I had a dream ... I was being applauded, surrounded by a sea of other researchers ...
As far as the why goes, my brain still needs time to work it out.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Touching one's forehead is a gesture of friendliness among Felidae and other cat-shaped critters.
I've seen Carbuncles doing it. But perhaps you could explain why you are doing this?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Are those chapped hands bothering you?
Try this amber oil. I made it specifically for field investigations …

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
This coat is worth around 20 rubles.
I pawned it during some financial difficulties, but I was lucky enough to be able to pay for it every time.
I doubt it's worth much now.

Hobby.Transcription:
Never drink to help you through adversity, it will just make things worse ...
Only drink to celebrate or commiserate, should the times call for it.

Praise.Transcription:
You've really read my research paper?
I don't know how to show my gratitude ... I think I might cry. Don't stop me.

Intimacy.Transcription:
C-could you lend me some money?
I am aware that research grants require applications and must proceed through proper channels,
but that's why I came to you …

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
In my hometown, especially during winter, it's hard to catch those parts of natural life that easily change.
Even spending days hunkering down and waiting, observing,
almost nothing will pass through the snow, except my footprints.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Genius Researcher Faces Funding Dilemma ...
Damn it! This isn't even newsworthy!
I'm tired of hearing of these struggling researchers.
These so-called geniuses should learn to swallow their pride if they wanna earn their bread.

Monologue.Transcription:
In the study of ley lines, there is no such thing as a "pole"—no "end of lines."
We endlessly draw new maps, trying to draw conclusions from them.
Ones that might build things and bring others together.
It isn't about whether the theory is right or wrong, only that it gives us useful answers.

Deployment.Transcription: It depends on the budget.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: No other study could show you this!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Limited scale, infinite lines.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: We worked on this collaboration together. I'll write you into my paper.

Insight.Transcription: Next, to draw a bigger picture.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: The whole world in my hands—I always knew it could be.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
There's also a room for me?
But it's hardly the best arrangement, given that
I don't need a room and my stay may pose a fire hazard.
Please, an airy fireplace will suit me just fine.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The fire brings down weeds in the field, and the rain lets the seeds germinate.
The circle of life is thus completed.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Few things stay the way they are through the long course of time,
but people's spirits will always endure.
Wood may turn into coal, and coal may be liquefied into oil, but fire will always be fire.

Idle.Transcription: Sometimes, I wonder, how different am I from candlelight?

Greetings.Transcription: Well, another worshiper, hah! Have a seat!

Morning.Transcription: Fire, the sun on earth.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Yes, yes, I can burn some of your problems into ashes, as long as you ...
Mmm, don't look at me like that.
Do you really believe that Flammy's report card spontaneously combusted
when she failed the test in 9th grade?

Night.Transcription:
Turn on that cuboid box and switch to [FM 8]. There will be sports at 7:30 ...
Yes, that's right. We're listening to this one.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
You kids should get together and sleep in one big room,
like what we used to do in the caves ...
So none of you miss my bedtime story.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I look lighter at the head, you say? Certainly you have an eye for detail.
I reckon ... it must be the change in air density.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Oh, many would like to shake my hand, but some of them will unfortunately get burnt for it—do you wish to try?

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Hey! It tickles ... let me go! Haha ... I mean it, hahaha ... for real!
Ah, you're just like Flammy. She would just jump on me and start tickling.
But I would always fight back, you see ... It's my turn now!

Hobby.Transcription:
Ah ... to tell the truth, I always think of the rainy season at Uluru,
when sheets of rain closed in on us like great curtains descending from the above.
It took away the heat, washed away the dirt and dust,
and left a long snake in seven colors swimming across the sky.

Praise.Transcription:
You are saying ... they didn't award you for what you have done?
There must be some mistake!
Alright, the Uluru Flame shall honour you with a trophy for your effort in promoting good sportsmanship!

Intimacy.Transcription:
My heart is made of a pack of obsidian gravels which are evenly distributed in 22 layers.
They close around this core of mine, keeping it from losing control ...
I don't share this with everyone, if you know what I mean.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Yes, I have become friends with your dryer, but I'm not surprised about it.
If fire can talk, and apple can sip some wine, why can't a dryer have her wits?
Didn't take me long to realize that we are very alike;
both of us like things that are warm and dry.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Fire is versatile. Whether it is sent from the above or taken out from a bigger fire,
it is always warm in your chest, flickering like a heart.
It is a small sun on a wooden stick, or the engine of a running castle.

Monologue.Transcription: Today, the fire burns again, just as I foresaw it in the millions of long dark nights.

Deployment.Transcription: Competition first, burning second.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Feel it, feel the beating of your hearts!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Now, a big shout-out to the champion!

Insight.Transcription: The flame goes up higher when more wood is brought to it.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: As the flame grows, I will roar.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Paychecks assured, pets allowed, full board, safety insurance ...
Oh, and even regular travel?
The career benefits you provide are much better than what Laplace offers.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
A rainy day like this reminds me of those days when I was manning a stall.
Umbrellas, coffee, and hot dogs were the top three sellers when it rained out there.

To_the_Future.Transcription: The numbers on the bank book will slowly grow. The key is, don't be stupid with money.

Idle.Transcription:
The good thing about getting a digital emu as your pet is ... you don't pay for her fodder.
Just a single press, and she'll have virtual sunflower seeds for lunch.

Greetings.Transcription: See, Plappy is greeting you. Press this button and say hi to it.

Morning.Transcription:
Alright, so what can I get you? Coffee, pancakes, eggs or bacon?
People are ready in the kitchen now ...
Wait, am I supposed to deliver the milk today? Shoot!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Roll your hair up into the rollers, cover them with tinfoil, and apply some liquid ...
Stay still, trust me. I've worked in a hair salon.
Wait for another half hour, and you'll have fluffy and curly hair.

Night.Transcription:
Interesting things happen during night shifts. You meet a talking dog,
a swooping-around UFO, a girl trapped in some TVs, and more.
Well, there are boring times, of course, but I'm glad that Plappy is here with me.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
During the restless nights of my adolescence, I had no one but Plappy there for me.
The "coo-coo" sound she made was deep and rhythmic,
like some kind of relaxing white noise.
I learned how to babysit, all thanks to her.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Mm-hmm, you smelled it.
This is how you would smell like if you were a part-time cook at a BBQ party of 20 people—
smells like pepper and basil.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Hmm, my hands are neither soft nor smooth.
Credit goes to the cheap detergent they use in small hotels.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I've worked as a model on the flyers as well.
Trust me—photo shoots are much, MUCH more tiring than giving out flyers.
You stretch your body like a resistance band,
let alone the funny striped skirts and purple eye shadow.

Hobby.Transcription:
This hair clip ... just stick the rhinestones on it in a certain order,
and it'll shine like a diamond.
Ha! I knew it! My taste is not as bad as what they said. Look how pretty it is!

Praise.Transcription: You always deserve the award of Employee of the Year ... no, Employer of the Year!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Ahem! Hm, I mean, I owe you one.
If it weren't for you or those kids busy preparing for the Uluru Games,
I would be out there on the street in Melbourne, hustling all the time.
So, for the sweet words I just said,
can I perform the mission assigned by Laplace with that Girl Scout next week?
They're paying really handsomely!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I once thought my digital pet was a chick
until she became too big and came out of the machine.
That's when I realized—you can never trust this little thing,
just like you can't trust those sellers who claim
their pocket pets are "with a maximum size of five inches."

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
The world is neither good nor bad. It has no ill intentions, let alone good will.
So, when bad things happen, use your brain and take actions to get through it.

Monologue.Transcription:
The worst days are over.
Those words are my secret to staying positive when living in poverty.
Though cliche, when life gives you a lemon, make lemonade and sell it.

Deployment.Transcription: Double-checking: you pay me five Sharpodonties per hour, right?

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: You wanna do it the hard way?

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Bo-bo-bo-bo. Plappy, give me a hand!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Dance in the pixel world!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Told you I can handle any work.

Insight.Transcription: Oh? You appreciate my work. Good for you!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Hey! Over here! Cold soda and hot ticket sales! Come take a look!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Ms. Vertin, it's a great honor that you invite me, a human, here in your suitcase.
I do enjoy seeing old friends, and I am more than happy to meet new friends.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The damp air and the moist soil provide a proper humidity for hyphae to grow.
The forest, best hotbed in nature.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
My mom told me a story about a kingdom where there is no conflict.
People there love each other, respect each other ...
To make that story come true in our "future,"
let's work together and start by making more friends!

Idle.Transcription:
... Oh, please don't mind me and take your time.
I'm good at waiting, just like the mushrooms.

Greetings.Transcription:
Please be careful.
I'm collecting the spores on the mushroom canopy. Even the slightest breath will blow them all over the place ...
The last thing I wanna see is mushrooms growing all over the neat suitcase.
I mean, I love mushrooms, but ... we have to keep it moderate.

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning. Are you still sleepy?
I can make you a mushroom coffee. It only takes five minutes. Please wait for me.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
We have fresh riberry juice, pan-fried penny buns with butter,
fried egg with white mushrooms, and baked delicious milk caps for breakfast today ...
Oh, I should have asked if you like fungi. So ... do you not like mushrooms?

Night.Transcription: Good night. Sleep tight like the hyphae clinging to the birch roots.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Hey, take this pillow. I added lavender powder and truffle extract.
They will help you sleep well.
I notice that arcanists have a higher chance of suffering
from sleep disorders and myoclonic jerks,
so I think this pillow may help.
By the way ... could you show me to Ms. Mesmer Jr.'s room?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Hmm? You wanna try my hat?
Sure, Ms. Vertin. Our heads are of a similar size, so I think it will look just well on you.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I keep these gloves on to protect my hands from stings and thorns when I work in the fields,
and I always have a few spare ones with me.
They are rough to the touch, but very durable.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
It's true my terrarium has a highly efficient self-sustaining ecosystem,
but it still needs occasional supplements to maintain the operation.
Of course, the supplement process requires a sterile environment ...
Oh right! We are both suitcase owners!

Hobby.Transcription:
This? It's a bag of beech mushrooms.
Add in some seasonings and you'll get a nice dish. Both Spathodea and Plappy love it ...
It's just, no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't understand how a pixel animal eats.

Praise.Transcription:
In fact ... I'm glad that Laplace allows me to visit the suitcase from time to time.
I can always learn a lot from you.

Intimacy.Transcription:
You don't mind my drawing a painting of these potted plants, do you?
They have been here beside the nixie tube clock, witnessing the changes of times with you. That makes a nice theme.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Ms. Vertin, are you aware how Mr. APPLe keeps the lustre on him?
Oh ... Sunshine, polishing, naturally generated wax ...
I see. Arcanists are more incredible than I thought. How marvelous.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Recently I've been dreaming of the days back in my hometown.
The path in Kosciuszko went all the way to the rainforest in Queensland.
When I woke up, I could still feel the taste of Manuka honey in my mouth.

Monologue.Transcription:
Even though I'm one of "those who could not hear the music,"
I still like "those who were seen dancing."
There is nothing wrong with them. Someone has got to do the dancing in life, right?

Deployment.Transcription: Preparation completed.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: An amazing discovery.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
The fieldwork went smooth.
I look forward to our next cooperation.

Insight.Transcription: I have come to an even wider pine forest. There are a lot of new mushrooms to collect.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I see. Now I'm able to perceive more details ...
I have discovered more, learned more, and comprehended more,
which will redefine my classification system.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Yoohoo! I ran here as fast as I could, right after today's training!
You said there would be a new doorplate for my room. What is it like?
Oh, wait, let me guess. Is it like a ball of fire or a rainbow?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: It's a lovely day, and the sun is shining! Wanna go for a walk?

To_the_Future.Transcription:
In the future ... I think I will continue to hold the Uluru Games.
Maybe I'll grow too old to run one day,
but Ulu and the Games will always be there for everyone.

Idle.Transcription: Mmm ...

Greetings.Transcription:
Maybe ... maybe we can bring Fire Dance back to the Games.
It is a bit dangerous, but we can always have plenty of frogs by the field ...
Oh, there you are! Come check out my new proposal!

Morning.Transcription:
Alright ... I tried many times to swallow three raw eggs in the morning,
but all the attempts ended up failing.
Maybe ... maybe I should use some sugar. Will it make them taste better, like pancakes?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Vertin, would you like to try a new hairstyle? Like boxer braids ...
Look, I 100% respect your choice, but are you sure you don't wanna give it a go?
I've been thinking how perfect it will look on you ...

Night.Transcription:
I know a professional boxer should say no to junk food,
but ... sometimes I just can't control myself at midnight
and I have to get up for a scoop of ice cream.
When I do so, it tastes even better than usual.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Hey, hey! Wake up, Vertin, wake up!
I was sleeping in my room and started to sneeze like crazy,
and then I saw something pop into the window ... It's mushrooms!
From Ezra's room! They have filled up his room already and are still multiplying!
We gotta do something, or the suitcase will become a mushroom garden!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
The top priority in a boxing game is to protect your head.
That's essential when you're looking for an opportunity to give your opponent a concussion.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Cold compress, physical therapy, rehabilitation care ...
I've mastered all the skills I need as a junior nurse! It's quite something, I know!
But you gotta understand anyone can master them, like breathing,
as long as they suffer enough injuries.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Hahaha ... No, haha ... It tickles ... Hahaha! Oh my ...
I-I have a strange feeling of deja vu. Something like this happened before,
but I don't remember what it really was ...

Hobby.Transcription:
On the day my coach told my mom
"what Spathodea will be dealing with as a professional boxer" ...
I-I dreamed of Ulu that night, and her heat woke me up with a dry throat.
So I went to get water, and I saw Mom sitting in the dining room alone, looking at my collection of the Uluru photos ...
Anyway, the next morning, she told me she would be supportive
no matter what my decision would be.

Praise.Transcription: That's the spirit! Like a punch at full strength! Well done!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Wow, I've never had any chocolate like this!
Emm, I mean, it's not the best chocolate I've had, of course.
The best one has something to do with a special moment that means a lot to me ...
While this one, I like it simply because it's appetizing ... So, can I have one more?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Whenever I deeply focus, sparks will be conjured around me.
I used to believe that's my arcane skill,
and my friends always described it as "Flammy is on fire!" ...
Haha, it sounds kinda cool to me, actually!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Wait ... Wh-What is it that you're holding? A piece of paper from my ... bag?
Aaaaah! That's my report card! Stop reading!

Monologue.Transcription:
Before I took my first PE course, I never knew I could focus on one thing this much.
Then I started my career as a professional boxer,
and it was the first time I learned how cruel and inhumane the dark side of the sports circle can be.
Then I spat fire, found myself to be a soul from the ancient times,
got blinded by hatred and moved on, brought the Uluru Games back,
and ... and now it's time for me to go to senior high.

Deployment.Transcription: Now it's time for, Spaaaathodea!

PreBattle.Transcription: Warm up, warm up! Get moving!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Come on, this is the one punch!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Cheer and witness my victory!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: A fair game!

Insight.Transcription:
Wow, these sparks, they are burning even hotter ...
This is so much fun! Can we do it one more time?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Woohoo! Let me rocket to the sky, like an unstoppable uppercut!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Huh, what is this place?
Tsk-tsk, the serene lake, and the clear horizon at the end of the vast treeless plain ...
I would have thought I was back in the good old mountains if I didn't see you here.
Alright, do you mind showing me around, my grave-looking friend?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
See that?
On rainy days, this is how you get yourself an enormous wild boar on the glass with moderate effort!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Future is a perennial topic threaded throughout our lives ...
I have been chasing after mine for 40 years, yet it was never the right one.

Idle.Transcription:
When you take a nap, always keep your ears to the ground and the leaves ...
The bear cub walks like drums, and pheasant like flutes.

Greetings.Transcription: Well, well, I heard your footsteps when you rounded the corner ... Anything I can help you with?

Morning.Transcription:
Eeh, wanna have some yak butter tea?
If this is your first time trying this, I'd suggest that you not smell it before you drink it.
No no, it tastes good, except for that special odor, haha ...
You'll learn to love it once you're used to it!

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Take your time, my friend, there is no need to race against the clock. Everything happens in its own time.

Night.Transcription:
Help yourself to the tandoori chicken, cinnamon-spiced lamb soup, and lamb biryani.
The chickpea curry, chickpea roll and chickpea & pumpkin stew are for the Buddhist vegetarian.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I remember the first time I saw my teacher dance.
The villagers said the dance would rid them of illness and evil spirits and lend them health and happiness.
The heat from the bonfire distorted my vision ...
And I no longer saw the dance, but a fierce fight between a brown bear and a snow leopard.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Interested in this mask?
Here, I have all sorts of them in different shapes and patterns.
They are the source of my power and as important to me as your wands to you.
They witnessed my rebirth as a Shaman.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I once thought this is a price I paid for being weak ... But now I see it as a medal of bravery.
I mean ... look at it! It's so much cooler than the other arm!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
The deepest cut on my back was inflicted by a wolf cub, took me two months to ease the pain.
Never underestimate the wolf pup, it can be more fierce than its parents, no less.

Hobby.Transcription:
My life here is quite similar to the time when I studied and meditated in the mountains.
Living in solitude, dealing with dangerous critters, and the unpredictable mischief-makers ...
How confusing yet exciting this is! Life can't get better!

Praise.Transcription:
Look at your wise and clear eyes, the strong and agile movements,
the considerable professional experience, and the composed character ...
though I think the composure appears too soon on you at this age, I'm deeply amazed by what you have achieved!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Raise your hand, clench your fist, then hold up your index finger and the middle finger,
keep your thumb out, and waggle, waggle ...
Look! A wolf cub!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
It's hard to imagine that you people can learn so much from that hissing metal box.
Even the most forbidden shamanistic ritual can't achieve this.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Kumar is hardly a good sister, but neither am I a good brother to her ...
so we're cool!

Monologue.Transcription:
Twenty years is a long time. It ebbs one's hostility and immaturity, but also takes away almost everything one once owned.
Fortunately, I got through it and find myself at the end.

Deployment.Transcription: Ha, an experience adult is coming to your aid.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Are we gonna do this with gloves off?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Give me a hand, friends. I can't do this alone.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: This is not bad for a stretch.

Insight.Transcription: Whoo ...! Thought I can have some sugared pine nuts.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I've seen snowy mountains stretch dizzyingly to the end of sight.
I've seen the eyes of the wolves, where plants grow in spring and snow falls in winter ...
That's the moment when I realized where I belong.

First_Encounter.Transcription: I'm Kanjira, and this is Punji! I hope you're not afraid of her ... Wow ... This place is sooo cool!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The warm sun is one of our most important helpers in life!
It relaxes people's limbs, makes everyone sleepy-sleepy, so they are too lazy to pick up their wallet on the floor!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Wanderers always live in today and don't think much about tomorrow, but I already plan my future—
I will live in a big house by the sea with all my friends!

Idle.Transcription: What?! No, Punji ... You really heard that? ... Oooh! Someone is going to be ripped off a fortune for this!

Greetings.Transcription: Ah-ha! Welcome to Kanjira's ... Whatever this is ... 10 rupees for a ticket ... Thank you!

Morning.Transcription:
Punji and Manka hunted a hare together, but they then fight over the brain for a whole night ...
*yawns* And I'm the only poor one didn't sleep!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Don't worry, Punji shows her toungue not to attack you, she just wants yummy food, like a rat or a frog.
Its skin will fall soon, you can keep the beautiful old skin.

Night.Transcription:
Can, emm, can you read this page for me?
The pictures don't make sense. I guess ... Emm, the words will help me a little.

Bond_Night.Transcription: Ah-ha! Found you ... Good, very good ... Everybody is here ... Things can't get any better.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: You like my hairband? Thank you. You can try it on too.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I use these hands to put food on the table —
like shuffling cards, doing coffee reading, and stea- ... taking coins.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Heh-heh, never doubt how quick a girl can move.
She can easily slip away under your nose even if she's wearing skirts.
