Hobby.Transcription:
This is how you enjoy a slice of old bread!
You just wipe off the phaphoondee (mould) on top ... Oh, remember! Use your finger, not the knife!
Always use the fingers if you value the food, or you will cut off too much ...

Praise.Transcription: Aah-ah ... it is very difficult to support a big family. I totally understand!

Intimacy.Transcription: This! Read this paper! ... Yes! From the page with rainbows and windmills ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I didn't understand why my parents left me in the village when they went out for work.
But as soon as I step on the gas of our caravan, I realized that although they are not here, they left me our home.
Vertin ... Do you remember the first time you opened the suitcase?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Matilda and I are neck and neck in Divination,
but you'd need more than that to make a living on the streets. I can really teach her a thing or two.

Monologue.Transcription:
Poverty is a deep deep trap where my people have been struggling uselessly for generations.
Nobody wants to be poor or homeless. But we have no choice but to accept it and keep moving forward.

Deployment.Transcription: Punji, we got a new job!

PreBattle.Transcription: Emm ... That'd cost you a little extra!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Em-hmm! I can see it clearly.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The star has moved. So will the mortal's fate.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: He-he, namaste, stupid heads!

Insight.Transcription: I've grown, right?!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Emm ... Sherjah will let me go further to other towns if I learned another 500 words!
Okay, did I get my name right ...?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Most star scryers won't read their own future.
We are supposed to remain philosophical about almost everything, either good or bad ...
But I broke the rule. Or say, I've seen it coming.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: I have to say, star scryers are all at the mercy of the weather ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
We focus so much on the linear time that it has become the criterion for "significance."
But time isn't always linear. It can be easily twisted and folded in a vaster space ...
Even so, when time is not the criterion anymore,
people are still obsessed with the "meaning" of everything they do.

Idle.Transcription:
I value the present day ...
No suspicious colleagues are around poking their noses into others' affairs, nor must I conceal my research direction.

Greetings.Transcription: Just time I expected. Be my guest, Timekeeper.

Morning.Transcription:
Departing at dawn, within half an hour after the first beam of sunlight appears in the sky,
you may see Mercury on the horizon if lucky enough.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: As for breakfast, Indian food tastes way better than the British.

Night.Transcription:
Masala papad is not a good snack for midnights.
Back in the days when studying in Banner University, I was tired of having nothing to eat but this to assuage my hunger ...
Yet after I left, the smell of it still lingers on, even till now.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Standing on an observatory platform,
I see the cold, dry wind; I see the tablelands far away, the celestial bodies above me ...
I was never alone.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
This is called Tilak.
Where I'm from, women apply Tilaks on their foreheads at a young age,
so the blessings of auspiciousness will be with them for a lifetime.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
It works in the same way as the Galileoscope. You can give it a go ... It's worth a try.
This showed me the entrance to the universe ... and showed people the Lunar Mare.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
A trench coat has higher practicability than a Sari.
When walking in the field, its heavy-duty fabric blocks the wind of the wild, and condensation on its smooth surface is easy to wipe off.
Don't forget the pockets—big enough to shovel three notes in.

Hobby.Transcription:
On the path of star scrying, I once had a mentor.
Our destinies were tangled together,
but she walked too fast and far ahead of me. Before I noticed, she had already gone lost from my sight.

Praise.Transcription:
Eventually, you will achieve what you wish ...
This isn't a prophecy read from the astrolabe, but my earnest thought.

Intimacy.Transcription:
The temperature and humidity are appropriate at a cloudless crescent night, while the telescope is fairly heavy ...
Heh ... I mean, moving it to the observatory is a two-woman job.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The days in London sometimes come back to my mind. The moist air smells like rock music and freedom—
But those things are too far from me, even further than the distance between me and the stars.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Wrestling ... is not my strength, but only an activity to balance my work and life.
When processing the data, the pain in my neck and lower back always reminds me to do some low-intensity exercise ...

Monologue.Transcription:
It is the complex hidden rules of human society that made me who I am and destroyed who I really was ...
But no matter what I have become, the night and the starry sky are always there for me, just like they're there for everyone else.

Deployment.Transcription: Hold your horses. I'm coming.

PreBattle.Transcription: I thought it was an academic debate.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Be faithful to the choice of fate.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Everything has its cause and effect.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: I've seen your struggle written in the stars.

Insight.Transcription: ... Your recognition is priceless.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
The sparkling Milky Way is around us. It's another Dīpa Festival.
Come, light the candles for blessings.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
The Mandelbrot set ...
That's right! It's just like the island! I'm a part of the set, just as I'm a part of the island.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Raindrops never actually fall!
They are motionless at the instants of time which constitute the falling process.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Everything in here and out there always leads to pure numbers and mathematics.
It's only a matter of time until I work out the equation which foretells the future ...
Hmm, the current assumption is ...

Greetings.Transcription:
You're back.
Of course you are, because this place is the "origin" ...

Morning.Transcription: Urrrrgh, I will not take another step closer to that table unless those brown bean juice drinkers leave first!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
No no, the scripture says, "Make the bed as soon as you wake up, leaving no imprint of your body" ...
Don't worry. Stay where you are. I'll do it for you!

Night.Transcription:
These people next door are really noisy. Could you please tell them to quiet down?
These "Romans" have disturbed my circles!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Thank you, Vertin. The rate at which you swing the suitcase is the same as that of the waves hitting the coast.
I had a very good sleep.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
What? You mean ... there's an orestias in my hair?
That can't be true ... Show me!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: People all over the world have adopted the decimal system by coincidence. See, this is why.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
That's right! This is my body, my little jar. It's made of flesh and bones.
We can temporarily entrust it with our well-proportioned geometric structures.

Hobby.Transcription:
Well ... I'm not very fond of the word "hobby."
It sounds like something you would give up easily, something that doesn't last.

Praise.Transcription:
You are making progress in life, Vertin, just like how zero developed throughout history.
At first it was just a placeholder,
then it became irreplaceable,
and now it serves as the origin of coordinates.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Check the answer for me ...
No way! This book is wrong ... My calculation says otherwise!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
See, here we have rectangular frames, rectangular cabinets, rectangular windows ...
Vertin, haven't you realized? This is a serious abuse of rectangles!
You should use more triangles in the suitcase, for they are the most stable structure.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I tried to talk to Ms. Centurion, but as soon as she tossed that coin, I felt dizzy and passed out.
It makes no sense, I mean, her luck completely overturns the probability theory ...

Monologue.Transcription:
The proof, once found, is irrevocable.
But sometimes, when I sit on the coast where my mother rests,
I can hear the waves wash against the edges of her geometric body,
which reminds me of her transient voice before she left the world of Matters.

Deployment.Transcription: And now, I belong to this set.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Welcome to the world of numbers.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Victory?
Okay, but what does it mean to us?
I mean, what does it prove?

Insight.Transcription: The next quadrant.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
The shape of truth is not fixed. Anyone who tries to figure it out is doomed to get lost on their way.
So I decide to draw the one I assume ... but just to get it out of my mind.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Greetings, Marcus here!
I've heard a lot about you from a ... special ... someone ...
Your collection is something I can't wait to get my hands on!
So here's my ID, employment certificate, transfer records, medical report, and ...
Huh? You don't need these?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Ah, the fog is rising. Excuse me, I have to light up the lighthouse.
You know what they say: a man loses his footing on moss, and a ship loses its bearings in fog.

To_the_Future.Transcription: Choices, choices, more choices.

Idle.Transcription: Mmm ... Hmm ... Ah! I-I wasn't sleeping!

Greetings.Transcription:
Please watch your step! Books are everywhere,
and if you step on them ... that hurts me ...

Morning.Transcription:
When was the last time I ate breakfast with this many people?
Ah yes, I remember the days of black bread on the verge of going moldy.
I'm glad those days are long behind me.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I had a dream last night.
The world had vanished, only a staircase remained in front of me.
No matter how much I climbed, no end was in sight. The one good thing about the dream, though,
was the talking Sachertorte encouraging me along the way. Hmm. Can we really call this one a nightmare?

Night.Transcription:
Hah. I'm neither in Romania nor on the Flannan Isles, but in a suitcase ...
Never would I have imagined I'd live in such a big and comfy ... suitcase ...
Is this what the life of a book is like?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Thanks for lighting up the lantern for me. Is it this time of the day already?
Ow, my neck …

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Um? A-are you wiping your hands? On my face ...?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Don't worry, Timekeeper. These are old marks, carrying precious memories.
Each mark proves I protected someone in time of need. I take comfort in that.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I bought this case in Bucharest.
Stylish, durable, and holds a lot.
Is it heavy for me? Hmm ... It used to be, but not anymore.

Hobby.Transcription:
The world overwhelms me.
"Reading" quiets the world, turns it into a book,
and helps me understand it word by word.
I am no longer afraid, and I no longer overlook the details.

Praise.Transcription:
She gave weight to the word "teacher,"
and you gave meaning to the word "ally."
I ... admire your courage in taking on the "Storm."

Intimacy.Transcription:
Books are simple, unlike people.
Even a smile can have different meanings.
Like the look on your face right now, what does it mean?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
A popular detective story, interesting.
According to this, James Harvey and I could be the same person,
because we've never shown up together at the same time.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Some endings are not the finale, but a brief farewell.
I will continue to read and write as I used to,
until the day I look back and see a whole new chapter.

Monologue.Transcription:
New books are always thicker after being read.
The extra thickness is probably the growth of knowledge and the mind taking flight.

Deployment.Transcription: Oh, were you looking for me? Here I am!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Mm … And now it's easier to understand!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Reading complete! Was I helpful, Timekeeper ...?

Insight.Transcription: Yes! A brand new chapter for me!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Oh, thank you! I will double my efforts!
I'll even double the size of my case!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Ladies and gentlemen, before you stands the great-artist-to-be,
the voice of peace, the adversary of banality and violence. I give you -- Diggers!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Oh no! My art in Hyde Park is gonna be nothing but splashes of paint ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
In the sky with diamonds, on the grass in green garments.
I would lie on the grass, among the dew, listening to the kids running around and playing ...
Some of the people would be singing, some playing guitar.

Idle.Transcription:
Simply looking, no touching ...
if you do this, you will — Atishoo!
Phew, good, just an improvised show that nobody noticed.

Greetings.Transcription: ... What do you wanna hear? We've got plenty of time together.

Morning.Transcription:
We should be anti morning, anti sleep deprivation, anti clocks, anti morning alarm!
This is vandalism of art ... and its artists!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
The creator of arts would work regardless of day and night, but the enforcer of laws would come to work in the day.
Now, friend, take these paints and fireworks and run. I'll go east, you west.

Night.Transcription:
Hello, my old friend darkness.
At night, ideas and words would grow from the silent streets, blown by the wind from one person to another.
Faces of the young wander far into the night, and I walk among them.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Go on, keep on trucking! To the countryside, to hitchhike, to sit behind a farmer's wagon;
and talk about life, philosophy, and arts.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: I always shave my face at the fountain in the park. That's where you find a mirror.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Yes, put out your middle finger and the index finger, palm outward, like this!
... Congrats, my friend, you have peace in your hand.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
What are the Reflective Bubbles for, you ask?
For the new-born arts being ignored and underestimated,
for the fact that people bustle past, not even willing to stop and appreciate them!

Hobby.Transcription:
The dawn of the new world is about to pierce the night, the power of imagination is taking over.
We will reinvent the world; and for that day to come, I shall march, march, and march!

Praise.Transcription:
Oh, I can see it on you.
Though you always keep that stern look on your face, I see the sparkles of rebellion.

Intimacy.Transcription:
My dear, dear friend, can you take these fireworks to the Big Ben first?
Don't worry, I will be with you shortly after getting these crackers ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The vision of men and women has been blinded for too long!
They succumbed to the vulgar circumstances, and I will bring them back into the arms of life with dreams.
No no, this one is too small.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
When you walk on the streets in London, be careful of those lip-pressing, hat-wearing, emotionless passers-by.
They are stuffy, stupid, lack of imagination and aesthet- ...
Oops, no offence.

Monologue.Transcription:
Here pause: these graves are all too young as yet ...
From the world's bitter wind Seek shelter in the shadow of the tomb.
What Adonais is, why fear we to become?
... Here witness: the white butterfly on the lawn, What a rare view we stumbled upon.

Deployment.Transcription: Oh, this is groovy! Let's get on the road.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: What is the road you have taken, my man?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Bubbles reflect like mirrors, my friend.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Of course, peace needs to be made to happen.

Insight.Transcription: I hear it—the revelation of Muse ...

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
A bright summer day.
We once had days like this, and we will have more in the future.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
(You smell like a friend.)
(Before you pat me on the head,)
(could you please try and tell me, does every species have the same kind of soul?)
"Instead of a pat on the head, the puppy prefers a handshake like a friend."

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: (We don't get to see such nice weather often ... The rain separates everyone, while the river outside the window flows upstream.)

To_the_Future.Transcription: (An everlasting space where there is no disc or globe but eternal time, can you imagine that?)

Idle.Transcription: The puppy expressed his lasting loneliness. He may require some adequate physical reassurance.

Greetings.Transcription: The puppy is delighted by your visit. He is about ...

Morning.Transcription: (I am going to have breakfast in my room. Please allow me to spend the moment alone.)

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
(Two Kenkel's crackers and a bowl of canned short ribs ... )
(It is highly possible that their offer will result in the corruption of a puppy warrior's independent will. )
(Of course they also work on a puppy philosopher's.)

Night.Transcription:
(This is the time when most people open their hearts to each other, so is for puppies ...)
(I have heard Wendy's soulful confession over 30 times and sometimes, to be honest, I'm envious of her straightforwardness.)

Bond_Night.Transcription: The puppy assures you that he will be by your side throughout the night, and suggests reading ...

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: (... Relax your fingers, go down, down, down ...)

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
(Thank you for your kind greeting, and remember to wash your hand. I just stepped on something you may find unpleasant.)
"The puppy would like to keep that smell a secret."

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: (I do lose hair regularly. I'm very sorry about your floor.)

Hobby.Transcription:
(Doggie is way too warmhearted and acute in most of the time ...)
(Its battery is unbelievably long-lasting.)

Praise.Transcription:
(I thought a space of my own and plenty of time to spend alone were just a dream ...)
(But that dream has come true. Everything is so different and amazing here.)

Intimacy.Transcription:
(I'm not a neat freak, but could you clean my body with a modest amount of water?)
( I will control it when I shake.)

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
(Never thought there would be so many unusual characters here, even the word "special" feels different now.)
"The puppy hopes your friendship lasts forever, no matter if he's the unique friend or not among the special friends of yours."

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
(I tried to find inner peace,)
(but now it turns out to be a boomerang game: the best way to get it is to wait.)

Monologue.Transcription:
(I was once stuck with nihilism after a certain setback. )
(I thought life no longer had any meaning, but then a ball fell down the stairs and I was, enlightened.)
(I didn't want it to reach me, so I need to keep running forward, whatever it takes.)

Deployment.Transcription: (No better canine for the position?)

PreBattle.Transcription: The puppy wishes to come along.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: The puppy agreed with your decision.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: (On top of the ladder of progress, there stands a dog interwined in happiness and pain.)

Attacked_II.Transcription: (Please put me through to the Animal Protection Society ...)

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Warning! Warning! The puppy is fleeing the scene at its maximum speed.

Insight.Transcription: (This may be too much for a puppy, but is just fine for an arcanist.)

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: (Sometimes things go wrong, even in a puppy's life ... Smile, hand shake, next.)

First_Encounter.Transcription:
An unexpected encounter ... A room, a frame, and an old TV ...
I need some time to figure out the situation here, approximately 12 minutes and 31 seconds ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: ... The weather today is too normal. On such a wonderful day, I can't sniff out any traces of incidents.

To_the_Future.Transcription: The content of Guidance on Security will be enriched. I am also glad to contribute to the revision.

Idle.Transcription:
... Ms. Acey, did you again replace my Bearnaise sauce and Sauce Velouté with Cheddar ...
Those are the specialties I went all the way to get!
[They tasted awful.]

Greetings.Transcription:
Hmm? Can I help you ...
Sorry, your visit was not on my plan so I am feeling a bit nervous ...

Morning.Transcription:
Newspapers and TV channels would never miss out on any possible breaking news. So ...
what we need is a seemingly authentic statement. Then the journalists amassing over will drive those security companies crazy.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Good, good ...
This is exactly the same as I planned—I get up, enjoy breakfast, and have you sitting on my right-hand side.
It's going to be a wonderful day.

Night.Transcription:
It was a normal night, I "paid a visit" to the legendary Foundation,
even though I wasn't invited ...
Frankly, their security traps are quite uniquely designed.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I think I need more coffee to stay awake and be better inspired ... to take on my ... final assignment.
... Professor Claire or Ms. Acey, which one of them is more dreadful ...

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Well done. Please keep on.
... Aren't you going to say that?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Ms. Acey barely talks. In silence she supports me, or poses challenges ...
Unfortunately, the latter is more common.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
People are always surprised at my identity as a thief ...
Why? Is there a book providing them with a definition of what a thief should look like?

Hobby.Transcription:
It's not that I have to steal something ...
For me, thievery is like solving a puzzle or proving a conjecture of security. They are always there waiting for me.

Praise.Transcription:
Full mark ...
Ahem, this is not a rate given by Ms. Acey, but by me.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Excuse me ... May I have a look at the gem on your neckband?
Yeah, yeah, just taking a look at it ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Father was fond of collecting photos of himself and the assets entrusted to him for safekeeping.
Those photos would always hit the headlines.
He stayed high-profile and was such an idealist that made other people around him looked superficial and profit-hungry ...
One after another, his peers and friends left him. Eventually, no one was there for him.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Dealing with journalists is not my forte.
They always raise harsh questions and bring about suffocating topics, like my dissertation, my future plans, or my ambitions.
Although I am good at making plans, these are too far away to think of ...

Monologue.Transcription:
Vengeance is not doing justice, and I wanted nothing but to sort out the mysteries.
Father died for his broken dream ...
But it's going be fine now, for I can see his dream is reliving in me.

Deployment.Transcription: Wait, give me ten more minutes ...

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Time waits for no one, even for a great thief.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
That went smooth.
[Exactly.]

Insight.Transcription: Did you See that! The story of Ramirez continues.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Next, next, next. Show me the next question.

First_Encounter.Transcription: Hey, the "great" Vertin! Nice to see you again!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Downpour and thick clouds ... we are trapped in this haunted castle.
Suddenly, someone knocks at the door. Knock, knock ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Future, future, hmm ... Our future slides back to the past. What else would be impossible then?
Perhaps that blondie would accept an award on the stage of any film festival,
or the lame horror novels written by my grandpa would win the Nobel Prize in Literature,
haha ... I mean, you can always expect the unexpected, my friends!

Idle.Transcription:
Great, it's high time. They are not here; only me. Play some horror music.
Soon, the bloody tsunami will rush to me. Those suspects in helmets will call my name ...

Greetings.Transcription: ... I have to remind you that jump scares are really outdated.

Morning.Transcription:
Years later, I think I have obtained some techniques to balance the tasks and a taste of art ...
Yes, the secret lies in the brilliance of caffeine.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: You should try your breakfast with bloody horror movies. That will definitely be a stimulating appetizer.

Night.Transcription:
Fine. I've always considered "The Man in the Frame" to be a conventional horror story.
But when I myself stay in a frame ... I finally realized it's really horrific.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Hey, come over here. Yeah! You must be good at this ...
What should I sneak out and eat for the night ...
Haven't you furtively eaten hash browns in bed?
You are "that Vertin"! Come on, I don't buy it!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Hey! Be careful! This is not a pair of normal glasses ...
This is the limited edition sold during the premiere of 
X Ray Monkey Man
!
The groove design inside is quite distinctive ...
Anyway, as a fans-oriented souvenir, it is fantastic!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
High five? Handshake? Or ...
Oh, good, it's a document for approval.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Hey! We made a consensus⁠—never attack from the back!
Oh ... al-alright, ok, I get it.
I will pay attention to my crooked back. Just ... be gentle next time.

Hobby.Transcription:
Horror is not scary. It's more like ...
an unexecuted punishment, a pending cause of death, and a confusing puzzle.
It is like the panic when you find there's only a half piece of tissue and a tiny piece of banana peel in the tissue box after you defecate ...
Do you get it?

Praise.Transcription:
No matter what you do, you'll always succeed.
Like no matter what resistance my bullets encountered, they would eventually shoot into the enemy's head.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Could you grant me another leave for a day?
I have a friend at Laplace ...
Yeah, I need to help him with his little experiment.
Don't worry. We will grab you a sample product if we succeed!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The twins living next door are really good at role play. It's rare to see such skillful actresses like them ...
They are not acting?! Oh ... I think I should change rooms.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Usually in a horror movie, blondies are depicted as a sacred figure or a cheesy one.
They can be an angel, or a fool.
You know, the virtual world is really judgmental.
When we fall into it, our face will automatically fit into a certain mold, and then we will become someone else.

Monologue.Transcription:
We all experienced the past where we were denied, distressed, and lost.
That beautiful building, the white cradle, cut off all the "inconsistent" parts from us, in order to shape us into a "better" self ...
All in all, I am relieved that I am still me, and you are still you.

Deployment.Transcription: The nerdy nerd, checking in!

PreBattle.Transcription: Logic leads the path to victory!

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Wow, this is an antagonist action ...

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Time to show you my card!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription:
Left, then right ...
which one comes first?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Let's fully relax, and relish all of these!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Nice ending. An 8.5 from me!

Insight.Transcription: Woo-hoo! That's great! Now I can pay the balance of my limited-edition Morrison the Killer's bust.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Delicious luncheon, nicely chosen movie, the most relaxing gun maintenance ...
Those childhood evenings when I couldn't fall asleep ... I hid books under my cushion.
I never expected such a promising future!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
This is where the arcanists live?
To be fair, not a bad taste, but ... the place needs a touch of bright colors.
Do you mind me changing the curtains?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Aah! I hate rainy days. No parties, no outings, only getting stuck with these morons to play some board games.
Alright, take a card.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
People once loved disco, then hated it, then killed it. And now they resurrected it in the Electropop ...
Everything can happen in the future, dear.

Idle.Transcription: Where's the lie? The party was very successful, even the host has sneaked away.

Greetings.Transcription: ... You'd better really have something ... important to say.

Morning.Transcription:
Always having skimmed milk and cereals for breakfast.
Or, do you think you can get slim by a poke of the needle like the balloon?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Huuhh! Breakfast first, then some shopping in the mall ...
Then I gotta take Jessica to the park for a Pets' Day out in the afternoon.
After that, we are driving to the beach to have a nighttime barbecue. Oh, oh. I also need to take a few shots of Jessica for my movie ...
Hurry up, the day is insanely packed!

Night.Transcription:
This assignment has ruined my nightlife.
Are you here to show sympathy? Then will you write the essay for me?

Bond_Night.Transcription: Buy a disco ball and put on your best clothes. I'm gonna show you how to dance!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Do you see anything different on me today?
... Humph! I have my hair made. You have no idea how to appreciate the beauty.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Interesting! It's been a while since I last met someone who would start with holding hands.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Ahem! ... This is just a random, boring doll. I bought it just to match my clothes.
Who cares if it's expensive or a limited edition ... Dad will pay for it anyway.

Hobby.Transcription:
I like ...
Wh-what a boring question this is? Why do I have to answer it?

Praise.Transcription:
Maybe it's not so bad to join your little club.
Ha! You are much funnier than those dorks in college.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Yes, I know I have quick mood swings, lack of vision, and I'm self-centered, frivolous, and fickle ...
But, this is who I am. You should learn to bear with me.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
You always seem so certain of your life ...
What a bo- ... boring life to live like this!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Sweetheart ... Is she a movie star?
She is definitely blessed by the god of fashion. Ha! I have to find a way to talk to her ...

Monologue.Transcription:
Is it true that humans and arcanists cannot live in harmony?
We have so many things in common to share and enjoy, like the movies.
As I learned about humans from the movies, so can humans learn about arcanists ...
It's just that no one has made such a movie yet.

Deployment.Transcription: Fine, genius, whatever.

PreBattle.Transcription: Ahe, fine. I'll give it a try ...

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Can't be bothered to sweat it.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Watch out. This is a special performance.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Pink always looks good on me.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription:
They come out of thin air, they are hideous and evil ...
They ... are my friends.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Alright, the party's over ...
Thank you for cleaning up the room and washing those mugs and glasses.
I have another round to catch.

Insight.Transcription: Aah ... a perfect spa! Keep the change.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Hmm ... I should make some adjustments to perfect the design ...
Just like ... this?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Today is gloomy and somber enough as it is, don't let the cloud hang over you.
Take a look at this, it may cheer you up.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
When the mirror was shattered, I broke off and lay scattered at where I am now.
I shall travel through days and nights to seek the truth, to return to where I was born.
Oh, wait. There is no such era of truth. That's right. No era is true ...

Idle.Transcription:
Em ... no one is here.
Standing still, eyes on the target, start spinning ...
Ahem, "the dart is going straight onto the bull's-eye!"

Greetings.Transcription:
Hello, curious explorer.
I hope what reflects in the mirror would bring you joy.

Morning.Transcription:
Morning used to be the time when I had to keep a low profile.
Spoke no words and took no actions, just to be good at being a mirror.
But now, I'm merely a fragment of what I used to be.
You see, I was lucky to be freed from the life-long duty to reflect others' images.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
The tides coming to the shore,
Carbuncles in the woods opening their sleepy eyes,
or the first light of morning shedding on a city avenue ...
Which one of the sceneries better brightens your mood while you enjoy your breakfast?

Night.Transcription:
A floating UFO lamp, a radio unwilling to talk, a wooden horse comes from a great bloodline ...
they are all real, living on the other side of the mirror, at somewhere under this sky.
They are so lively, so honest and benign.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Try ending your long day with a milk bath and clearing your mind in the tub.
I promise, you will wake up feeling in top form in the next day.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I can feel your eyes.
Now, if you give off a smile, you'd find yourself being smiled at too.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Oh, please be very, very careful. I don't wish to see more of the unnecessary bloodshed on any scale.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: While you gaze your reflection in me, I gaze back and see my own reflection in your eyes.

Hobby.Transcription:
All these frames in the world!
Although they don't belong to me, I'm deeply enchanted by their caring nature, or say, their carrying nature.

Praise.Transcription:
Mirror, mirror, who is the most exceptional one of all?
"Oh, this person is, right before me. Behold, the reflection of the embodiment of virtues and manners."

Intimacy.Transcription:
It's my pleasure to reflect your look day and night, when you are resting and working.
The companionship goes both ways.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Sorry to bother you with this, but please attach this piece of note to my back.
Yes—it says "no entry."
I have to find a way to stop those fanatics from getting passed through me to that "world in the mirror."

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Yes, please decorate me with the things you like.
I think I can handle different colors, glittering ribbons, or some scorchingly warm lightbulbs.
Having them around me would smooth my sharp edges and thaw my coldness, and give me a touch of warmth and festivity.

Monologue.Transcription: A sophisticated mirror would know what can be reflected and what cannot.

Deployment.Transcription: Oh, are we fighting ... balloons?

PreBattle.Transcription: My enemy is fighting their enemy's enemy.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: This is poetic, don't you think?

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Wholeness is only a matter on the surface.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: I see—a million suns!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: They have witnessed their failure with their own eyes ... though it was too cruel to be my intention.

Insight.Transcription: The view in the mirror has become the reality ... or it seems that way.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Welcome to sail with us!
Well, now, go to the back of the ship and make it move! Don't be dawdling!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Ahem! Before I get sunburnt, I should go to the Viking's Bar and drink with Old Andy ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
One day, I shall make the Stillwater Lake School my territory!
Jack, that tattletale, will be flushing the toilet,
and Mr Williams of the Viking Club will be my first mate ...

Idle.Transcription: Hey, heeeey? Where are all the people? Erick the Fearless is not afraid of standing alone ...

Greetings.Transcription:
Squat down when you are before me.
Do not make me look up. That's so very disrespectful to a Lord!

Morning.Transcription: Keep your eyes open and get it together! Valhalla does not welcome sleepy heads.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Oh, shoot! The homework! My homework ...
I haven't written anything yet!

Night.Transcription: I'm going to bed now. Any raiding plans can wait till tomorrow ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Gather around, brothers and sisters!
Let me tell you the legend of my mother Lagertha who defeated two bears on her own ...

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I've taken an oath ...
Until the day my longship sets sail to the sea, I will never, ever get my hair cut.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Don't touch me!
Unless you are going to pull me up from the cliff, or, take me to the Ocean Funland ...

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Like what you see? Worry not, you will also be rewarded with these if you stay long enough in the fleet!

Hobby.Transcription:
I've only seen her in the photos. Harald said she has Thor's courage and Sif's charm.
She must be the most beautiful Valkyrie in Valhalla.

Praise.Transcription:
Your courage impressed me.
I will appoint you to be my helmsman, and put you in command of that open space in the park!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Tomorrow is "Best Friends Day" at school.
Now that I have given you my invitation, you are not allowed to present as another's friend!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
That Sonetto girl, I heard that she's a skald ...
I happen to need someone to sing my legends across the lands ...
Hmph, no one can turn down a full box of Twizzlers!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Old John wants to put that arm ring on me, so that I will become a little girl who needs his protection!
But I will not! I will become a warrior like my mother.

Monologue.Transcription:
My mother is the strongest and most beautiful Valkyrie,
and I am the strongest and bravest Viking across all the lands and seas.
When my day comes, she will ride across the sky in her finest armor, taking me to sup in Odin's great hall ...

Deployment.Transcription: Ready to show them a good fight?

PreBattle.Transcription: Suffer the loss, or suffer the notch!

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: The axe told me it's ready!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Hoist the sails! We will not be stopped!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The rage of the sea will claim you! Like ... the anger of a teacher!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: As they fell, Lord Erick embarks on her legendary journey!

Insight.Transcription: Thank you for paying the tribute! Lord Erick will promise you more lands and wealth!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Riding the winds and waves, Lord Erick is setting out for her great journey!
... If you need the loo, go now.

First_Encounter.Transcription: It's my pleasure to meet you, my fellow.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Those insane people screamed and rushed out of the guardroom.
They kept meaninglessly and repeatedly roaring. Then, their blood shed on the snowy ground.
I've seen that a lot.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Just like Homo sapiens wiped out Neanderthals, arcanists will be eliminated as well.
This is not a prediction, but a predestined fate.

Idle.Transcription:
Where's the soap? I need to wash my hands ...
No, before that, I need to make sure the door is locked.

Greetings.Transcription: Oh, it's our "genius." Any insane new ideas?

Morning.Transcription: Thank you. I've already planned for my breakfast.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Too many arcanists here, weirdos as well.
Damn it ...
You'd better prepare me a room where I won't be disturbed.
Last time the girl doing the potion experiments made everywhere so dusty I could barely clean myself.

Night.Transcription: Good evening. Good night.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
It's very quiet out there. The door is securely locked. At night, the river whispers outside the window.
I must extend my gratitude since you prepared such a perfect room for me.
Also thanks for your suitcase. That's all, that's it.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Thanks to it, we are all freaks now.
Haven't you ever blamed your brain? Haven't you for once vomited due to the sound or whisper in your brain?
How naive and ignorant.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Compared to the incurable anxiety, these wounds are minor.
Oh, watch your distance.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Press the button, achieve the function.
Humans are like machinery, simple and efficient.
Arcanists are quite the opposite.

Hobby.Transcription: What you see is the alignment and tidiness. What I adore is this orderly state.

Praise.Transcription:
As an arcanist, your performance really amazes me.
Wish you were a pure blood human.

Intimacy.Transcription: Could you please get your buttons right? The patterns aren't aligned.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Nearly all the arcanists I met were insane.
Only a few appeared to be normal. They just haven't lost the sanity yet.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I can only stand those arcanists from the Foundation and the Laplace.
After all, their insanity is contained by humans.

Monologue.Transcription:
That's it, that's it, enough ...
Stop crying, stop, and don't laugh. Don't be insane.
I am fed up watching or hearing you. Leave me alone for a while!
Just a while! Stay away from me!

Deployment.Transcription: Great, a mission with a bunch of arcanists.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Relax. It's a treatment with a higher dose.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Let's call it a day. I need a deep cleaning.

Insight.Transcription: For the Mesmers, such achievement is effortless.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Good news: I can better ease franticity.
Bad news: I am more frantic.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hello, dear friend. From now on, we can be together all the time.
I thought of many things we can do. Firstly ...
let's roll in the grass!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
When the sun was out, I would bathe in the lake and enjoy a nap on the shore,
until my fur was warm and dry beneath the sunlight ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
There is a place, far away from here, and it's grander, more wonderful than all places⁠—
place where I can see the stars twinkling in the sky and snakes dancing in the grass,
as well as other things you've talked about and things I've always wanted to see. These beautiful things.

Idle.Transcription:
97, 98, 99 ... 100!
I'm coming for you ...

Greetings.Transcription: I'm so glad we meet again. When you were gone, I collected every hair of yours and put them in that drawer ...

Morning.Transcription:
In the morning, the sun would pierce through the fog, then float across the tops of the trees and mountains ...
I bet it tastes like a raw egg ...!

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Your bed feels even softer than my haystack. Can I ... crawl in and join you?

Night.Transcription:
My friends are here. Do you want to meet them?
Shh ... Look! Over there behind the curtain. Can you see his feet?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Do you prefer demons or ghosts? Or the man with a chainsaw?
I have to figure out what your favorite monster is, so that I can better surprise you under your bed!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Every time I took that "medicine," I could hear a soft, light whistling melody...
Whistling? Hmm? What is "whistling"?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: My hands in your hands, friendship never ends! You can take me to any places you go!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
This is my "ring" ... Look how snug and lovely it is!
It embraces me, securing me to my clothes and to the bed ...
Maybe we could use a ring like this to stay together.

Hobby.Transcription: In that dream ... that strange dream, the grassy meadows are waiting for me, and I can hear the joyful whistle of the wind ...

Praise.Transcription:
Raise your left hoof! Then your right hoof! Well done!
Now, just like in the training⁠—jump up, and roooar!

Intimacy.Transcription:
When I was "Anne," I spoke as gently as possible, like this ...
Slow down, hold in the chuckles, and resist the urge to give those annoying people a good kick ...
That was difficult, but I did it!
You should say something nice to me, like those people in white do!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I saw them put a leash on that puppy. Are you going to do the same thing to me?
It's okay. I will be fine with it. As long as we are together, it doesn't matter who is on which end of the leash ...

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There's a special scent on you. It ... it ... smells like honey!
Or Iris, or a crushed ladybug. I like it!

Monologue.Transcription:
Why do my friends always have "more important things" to do?
We ought to cut those unwanted "shots" from our lives, keeping the takes which record our best and sweetest moments.

Deployment.Transcription: A forest party!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Oh, don't worry! I have prepared it all. I ... have prepared it all.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Come on! Stand up! There's one more round!

Insight.Transcription: Oh, thank you for grooming me. It's so very nice ... I wish you could experience it someday!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I'm ready⁠—ready to tell everyone my name, ready to make them scream and cry ...
Will they like me in the same way as I like them?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hi, I am Sputnik-1's ... twin sister.
No, no, no, I don't know her.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Such weather is not suitable for a rocket launch. Fortunately, I haven't planned for one today.
Ugh, another day back to work.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
First make a small goal of increasing my deposit to a favorable amount,
and then think about where to purchase the materials.
The materials for outer shell must be carefully selected.

Idle.Transcription: Even now, the continuous electric wave never ceases.

Morning.Transcription: I can of course be the maid to serve you breakfast, as long as ... I am fairly paid.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
If it's alright, please take the serviette and gently wipe ...
Yeah, right here! Thank you so very much.

Night.Transcription: The moon, the stars, eventually, I will be among them ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
For any satellites, night and day would have made no difference.
But for me, a night like this allows you to see me in the sky.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Bright but not too dazzling, I think orange suits me really well.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Sorry, I haven't received your signal yet. Please be patient.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
What a beautiful blue planet. It is so fascinating, so stunningly charming. I once saw it ...
I mean I once saw the picture of such scenery from "elsewhere."

Hobby.Transcription:
I need more money, more money!
I might sound shallow and greedy, but it will enable us, all of us,
to be in a better place.

Praise.Transcription:
You shine luminously and gloriously, it is even visible from space.
You have my word.

Intimacy.Transcription:
In the very, very, very distant future, I will leave this place.
I swear I will miss you. Please remember me.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
How about Explorer-3?
Oh, I have to say he looked brilliant.
But compared to Phobos-1, he's just like an ... immature little boy.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
DUU-DUU-BELL-BOO from the other side of the atmosphere,
is so special and unique that I almost know nothing about it. What a negligence!

Monologue.Transcription:
Oh, alright, it's nothing miraculous. The birth of new life comes unexpectedly.
I just suddenly learnt how to hear, speak and think.
Therefore, I was derailed from the scheduled track and started to embrace my "life."

Deployment.Transcription: A nice job.

PreBattle.Transcription: According to the NDA, we must wipe out all witnesses.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Final check complete. Start the countdown.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Three, two, one, launch!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: It's over. Hopefully the victory won't make me more recognizable.

Insight.Transcription: My travel fund is growing steadily. Thank you very much for your support.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Congratulations. You are about to unveil the truth of this world.
Welcome to Headonion, a show to reshape your conception.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Last time it rained like this, we spotted an unidentified flying object commit the theft of a cow.
We are now still tracing any possible signs left by it.
Our show, Headonion would like to remind all our farm owners. Please watch out for the thief from above.
Do not leave your cows, cats, and shepherd dogs unattended!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future? It's gloomy.
A running mansion, artificial aurora, mass-manufactured circuit men ...
Ahhh, the world is doomed to drown in chaos.

Idle.Transcription:
Now to our news exclusive!
This nothing-special suitcase here,
stores a sumptuous apartment with all the necessary home appliances.
It will soon become the trend of future accommodation, but also the nightmare for all real estate developers.
Please follow me, let's enjoy the room tour to the attic.

Greetings.Transcription:
Please welcome our mysterious guest ...
Oops, my bad. Just an occupational habit.

Morning.Transcription:
Such a bright morning.
Today, somewhere over there, the mysterious and indescribable incidents are still in occurrence.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
People have been fed up with those boring news headlines.
Or, are they just satisfied with the world they are living in?

Night.Transcription:
It's late, but I am about to prepare for tomorrow's broadcast.
I won't go to bed, nor will I take off my headgear.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Headonion will present you the latest news for tonight.
The US Congress plans to impose restrictions on TV exercise programs outside working hours,
due to the recent sightings of the Capitol going hiking at midnight.
It is estimated that the mansion will arrive in Memphis, Tennessee in no time.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
This is not a made up newspaper, but an onion headgear as my disguise.
The denotation is to delve into mystery one layer at a time to eventually find the truth.
For your information, it is not waterproof so please be cautious.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I have touched that glittering skyscraper.
Exactly the same as I reported.
It was covered in scales and a stinky smell of marine algae emanated from it.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
A charming gentleman in a suit, this is how I present myself in my show.
Just like this crazy world, what people see ...
is only the products created and refined by those behind the scenes.

Hobby.Transcription:
Who said I love eating onion? Was he insane?!
ONiON is my pen name, a pen name! It's just a name!
Damn I hate onion, ewwwww!

Praise.Transcription:
You've offered me something precious: trust and understanding.
That's what I really need now.

Intimacy.Transcription:
My onion headgear is easily worn out so I will prepare several more.
Come on, let me show you how to make one.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Apart from being sharp, you also must be fast,
to run ahead of the unexpected and to escape the dangers.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
New treatment to patients suffering from blood circuitization has been found.
It is now been put on the hospital's agenda to seek cooperation with power plants,
"Aurora may be the work of some graffiti extremists,
as some members of the sperm whale family alleged they had found the aerosol cans for special paints" ...
All these are strictly prohibited by our station manager but someday I will definitely ...

Monologue.Transcription:
To accept only the "truth" is to miss the truth.
Sadly, few people understand this.

Deployment.Transcription: I am in. I have seen so many precious materials.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Let's get straight to the point!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Ladies and gentlemen, please be ready, to witness the real world!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: What takes place in our real world, is far more absurd than what you see on my show.

Insight.Transcription:
Peel off one layer of the onion, inside it's still onion.
Put on your glasses, watch out for the pain in your eyes and the burst of tears!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hello, I think we have been acquainted.
... I am responsible for your teeth, every night you fall asleep.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: The soil has become crumbly, aerated, suitable for plantation, and conducive for the dry body to regenerate.

To_the_Future.Transcription: Heading towards the future means growing up, means teeth falling, and ... new life.

Idle.Transcription:
Everyone here gnashes their teeth and covers their mouths with their hands.
Humph! Come on, today is not a revenge day.

Greetings.Transcription: Stop talking. It's time for a checkup ... Please open your mouth.

Morning.Transcription:
Toothpaste or tooth powder will make your teeth glowing and healthy.
Mint makes your teeth courageous, fearless, and never escape from the gum.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Harvest last night brings a big breakfast delight.

Night.Transcription:
Kids in early childhood are hyperactive at night. They are energetic and have mood swings ...
Their demand for bedtime stories is a bottomless pit. So I always prepare songs for them.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Please! Have a sweet dream.
"Mary had a little lamb, little lamb, little lamb ..."

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I have seen those toothfairies flying in the air with their hair dancing freely.
Inside their gold-string pockets lie the fragile baby teeth collected from the kids.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You need to act swiftly and gently, firmly and precisely, to grab hold of their neck, wings, or the back.
Don't hurt their abdomen and ankles. Like this ...

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: The color is flexible. My black overcoat helps expose every single pathogenic tooth.

Hobby.Transcription:
Green anaconda, wolf, shark ... Animal teeth really surprise me. I have collected a lot,
but only the baby teeth of kids would amaze me.
Those teeth are soft, delicate, and irreplaceable.

Praise.Transcription: Well done. Here is a toffee for you.

Intimacy.Transcription: Your baby teeth. Twenty in total. They're all here.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
My family and I walked among humans and arcanists.
We gain possessions, status, and decent life.
But at the same time, we lose friends, belongingness, and recognition by society.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I remember you, Ms. Vertin.
When you were still a student, when I was the dentist there, you always visited the clinic.
All those headaches you had were faked, but the wounds and bruises were real.
I think your frequent visits were for the comforting candies, weren't they?
Because you always smiled when you received the toffees.

Deployment.Transcription: I'm here for a worn tooth.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: I smell the scent of mint oil.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: A-tishoo, a-tishoo. We all fall down.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: They are much naughtier than the Foundation's kids.

Insight.Transcription: I owe you a debt of gratitude. I am one more step closer to my dream.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Sleep, sleep in peace. This is a sweet, sweet night ...

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Oh, it's very nice to meet you.
This room is very classy,
yet it can use a bit of warmth to its perfection.
I think I can offer you a solution.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The Cactus Cat will enjoy a sunny day like this.
On the contrary, Carbuncles prefer cloudy weather.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Future, what an intriguing topic.
It's about new things being born and old things dying.
I'm curious about everything in the future, and I will take my shot.

Idle.Transcription:
Instead of words, I'm always expecting eye contact.
It feels good even if we don't say a word, doesn't it?

Greetings.Transcription: No matter business or bonding, you're always welcome.

Morning.Transcription:
Starting my morning with a warm cup of black tea.
This is one of the few habits I have from my family.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
I'm preparing breakfast for these little things. Could you please give me a hand?
Thank you very much.

Night.Transcription: Good evening, dear. Glad to see that everything is going well with you.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Dear, are you worried about some uninvited guests disturbing the suitcase?
Loretta, Dwayne, guard the door.
We'll have a great evening. I promise.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Looking tidy is an important step in building trust.
Before selling something, we always have to sell ourselves.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Don't waste your strength in wrestling with the critters.
The leash in your hand is not for curbing them, but understanding them.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Heh heh, clothes make the woman, don't they?

Hobby.Transcription:
Gentle, loyal, and kind ...
They are more than my career, they are a part of my life.

Praise.Transcription:
Good girl ...
Oh, I'm so sorry. Habits are hard to break.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Imagine, the news of Miss Vertin's Appearance at the NewBabel Pet Tour.
How will this surprise the eagle-eyed journalists and indecisive families?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Squonks are the most difficult to catch, tame, and keep.
These shy and timid little creatures will turn into a cloud of tears if they are just slightly spooked.
But they are good companions to the traumatized and quiet children, for they understand each other.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Stress stress stress ...
Teakettler needs more anecdotal stories to get people's attention.

Monologue.Transcription:
I haven't doubted my success in the future for even a second.
NewBabel will change the world.

Deployment.Transcription: Excuse me ... Sorry, a bit crowded here.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: These glowing lights ... We are the master and maven of the place.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Your firsthand experience is our best advertisement.

Insight.Transcription:
I have laid my hands on the souls of critters. They're soft and hard,
like the dew in the desert in the early morning, like the tide in the ocean at night.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
NewBabel will be popular in each and every household.
We set our feet on today, eyes on tomorrow.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hm? Do you have anything to tell me, young lady?
No, not those cliched greetings.
It should be a tender one, with some heartwarming words ...
How do you greet your mother?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
When reaching my age, most people are just like the thick cloud in the sky,
burdened with cumulative agony and joy ...
Their countenance also demonstrates the story of ageing, which is quite hard to ease.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
There will be a day when I defeat those "geniuses" at lawn bowls.
I just need some more practice, or ... a little more patience.

Idle.Transcription: Hey, my child. Do you have a television here? I'd fancy taking a nap with my blanket on the sofa ...

Greetings.Transcription: It's always good to have you here no matter if you found a bargain or suffered a loss.

Morning.Transcription:
Young people are all the same. They don't cherish the day ...
Don't look at me like that. I'm speaking from experience.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Quit yawning, sleepyhead. Let's play lawn bowls together!
All you need to do is hold this umbrella ... and count my scores.

Night.Transcription:
The night offers a chance for all stories—bloodshed, adoration, impulsion ...
The world we live in is ever-changing, that's why I love watching The Night Show.
The content is invariable and warmed-over; the view is indifferent,
and the best part is, it's never late.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Fall asleep by a warm fireplace ...
That was the only way I spent my night for a long time.
Well, now we have proms, and sofas, and the 29 inch CRT TVs.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
To gain a foothold in these times is no bed of roses. A pretty face is indeed the icing on the cake,
but what really matters is a good mind and a clear view of the time.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Go on, try holding it, and feel its temperature rising in your hand ...
Easy, sweetheart ... take it easy, heh heh ...

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Body, the enemy of the ripe old age, the friend of the flower of youth.

Hobby.Transcription:
The marine animals are a gift from mother nature. Their meat is fresh, the texture is soft,
and their blood is sweet with the unique ...
Oh, I'm terribly sorry. It seems it's not a pleasant topic for you.

Praise.Transcription:
You are such a brilliant young lady. Would you mind being my apprentice?
Well, before that I need to ask you one question—are you allergic to seafood?

Intimacy.Transcription: No need to propose a toast. Let's just call it a day and go home to watch a vampire movie in bed ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
My immortality allows me to be well-informed. No matter the dead or alive,
you can have your answer from me as long as the pay is adequate.
But ... just like anyone with a clear mind won't touch a hot potato, I suggest you keep your little nose clean.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Your Foundation is really a pain in the neck, my child.
They had a grudge against me because of the special invisibility cloak and the feud still continues today.
But in my defense, they had a 7-day warranty. What else do they want?
Or, they can just ... give it a try and buy one more.

Monologue.Transcription:
In Exeter, Death only spared me.
I often feel like a scarecrow. Everything around me keeps changing, growing, and eventually comes to an end.
But I remain unchanged and alone.

Deployment.Transcription: Alright, just one thing: I will be home by 10 p.m.

PreBattle.Transcription: Anyone offer your seat to the senior?

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Would you buy me a drink?

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Hmm ... A little bit hot here.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The ocean dried, and I'm alone again ...

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Pride goes before the fall. I've been there. You'd better take it.

Insight.Transcription: Well ... just a tiny piece of change in my long calm life.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
This is my secret of keeping young ... Fresh milk before bed.
Hmm ... The thick scent of milk.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Alright, ready to welcome me!
Prepare your softest brush, smoothest silk, flaxseed oil or something more expensive, and ...
Hey, is that a carrot? Ohh! For me? Thank you!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Darley Clatter is ready, is ready, is ready!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Run, chase liberty.
Now I am racing on the ground. In the future, I will be dashing in the sky!

Idle.Transcription: Ho, ho ho! From now on, this is the racecourse of Darley Clatter!

Greetings.Transcription: You are granted an audience with the Darley Arabian.

Morning.Transcription: Let the morning sunlight shine on my mane. It deserves that ... I mean the sunlight.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Darley sometimes gets up late. There's nothing to be blamed.

Night.Transcription:
Please offer me a bed with a soft mattress,
goose down duvet, rabbit fur cover, delicate sewing patterns and designer perfume sprayed.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
That is awesome! You must really be looking forward to spending a wonderful evening with Darley!
Oh the story, about the golden carrot in the lake, you have my permission to tell it one more time.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Oh ...
I can't deny you are really good at patting.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Faster than the wind! I am undoubtedly the fastest runner!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Take a look at my beautiful muscles! I don't need to explain how fabulous I am.
Hey, watch out! Rub me in the direction my mane grows.

Hobby.Transcription:
The breeze that combs my mane, the golden carrot, and my little Lilian ...
Oh, you don't know her? She is my lady ... Ahem, my maid!

Praise.Transcription: Oh yes! The great Lord of the Wooden Rocking Horse, is me, who grants you the right to ride on my back!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Adorable?
Ahh? You don't even have a taste!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Mass production? Oh my god!
The great ... great Darley Arabian is the one and only!!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Hey, hey! Come over here. I have a secret to share. I am the legendary Darley Arabian ...
Why are you laughing? Come on this is not funny at all!

Monologue.Transcription:
All the horses shall race freely,
no matter made of wood or iron, glass or flesh and blood.
As long as they possess the soul of a real horse, they are qualified to race.

Deployment.Transcription: Enter the starting gate!

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Right, that's exactly what I live for.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The endowments from the great Arabian!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Hey, anyone there?
I need to get my hoofs ... Oops, I mean wheels cleaned.

Insight.Transcription: Darley Arabian does not need a clean body. The mud is the glory!

First_Encounter.Transcription: Ms., your hat is tilted.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Lighting needs to be appropriate. Too bright will cause overexposure ...
And the films should be saved for sensational moments.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The smoke of war has never fully cleared. It just occasionally gets thinner ...
I will follow it and keep photographing it until the day it eventually dissipates.

Idle.Transcription:
I am no longer afraid of land mines ...
Wait, I never was.

Greetings.Transcription: If possible ... a knock on the door will be appreciated.

Morning.Transcription:
I am not afraid of the sun. I just dislike being exposed to it ...
Maybe I need a pair of sunglasses?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
If you are interested, I can show you my "workplace."
Hmm ... remember to take your safety helmet.

Night.Transcription:
Those air raids always strike at night,
so it is probably a good thing to stay awake late at night ...
no matter as a civilian or a war correspondent.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
There's no day and night in the air-raid shelter ... but it's not depressing.
Sometimes, not frequently, people enjoy the afternoon tea in the dark ...
so do I. Taking photos of them sometimes makes me feel much better.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: I once had a strong helmet. And then ... then what happened ...?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Baseline 100mm, shutter speed 1/1250 of a second; it's very resilient ...
This camera is the best device to take with me to cross the ruins and record the truth.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I am visible but impalpable ...
This is ideal for a journalist.

Hobby.Transcription: Or ... sometimes, I have nothing to do but float ...

Praise.Transcription:
The Great Adventure of Ms. Vertin
, another memorable photo portfolio.

Intimacy.Transcription: Do you ... mind me putting these photos of you into my portfolio?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
A quarrel is happening in the hall 320 meters away.
It's the wolf and ... the lily. Sorry, I have to go.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
This one is much funnier. A white kitten is confronting a lady ...
It seems not into vegetables because cats just aren't.

Monologue.Transcription:
Is war correspondent a good occupation?
... It shaped me into somebody but also took my life away.
Now I can still take photos, so I think death is not a bad ending.

Deployment.Transcription: Standing by you ... like an ally?

PreBattle.Transcription: Join the battlefield, like what I've always been doing.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: One sec, need a better angle.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: A historic moment for commemoration.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
I used too many films ...
but it is worthwhile.

Insight.Transcription:
This portfolio ... you wanna buy it?
... It is my honor!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: ... A perfect moment!

First_Encounter.Transcription: Heh heh ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Forte ...
piano.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Hmm?
... Hmm.

Idle.Transcription: *a soothing piece*

*humming*
*surprised*
... Heh heh.

Morning.Transcription: Hm?

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Um ...

*a dreamy piece*
