"Meow" ...
"Coo coo" ...

Praise.Transcription: *a cheerful piece*

Intimacy.Transcription: *humming*

Chitchat_I.Transcription: Hm ...

Chitchat_II.Transcription: Heh heh.

Monologue.Transcription:
I ... can't over exaggerate my gratitude for that planetary alignment.
It ... brought me that letter.

Deployment.Transcription: *a piece of music symbolizing her trying*

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Stars.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Phew ...
Yes, great.

Insight.Transcription: *a piece soaked in moonlight*

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: It's a secret.

First_Encounter.Transcription: New friends ... new friends ... new investor ... new friends!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Outing canceled?! I'm just getting excited!
Damn ... Not even a decent enclosed training field here?!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I have to say thank you to the "Storm."
Without it, those old fogies would have never given me the green light for research and so much funding.

Idle.Transcription:
Oh ... No one else's here?
Great. I own the place now.

Greetings.Transcription:
Hmm, hmm ...?
Oh, I just ... passed out.
Nice to see you here. Take the notebook on the desk and write down what I say ...

Morning.Transcription: The bread is mine now. Make yourself another one.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Here, take the latest Arcane Biology Daily.
Now see how they praise me and learn carefully.

Night.Transcription:
Next, I'll sing a song here.
My dear friends, say goodbye to your sleep.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Just you and I?
Great! Leave me alone and I will, too. Let's sit across each other until dawn!
That's the best companionship.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
This? Not bad. It's tough to bite and ...
This is your hat?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Don't restrict yourself to the suggested amount. An effective trail needs bold attempts.
So, I will say: full dose!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Hiss ... Hah ...
After ten minutes ... the mid clavicle ... the fourth rib, remittent ... pain ...

Hobby.Transcription:
You should take a look at the field Laplace prepared for me.
More than one hundred and twenty square meters.
Plenty of balls, frisbees, ladders, sandbags, sponge dummies.
Of course, it's open space.

Praise.Transcription:
Hah, much more comfortable in the suitcase. Flexible time for research, independent laboratory ...
and unlimited freedom.

Intimacy.Transcription: The experiments I do here ... Keep them a secret from Laplace. I'll make you an offer.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Family ...? Oh! Parents! If you had said this earlier, I would have understood.
I just don't have any reproductive organs. It's not like I'm born from stone.
Of course I have a family, a mother and a father.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Seriously, how obsessive are you guys ... The pronoun thing, I don't give a damn.
She, he, they, whatever you like ...
Hmm ... Well, if you had to choose, rofecoxib and pregabalin, which do you prefer?

Monologue.Transcription:
Humans are so busy distinguishing themselves from animals,
busy being arrogant, calling themselves "creator's favorite and miracles" ...
Hilarious. They think they're so exceptional, yet so much mediocrity in front of me.

Deployment.Transcription: Me? Is everyone else dead?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Go, go! Go for it! Puppies!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Huh? It's already over?

Insight.Transcription: Thank you very much. How about increasing the research funding by tw- ... fifty percent?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Don't run, puppy. I'll catch you in a minute ...

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Aaaah!
Sorry, I'm so sorry ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Sunshine?!
I gotta stay away ... before the rashes get on me again.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Emm ... I'm just a ghost, dead, no future ahead. I hope you can understand.
Oh, I'm not judging your idea. They are very lovely thoughts ... perfect thoughts.

Idle.Transcription:
No ... don't! Where did you go?
Oh my god ... Where are you? Don't leave me alone! Please ...

Greetings.Transcription: Welcome to my place. We can ... play together here.

Morning.Transcription:
I've made you breakfast, but it's all ruined by the seawater dripping off my sheets.
This is just like the party I went to, so ruined ... Haha ...

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Hi, what did you dream about last night?
You were mumbling in your dream.
I could barely hear anything even though I have moved very very close to you.

Night.Transcription:
Listen! Did you hear that? The ticking sound of a clock.
This ... this is too quiet, nobody noticed me, nobody looked over, I ... I ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Can you stay? Can we talk, just ... just for a while. Please look at me.
But ... not for too long.
You can watch me for 3.5 seconds, and look away for ... for 5 seconds. Then look back at me again.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
It's always so wet, sometimes itchy ...
What is this?!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Well ... I ... This is my finger, Ms. ...

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Are you saying ... people only have two legs?
Ooh! But how did I get this leg?
No. Wait! I'm trying to recall ...

Hobby.Transcription:
Sometimes I would watch TV, those drama series were so great.
And mom would bring me apple pie and soda.
Um ... I really miss times like that.

Praise.Transcription: You're totally far out! Even beat the most popular girls.

Intimacy.Transcription: I like new sheets, or as long as it is cleaned. But don't take them off me, please.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I think I dig it ... I must have picked up an extra leg from the sea ...
but I don't remember which one is mine, not to mention that I have picked up more than one leg ...

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I looked up in the water, watching the last breath of oxygen flee in bubbles,
then I heard ringing in my ears ...

Monologue.Transcription:
I'm not pretty enough. I have thick legs and freckles.
I'm not even close to being as pretty as those people on TV or as popular as other students.
I like my bedsheet. It's great. It protects me.
I will come out of my sheets when I'm less afraid,
in near future ... theoretically ...

Deployment.Transcription: Woo ...

PreBattle.Transcription: This is gonna be a haunted house.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription:
Please look over here ...
Ooh! No no no!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Perfect ... They have noticed me,
and ... and didn't stare for awkwardly long. I enjoyed this ...

Insight.Transcription:
Are you being sarcastic?
No?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
What do you think of my beachwear? Does it look bad?
Yes ... yes?

First_Encounter.Transcription: Hmmm ... Excuse me, is this the way to the audition?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Raindrops and dance, singing under the streetlamp—
Ah, that one classic dance in the rain.
If someday I could be starring ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
A character for me, a line for me,
such a day will eventually come to me.

Idle.Transcription:
Hello, I am Bette. I am here for the new character audition. I am going to present you ...
No no no ...
Hello, my name is Bette. I am here for the audition!

Greetings.Transcription:
Hello, please take a seat.
Oh I'm sorry. Just a minute, I'll find another place for these costumes right now!

Morning.Transcription:
Oh, bacon, a big no no for all beautiful girls on the film crew.
They envy my ability to change appearance, but I am so jealous of their lines.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Good morning, how do I look? Do you think I can nail today's audition?
It's for an ordinary character and the only line is "Good morning".
But ... it's still better than nothing!

Night.Transcription:
Oh hello ... I didn't realize you're here.
This, this is just a notebook. Nothing special. It's just my script ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Vagrants, forty-niners, hairdressers, winos ...
every one of us lives a life and every night we share the sky.
This is what films teach us. Magical, isn't it?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Cover my hair, blur my features! Now it's all up to my acting.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Ha ha ... They might be a little rough.
To tightly grab the eave does require abundant practice.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Before the advent of sound in films, body language was the only way to express emotions.
See, like this!

Hobby.Transcription:
When I am upset, frustrated or fail the audition,
I always stay in my bedroom going through my little notebook.
The rustling sound of paper always helps calm me down.

Praise.Transcription:
Well done, perfect! Let's call it a day!
Oh, sorry, I forgot we are not filming.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Argh, don't mind me ... I'm just observing, or imitating you.
Just in case someday you might need a reliable stand-in.

Chitchat_I.Transcription: Never give up, the future is bright. Everything's gonna be alright!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
A 720° flip and a 3½ backward somersault ...
Uhh, I ... I am not sure ... Are these heroics really necessary?

Monologue.Transcription:
I've dreamt forever about my first character,
not as a rich young man, a courageous adventurer, a fair or rich lady,
but the first character starred by me, Bette with brown hair!
I have noted them all in this notebook, which is called "My Script."

Deployment.Transcription: Here I am!

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: And a forward roll? No problem!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: It's my duty to reduce damage!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Salute to you, my lord!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Have I made it, director?

Insight.Transcription: What? I am so very grateful for your approval!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hello, Ms. Timekeeper. We're a team now.
If you encounter any difficulties with your assignment or the study of arcanum,
please feel free to ask me any questions, just as Ms. Sotheby does.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
At that time, I failed to make it to Ms. Sotheby's side because of a mission,
leaving her alone in the face of that cruel ... "Storm."
But you were there for her, Timekeeper ... Please allow me to express my gratitude again.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Teaching is ... more suitable for me than my current job.
Some say only the unambitious people who seek an easy life would choose to be a private tutor,
and I'm not even professionally qualified for teaching.
But I ... I really hope my time as a teacher would never come to an end.

Idle.Transcription: Let me ... check when my next class starts ...

Greetings.Transcription: Hello, chi le ma nin?

Morning.Transcription:
At this time of the day, the porcelain factory in my hometown has started the morning shifts.
Heh-heh, I wonder how it is doing now.
Feels like I was there yesterday.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Timeke ... Ha ha, you seem sleepy. Do you need another nap?

Night.Transcription:
Mr. APPLe is a wonderful teacher.
Compared to him, I'm neither experienced nor knowledgeable enough.
Perhaps I should seek some advice from him tonight in terms of home education.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Butter cookies, sweet and crumbly, are always popular among the kids.
Do you want some?
But don't forget to brush you teeth. I will come and check later.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
A gentle stroke on the student's head or at their backs can encourage them to express themselves,
and it will become a healthy start of a positive teacher-student relationship.
Encouragement and recognition are always more helpful in raising a happy and confident child rather than harsh criticisms.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I've done something terrible with these hands,
and something good.
The past is a part of who I am, and I must accept it.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Although the Foundation is well-known for their effective ways of teaching,
they always overlooked each student's character and personality.
Hmm ... I find their teaching philosophy difficult to comment on.

Hobby.Transcription:
When I lived in DC, I learnt to play an old boardgame from the East.
It's quite simple.
Are you interested as well?

Praise.Transcription: You are competent for many jobs, whether for the Foundation or for yourself.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Timekeeper ... thank you for taking care of Ms. Sotheby.
I'm least worried when she's with you.
Ahem, could you ... could you please also review Ms. Sotheby's potion assignment for me next week?
Well ... there will be an exhibition of eastern cultures in town.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The blue and white porcelain animal chasing ball plate of Bevington ...
What a delicate piece of work, wish I could see it with my own eyes.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Standing on a flying sword!
Wow, looks so much more graceful than riding on a broomstick.
The Chinese arcanum is utterly brilliant!

Monologue.Transcription:
As the Chinese saying goes, "Sai Weng Shi Ma, Yan Zhi Fei Fu."
I think my life cannot be better described.

Deployment.Transcription: Practice is the best teacher.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Like harvesting on the wheatfield.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Class over. Don't forget your homework.

Insight.Transcription: More books read, more strength gained.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
This dress reminds me of my hometown,

It's hard to imagine what a dangerous weapon they would make once broken.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Greetings to you, fair lady, may I present you a rose?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Sunlight eases people's mind and endows diamonds with glowing luxury.
What a perfect occasion for deceiving.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
So what's next?
The young lady of the rich, resolute and courageous as she is,

But then, I will leave her and disappear, forever.

A cigar would make a nifty accessory,

But ... no, thank you. I'd prefer my teeth unstained.

Greetings.Transcription:
Good day, my lord.
You're too kind visiting me, and I regret to receive you in a room of nothing.

Morning.Transcription:
Another beautiful morning arrives, and many beautiful things are about to come.
I see people opening their arms, waiting to go to the ball, new clothes, new flatteries,

Good morning, my lady.

Of course, I would never lie to you, this is a piece of cultured work.
But look how it sparkles, how elegant, isn't it?

Would I have the honor to invite you for dinner?
There's a banquet held by someone I don't know.
Huh? A freeloader?
No no no, I'd say it would be lavish of us if we don't enjoy it.

Ruby Port, a beauty from Douro Valley.
Em ... tastes as sweet as it smells.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
A decent gentleman will not let go of this.

Eye contact is vital.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:

I'm sure you know the reason why.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I don't dislike dresses.

They are what I'm supposed to wear, not these trousers.
Heh, destiny holds a different plan, doesn't it?

Hobby.Transcription:
Diddling, rightly considered, is a compound of which the ingredients are
minuteness, interests, perseverance, ingenuity,
audacity, nonchalance, originality, impertinence, and grin.

Praise.Transcription:
You have every virtue that belongs to a deceiver, yet you're a woman of honesty.
I don't know if I should admire your righteous nature, or lament the waste of gifts.

Intimacy.Transcription:
If you want to, you're always welcome at my place.
I will be here, with my cleverest scam, waiting for your arrival and, of course, an invitation to yours.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
If my eyes serve me well,
it's the "Bay of Light" this respectable young lady is wearing.
Oh, don't worry, I won't do anything.
She is of a background too prominent and an age too young for my tricks.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
New Delhi? To be honest, I barely remember anything about it.
It doesn't make much difference to England, aside from the scorching sun.

Monologue.Transcription:
We are two of a kind, dear.
We would employ every means possible to find out the truth we crave to know.
We are very alike.

Deployment.Transcription:
A crime group?
Heh, just to my likings.

PreBattle.Transcription: I don't like to resort to violence, but accidents happen.

Select_Incantation_I.Transcription: Glad to be of service, my lady.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: A design of its own kind.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Fragrance and dazzle can easily confuse one's vision. I'm sorry for you.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Now, to divide the spoils ...
Or should I say, a reasonable reallocation of the profits?

Insight.Transcription: To its perfection, to its best clarity.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Shush, my lady, let us enjoy this moment,
this beautiful, short, enchanted moment.

Ghost is not as complicated as you think. It's an ... energy force that couldn't be seen or touched.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription:
So spooky, so gloomy, toplight turning dim and bright, that is ...

You can do anything but you choose to hurt people.
Go listen to Lily's lesson and study again, reincarnate soon!

はじめまして。どうぞよろしくお願いします。

「雷神の少し響みてふらずとも吾は留らむ妹し留めば」

I would like to be with the boss and children ...

どなたかいらっしゃいませんか？

When I was in jail,
the guard in the jail would tell me about the fun parts of his day once night fell ...

私、お洒落はからっきし…　でしたが、

Please don't ...

すごいです ... There must be nothing you cannot do.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:

Yes ...

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
「なくな雁　今日から我も　旅人ぞ」
... I spoke about the past with customers at the cafe once. This Haiku was taught by them.

Monologue.Transcription:
A safe place, clean clothes, delicious food, a stable job ...
All these are like a dream. Thinking of waking up from this is ... terrifying.

Deployment.Transcription: Group crime ... Oh, no. It's nothing.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Time to admire the cherry blossoms.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Is it over? That's great. Let's go back together.

Insight.Transcription: Th-Thank you so much for your care ...

Hello, I'm the Necrologist.
I am adept at listening to and managing others' affairs.
This of course includes yours as well, whether in the present or perhaps, in the future.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
There are still many tombstones like this in the museum.
They get exceptionally noisy when it starts raining.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future? There's no real difference between the present and the future.
People die and there'll always be tombstones speaking of their desires, always a necrologist fulfilling those wishes.
I can't imagine another necrologist fulfilling my wishes when I'm dead.

1930s Porno Clippings in the attic ...

which is why I have chronic insomnia.

If you've got the time ...

The tombstones will leave once their wishes are fulfilled, and they will stay in the glass display for all eternity after.
They'll never be cold to the touch and instead, turn silent and warm.

You possess gentleness and that sort of incredible ability.

What would you like to tell her?

Alright, I see.

Death is merely an extension of life, which everybody is subject to. Everyone gets to that point someday.

Mhmm, mhmm ... I will take you back.

Anyone there? Heeellooo!

Greetings.Transcription:
Ohh! Finally made up your mind to share some secrets with me?
Grab those onion rings and popcorn and come closer. Yes ... tell it to my ear.

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning, any interesting gossip ...
Oh, you want the morning news? Fine, I'm out.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Good morning! Ah, you are having Sprinkle Spangles! Shame that I can't have any ...
Or shall we run a simulation?
Come, I will open my mouth, and you will take a spoonful in front of the screen and act like you're going to feed me, aaaaah ...

Night.Transcription:
Hey, you, you you you ...
really gonna spend a nice evening on these boring stories of hell?
Hell no, I'd better get the hell out of here!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Come over here! Put this TV down on the ground!
Ooh! I haven't lay down in ages, I almost forgot how comfortable this can be.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Hey! Stop smacking! The signal is alright!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
These are not my hands.
But if you want to feel them ... you can try touching the electric current ...

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: What to watch now—The Fitness Girl.

Hobby.Transcription:
The bottom of the drawer, the confessional, a locked cabinet ...
Diaries, reminder booklets, and notes hidden in the jacket's pocket ...

Praise.Transcription: Hey! Can I have your autograph? Like those celebrities on TV!

Intimacy.Transcription:
It's great that you don't have to pay for electricity here.
Just imagine what the bill would have looked like!
But even if you had to pay, you'd leave the TV on for me, because I'm worth it, right?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
This place is not as interesting as you thought it would be. People have locked away many things ...
Locks ... over locks.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
What ... is ... going ... wrong?
Turn it ... off and ... on again, or unplug the TV!
Don't you ... know ... a restart solves ... everything!

Monologue.Transcription:
It's not about the size or depth of a secret,
even the least important thing can be intriguing once it's intentionally covered up.
Just like the candy jar on top of the wardrobe. It always has my curiosity.

Deployment.Transcription: What, what? Make space for me!

PreBattle.Transcription: Let me hear it, let me hear it!

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: I never expected this from you!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Oh? Mhmm, mhmm! Ohh ... This is breath-taking!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: The TV always prevails! This is the power of amusement!

Insight.Transcription: Thank you for your "secret" service!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Woooh! Fully charged!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hey, Jefe. Life is a gamble.
Miracles won't happen if you just sit around and wait for it. When exactly are you going to make a bet?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: I bet you the weather's gonna clear up in three hours.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future–will the future bring more thrilling adventures?
Think about it. Isn't it always like this in those exaggerated novels?
Arcanum will eventually destroy the world and render everything to ruins!

Idle.Transcription: Slot machines, Blackjack, Russian Roulette ... Hah.

Greetings.Transcription: Oh, Jefe. Take a seat. Don't stand on ceremony.

Morning.Transcription:
Morning ... Huh?
If my memory didn't fail me, I must have fallen asleep at the back of some truck last night ...

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
You're just in time. Shall we have breakfast together?
I got some spicy burritos ... you don't like it?
What about enchiladas? ... It's not about the type of food?

Night.Transcription: It's night! It's night! Let the gamble begin!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I was born holding this coin, but I have no idea where it came from ...
It's like a friend that's been accompanying me all these years, yet I don't even know its name.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Want some of my good luck? If you think it'll work, try me!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Here, let's shake hands! Buena chica!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
If you want to be healthy, take care of what you eat. It doesn't feel good when you get an upset stomach.
I once had a companion who would eat soil, screws and whatnot!
Frightening, isn't it?

Hobby.Transcription:
Ooh, it's you, Jefe? Wanna go on an adventure?
There are over 261.6 places that have been rated as dangerous.
Murder scenes or cliffs, it's your call.

Praise.Transcription:
You'll definitely win a lot. Trust me, I'm never wrong.
Every single slot machine in Las Vegas is like my babysitter. I know them!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Are you ready to do this with me?
Everyone's jaws are going to drop and the ratings are going to soar like the eagles!

Chitchat_I.Transcription: Wherever the coin goes, I go too ... It's always been this way.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I'm often the object of people's jealousy because I'm too lucky,
but as you know, with my luck, nobody can do anything to me.

Monologue.Transcription:
Stability? Safety? For a life like that,
you might as well just give me a poison apple and let me sleep!
Remember to kiss me awake when there's something fun going on!

Deployment.Transcription: Is the camera in place?

PreBattle.Transcription: Hey, give me a chip. Just one with the lowest denomination.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Now, let me choose two lucky guests!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Hey, hey, hey! Don't be shy, mi amigo. Let's dance!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: What? You still don't recognize me? What about now?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription:
Ladies and gentlemen, this is no magic nor any special kind of mechanism.
Wish us ... luck!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Whoa, seven, siete, sept!

Insight.Transcription:
Heh, everyone's guessing who is this "Jefe" always supporting me,
letting me stir up trouble on TV.
... Wanna show up?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Not enough oxygen. I feel like ... I'm about to fly!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hello. Could you help me?
Over there, please. Thank you.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The melody-like sound of rain drops on the window is always here,
accompanying me through the long long night.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The doctor says that as long as I work hard, my disease will be cured.
At that time, I could run freely, just like other children.
But ... in case there is any accident, please give this letter to my mom.

Idle.Transcription: Shh, please don't speak too loudly. Ms. Timekeeper is having a rest.

Greetings.Transcription:
Ah, I'm so glad you are here.
How was your day?

Morning.Transcription: Good morning. I brushed my hair by myself today. How do I look?

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Sorry, when I thought that today we can read the book together, I was too excited to sleep well ...

Night.Transcription:
You have already worked very hard, please take a break at the right time.
Shall we ... read this book together?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
The dinner is really delicious.
Although my mouth always tastes like rust, I can still feel it.
Thank you chef. Thank you Ms. Babyblue for the fruit candies.
And of course, thank you for staying with me.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Are you patting my head?
The doctor says, this is a reward for good children. Have I done something right?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Would you like to hold my hands? I could be with you any time.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Ms. nurse says that my body is "like a leaf that can be blown away by a gust of wind."
But it's really fun to be blown away.
I always wanted to fly once *coughs* ... Sorry.

Hobby.Transcription:
I want to have a try at "travelling," like in the books.
But first, I want to climb up the hillside that I can't see clearly from the window.

Praise.Transcription:
Turn the impossible into possible. Be brave and never shy away.
You are completely different from others. You raised my hope.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Are there really hundreds of countries out there? Tens of thousands of people?
Oh, there's a hole on the tree in the yard. Does the squirrel family really live there?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
If there is something bothering you, please feel free to chat with me at anytime.
Although I can't get around as much as everyone else, I can still do the talking!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Please teach me how to use arcanum and master it better,
so that I could recover and not get sick again.
Maybe ... mom will not cry for me anymore.

Monologue.Transcription:
Not only mom and dad, all the nurses grieved and cried about my "misfortune" ...
Sometimes I think, maybe it's me who brings them tears and sorrows ...
I am so sorry about that ...

Deployment.Transcription: Thank you for taking me out.

PreBattle.Transcription: It's very nice to meet you!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: It protects me, as the doctor says.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Really? We did it. That's great!

Insight.Transcription: I ... I'd like to try to stand up ... May I?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Thank you for visiting me. Thank you for your flowers.
I have never really touched them myself. I'm really ... really grateful to you.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Have you heard that story? A magical golden lamp,
rub it 3 times and there was a genie, who can satisfy all your wishes?
Yes you say? Well then, go to that guy instead!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
It is said in a foggy day, there will be ... a faceless ghost～
Ha!
Haha haha.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
People always toss coins and talk about their future wishes ...
So why don't they start it right now?

Idle.Transcription:
If you come back now, you will hear my weird wish collection!
Hey ... are you there?

Greetings.Transcription: First, just to be sure, you didn't bring any coins, did you?

Morning.Transcription:
Birdie ... birdie, talk to me.
... Though I don't understand a word.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Ah ... Morning morning! Nice, finally wasn't woken up by any coins.

Night.Transcription: OK, that's all for today's spring visit. Go home, people! You are dismissed!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I can't sleep yet ... Who knows if the daydreamers will come back?
... Just like this. Whoosh! And the coin falls into the jar!
You have to protect me!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Sacrilegious!
... Isn't it?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: So, why am I holding a jar?

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Hey!! It tickles! Don't do that!

Hobby.Transcription:
People always make up those stories: they've met angels, their dreams come true ...
Unfortunately, it's me they've met!

Praise.Transcription: Well done! I'll give you my permission to wash your hands in this jar ... once only!

Intimacy.Transcription: I've heard girls on the outside world wear fashionable clothes ... May I have a try?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Hey, the Arcanum water purification unit ... You mentioned it before ...
What is it?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There once was a very kind guy.
He took away my coins, here, one by one carefully ...
Wait, that's the so-called thief? What ...

Monologue.Transcription:
What's in the jar, you ask? Gold, jewelry, pine cones ...?
No no no, there is and there always is, spring water.

Deployment.Transcription: Hee hee, I got the whole jar of water.

PreBattle.Transcription: I can also grant my enemies' wishes ... in my own way!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: No! More! Wishes! To! Me!

Attacked_I.Transcription: It's gonna break ... It's gonna break ...

Battle_Victory.Transcription: The triomphe of the wise La Source for sure!

Insight.Transcription:
The jar gets heavier ... or lighter?
It's heavy and light! So weird ... I don't get it!!

First_Encounter.Transcription: ... Greetings, madam. I am here.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Clouds help predict the weather, and also affect the air humidity ...
Oh, my wine!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
People are infatuated with time, chasing after immortality. That's the thing that never changes ...
It's the motivation, also the limitation.

Idle.Transcription:
Just like Cézanne's 
The Kitchen Table
, Balthus' 
Still Life with a Figure
 ...
Well, I think Caravaggio's 
Basket of Fruit
 is better.

Greetings.Transcription: Are you here to confirm this APPLe's expiration date? Don't worry!

Morning.Transcription:
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
However, please do not count on this APPLe, will you? My friend.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
The light particles traveling from one medium to a different medium in a parallel direction ...
Um, hi ... good morning.

Night.Transcription:
When the side of the earth turns away from the sun, people call it night ...
While in fact, everything stays the same and nothing changes.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Hello, Ms. Vertin ... sssssss ... W-When did you, burp, master my ... optical arcane skill?
But I-I don't see ... any sunlight in here?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Apples will drop when they're ripe ...
Umm, why am I saying these?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: What are you looking for? I think I ... may not be of help.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I am not heavy ...
since I have to consider the force that the people sitting under the tree can withstand.

Hobby.Transcription: Alcohol can sterilize, disinfect and innerve ... I mean, Sherry is pretty good.

Praise.Transcription:
You've read through 
The basic study of alchemy
?
How about 
Theoretical system of nature philosophy
? And 
The trajectories of the planets
?
... You may now be able to discuss more things with this APPLe!

Intimacy.Transcription:
About the study of fission and enrichment of the tungsten powder in displacement reaction,
this APPLe considers you as the perfect assistant.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Waffle! Ugh, please don't misunderstand me. It's just a little admonition for this APPLe himself ...
Haven't the posts on this forum been checked?!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I heard that there is a medieval knight wandering around. May I have a look at him ... or his armor?
... Maybe we can talk about wines in the Loire region.

Monologue.Transcription:
The shattered memories from the past sometimes haunt me ...
I see the revoluting celestial bodies faraway,
giant telescope and rainbow lights ...

Deployment.Transcription: Hmm ... there will be some differences between theory and practice.

PreBattle.Transcription: You can't see me, you can't see me ...

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Don't worry. Weightlessness only lasts a second.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: The star falls towards the sun, as the apple drops to the ground.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Which matters more, knowledge or strength?

Insight.Transcription:
Marvelous ...
If possible, may this APPLe have one more please?
This APPLe thinks there is still room for formula improvement.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the table ...

First_Encounter.Transcription: Hello, world.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Ahh, photosynthesis feels good as always.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
We have our backs to the "past," our feet in the "present," and lead people to the "future."
What a wonderful story.

Idle.Transcription: FM, FM, the latest news for you next ...

Greetings.Transcription: Welcome ... My good friend.

Morning.Transcription:
I've selected some morning news from 249 regions ...
Would you like to know which region consumes the most meat every morning?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Now, I am going to clean the dust under the battery cover.
Please guard the door for me and don't let anyone get close.

Night.Transcription:
Somewhere on Earth, there are always people working ... .
That's why the world is forever awake.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
No matter how the world has changed, it looks up to one abiding moon ...
Please rest at ease.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
This will cause me to malfunction, please don't ...
News from yesterday: the latest economic focus meeting has been held on Grazing Hilltop.
Cows attending the meeting believed donut holes and poor pessimists to be the causation of the recent cold wave.
Gold-raising and lava-raising are therefore urgently required ...

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: □■□△！No touching ...!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Thanks to your careful maintenance, my color stays beautiful and fresh.

Hobby.Transcription:
Those fluffy quadrupeds have a long history of such behavior,
using fraudulent appearances to commit some dangerous acts ...
They are not here, right?

Praise.Transcription: It's amazing, please allow me to play a song to praise you.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Could you put me into the water? Could you leave me near the fireplace?
I have no eyesight, which makes me on tenterhooks.
Please look after me, guide me to feel them, and take me away when necessary.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Someone once tried to steal me, and stuffed his own ears with earplugs ...
until he later understood that some "voices" cannot be blocked.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Please promise me NOT to open my battery cover, and honor your own word.
I hope you will not be another Psyche, and I won't be the crane flying over the mountains.

Monologue.Transcription:
... Every question has an answer, but not every question needs an answer.
Flowers in the garden know nothing, but they still keep blooming.

Deployment.Transcription: Alright! Let's try together.

PreBattle.Transcription: Maybe I should switch to a more exciting channel.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Knowing nothing is also a blessing.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Joy of victory is also new knowledge.

Insight.Transcription: The moment when dirt bids farewell to the machine is worth remembering forever.

First_Encounter.Transcription: Hi there, I am Mondlicht. I still have things to do, so I'll be on my way.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: They like foggy days like these the best ...

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Once everything is over and this "future" you are always talking about arrives,
everybody in the village will be able to live peacefully, right?
At that point, I want to ... to go to school ...

Idle.Transcription: Oma ... I'll make sure to protect everyone.

Greetings.Transcription: It's good that you're back safely.

Morning.Transcription: Bread is on the table ... I'm leaving soon.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Oma cleans her rifle multiple times every morning.
"Don't let bullets rust inside," is what she always taught me.
After that ... No, forget it. It's nothing.

Night.Transcription:
I need to stand guard, up until the day breaks.
Please get some rest.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I'm still here. I won't let anyone get hurt,
so please rest well. I'll take care of everyone.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Can you smell the blood on this cape?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Don't touch it. It's dangerous.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: The big bad wolves are very bad, but I can handle them.

Hobby.Transcription:
The children in the village will go to Anne's house on the Sabbath.
Her mama gives out snacks in the afternoon, and she starts reading storybooks at dusk.
I'll sometimes stop by their window,
but not for long. I need to be back at the lookout before night falls.

Praise.Transcription:
Danke.
With your help, I'll definitely ... be able to kill all the big bad wolves.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Hey, are you free now?
I found this book in my room. Could you ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription: Don't trust anything the big bad wolves say. Never let your guard down. Don't respond to them.

Chitchat_II.Transcription: There isn't soft bread like this in the village. I really want everybody to try it.

Monologue.Transcription:
It's all because of the blood we've spilt.
Grandma said ... that the entire river was red that night.
I've never seen that night, but I keep dreaming of that river.
Blood debts must be repaid in kind.

Deployment.Transcription: I'm always prepared.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Have a taste of this bullet.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Wie du mir, so ich dir.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: The hunters, no longer have the right to lose in battle.

Insight.Transcription: The blood of those monsters shall dye my cloak a deeper red.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: I'll protect every single person. I swear on this red cloak of mine.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Who's in front of you?
Humph! The Admired Captain, The Coolest Radio DJ, The Genius Alchemist!
Humph! Call me whatever you like.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Marvy!
Look, isn't the sun in the sky shining like a record?

To_the_Future.Transcription: Pirates may lose their job, but who cares ... Rock 'n' Roll!

Idle.Transcription: It's a bit too quiet ... I'd say, how about some rockabilly music?

Greetings.Transcription: Oh oh oh! Watch out, mate ...

Morning.Transcription:
News, or rock music? Which is the best to wake you up?
Welcome to the Pirate Radio.
Let's get it on, today and every day, Rock 'n' Roll!

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Are you staying here all day today? How about having fun with the Pirate?

Night.Transcription:
When you're sailing on the sea,
there's a record player, there's Dr. Papper, and there are enough good records.
All the stars will be your audience ... And they will never complain!

Bond_Night.Transcription: Hey! I'd say, let's play that record, the one we all like.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Berets, sun hats, casquettes, and captain hats.
Hats protect me against the wind and the rain, as well as the cold and the heat.
Regulus loves hats, and also loves not wearing a hat.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: What do you want? I don't have any spare scratch.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Now? You can wear anything now!
Even if you want to wear a paper bag tomorrow, it doesn't matter ...
This is the Swinging Sixties!

Hobby.Transcription: Drift on the sea. Go on a radio spree. Attack all the new things. Forever and ever!

Praise.Transcription:
Have you thought about being a Rock DJ at Radio APPLe?
You will be a great DJ only second to me!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Have you ever been to a live show?
The rock music from the radio is great,
but it's completely different to have a live rock show!
Of course, the ticket price will also go up ... Can you dig it?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
I've heard of a technique that can control the frequency.
So that all the radio stations will receive your message ...
Rock music will be broadcast on the radios of the officials who hate rock.
Haha, it's a gas!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
If it had not been the annoying "shadows,"
APPLe could have sailed longer on the Thames.

Monologue.Transcription:
The past, the future. Some may remember; some may not.
But the brave legends, adventures, rock music and its spirit will be immortal!

Deployment.Transcription: Wait, I have to hide the records first!

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Everybody, let me see your hands up!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Are you ready to be blinded?

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Left hands up, now, right hands up!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Are you ready to shake?

Attacked_II.Transcription: Peace and love, peace and love!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Hip hip ... Hooray!

Insight.Transcription:
How much are these materials? And how many records can I buy?
Ah! No, I definitely do not mean to steal a few! Really!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
The roaring engine of the motor, the rocking music from the radio, the waves when the ship sets sail.
Everything and everything. I can't wait to feel the new world!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Balloons ... you need some balloons here.
That's why I brought them. Say cheese.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: How I wanna tear the clouds apart. A party needs a lawn.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
But, if time stands still, there'll never be the next party.
Ah ... I have to think about it.

Idle.Transcription: Interesting ... Maybe I should make a bigger sound?

Greetings.Transcription: Oh! Nice to meet you! Nice to meet you! Nice to meet you!

Morning.Transcription:
... Oh, I guess I should say "Good morning" now?
Okay, sorry, I forgot it again. Let's start over, lie down please.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Would you like to touch the viscera in the balloon?
They're soft and bouncy, like a jelly.
The jelly best for breakfast.

Night.Transcription:
Don't you think it's too quiet? At night, or evening, this time?
Everyone is asleep! What an incredible waste of time! Is that sleep? Or a coma?

Bond_Night.Transcription: ... I'm going out. Wanna come with me? Please?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I keep thinking and thinking about how to hold a party and join it.
Oh—if someone opens my head, you know, just open it!
You'll see the draft of party plans all over the floor like brains.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Boom boom boom!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Starting here, it is called the skull, the collarbone, the ribs, the ulna, the radius
and the rainbow lollipop I hide in my body!

Hobby.Transcription:
There is nothing I love more than the smile on a crying kid.
Smile more, everyone.

Praise.Transcription:
You're the best party partner, the best kid and adult I've ever met!
Although I don't understand what's a kid and what's an adult,
I just wanna say, you're the best? You know what I mean?

Intimacy.Transcription:
Please take my balloon with you,
so that people can see it, and I can find you within a second.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Please, keep those horrible people away from me! I do not want to know any medicine
or potion formula that leaves a bitter taste in the mouth! Yikes!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
When I was little, I had a dream.
I saw many kids buried in the ground,
their tiny hands exposed, like newly growing potatoes.
And then I woke up, I started to throw up balloons.

Monologue.Transcription:
I wanna be like my parents,
but not exactly the same.
With these balloons, I can do what they can't.

Deployment.Transcription: Let us get to know each other.

PreBattle.Transcription: Let the helium fill your pulmonary lobe!

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Where's the party star? Where is it?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription:
The story begins with a bad adult.
He did this first, then that, at last ... boom!

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
It's time to say goodbye! Don't miss me, really, I'll be back!
*sobbing*

Insight.Transcription:
I know what you mean. The next party, the bigger party.
Hehee, I'm on it!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Ah! I see the peaceful families, and the lawns under the sun ...
Kids who are suffering, please come to me!
Or ... I will go to you.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
The lake is overflowing. It's cold, just like a flowing line ...
Wait, where am I?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Horizon ... the boundary of heaven and earth that may or may not intersect with the earth's surface,
useful to measure the radio waves, and useful to ... make people feel better.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I hope that in the future I can also contribute to the well-being of mankind ...
However, it would be better to have more missions.

Idle.Transcription:
Timekeeper ... Timekeeper? ... Are you asleep?
Okay, please have a good rest. Where is the blanket?
... Mmm, cover yourself and you won't catch a cold.

Greetings.Transcription: Greetings! Today your shirt matches the color of your eyes very well.

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning! Here's the newspaper today.
Huh? Why are my fingers black ... stained with ink?
How come? I've just touched it ...

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Good morning! Today I read a news story on the Italian Cheek Kissing Greeting ...
Uh, I mean, it would be great if we can practice it.

Night.Transcription: These newspapers ... plea ... please do not throw them away until I finish reading!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Is it really ok doing nothing like this?
Ha ... I mean when I was at the Foundation, there had never been such a tranquil night ...
Thank you for teaching me all these things.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Order is more important than opinion ...
I was taught in this way.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
It is said that the world I write down is just my imagination ...
But how can I get closer to the reality? What is ... the boundary between them?

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: The Foundation has provided me with much help, including food, uniforms, education ... and goals.

Hobby.Transcription:
The joke on November 7th ... I seem to have read it somewhere?
Ah! It was on the issue of February 29th!
... Report! I found a typographical error!

Praise.Transcription:
Emotionally stable and responsible; well-planned and capable; gentle, decisive and beautiful ...
Huh? What's going on? Timekeeper? Why is your face covered in your hands?

Intimacy.Transcription:
... Here's the newspaper from yesterday. The bridge, can we go there?
It looks really beautiful!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Did you do something amazing just now?
Well, you don't need to explain to me. I can imagine it.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
The verses to release arcane skills are not easy to find.
They must be full of passion and well-timed, and can only be found with luck.
However, if I know a poet, maybe ... things will be much easier.

Monologue.Transcription:
Sometimes I think about the time ... when we studied together ...
The instructor made us deskmates,
and your pockets are always alive with frogs, stones and toffees.

Deployment.Transcription: Just as what's been practiced countless times.

PreBattle.Transcription: May the peace be with us.

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: You've found the right verse for me.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Depict the world I have never seen before.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: So long lives this, and this gives power to thee.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Each moment, now night.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: I will pray for you ... sorry.

Insight.Transcription: Hu ... La ringrazio. I will make good use of this power.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
This place has brought me so many things: freedom, fresh knowledge, brave friends.
How can I ever repay you?
I want to be of help to you at any time.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Silence.
Speak. From whence dost thou hail and what is thy purpose?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: The flames of injustice are yet to burn at the stake on rainy days. All is not yet lost.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
There are numerous injustices in the world.
The law cannot prevail over power, but there shalt eventually be a sword sharp enough to cut it down.

Idle.Transcription: Silence.

Greetings.Transcription: Speak.

Morning.Transcription:
Oh? Thou art early.
I think thou were like those lords ...
No, 'tis of no concern.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: There is much to be done today. I will be on my way after greeting thee.

Night.Transcription: The trial today hath ended. Was it fair? Certainly.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Everything I doth ...
is so I may enjoy this calm wind on nights like this, rather than hear the sorrowful cries and moans of unhappiness.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Thou art overstepping my boundaries, arcanist.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: If a greedy hand commits a crime, it shalt be cut off.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: This body is a representation of justice. Laziness is not permitted.

Hobby.Transcription:
The idle chatter of the people is entertaining,
but 'tis more entertaining that they are always the first to know about the corrupt behavior of nobles.

Praise.Transcription: We seem to be on a similar path. Keep going, o' ... friend of mine.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Those who hurt others shalt eventually be the ones dripping with blood. Makers of injustice shalt be visited by justice.
I have seen the righteous wielding much power fall to it.
When I succumb, do not be merciful.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Thou cannot trust those greedy gents to abide by the law.
Thou must pick up thy sword, hold it to their throats, and the law can then prevail.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
They cried bitterly afore the trial, then threw a handful of fine salt at me ...
Next? They repented by apologizing profusely.

Monologue.Transcription:
There shall always be those who think themselves above others and ensure it with their power, wealth and wickedness.
If they keep the commandment of the strong judging the weak, they should not have complaints.

Deployment.Transcription: Silence.

PreBattle.Transcription: This trial is mine to judge.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Pay for thy sins with thy blood.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Noble or lowly, sin shall be punished.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Thou shalt make an atonement for thy sins in full.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Using troops? Pfft.

Insight.Transcription: Trials are akin to flames.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: It concerns me that I can imagine how it feels to be in a position of power.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Are you a brave speaker?
You look like one ... Hmm, and sound like too.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: Seeds will grow up with the kiss of raindrop ... So does hope.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I've planned to have a new job a long long time ago ...
but "now" is not the time.

Idle.Transcription:
Be quiet, my old pal ...
You always let me hear everything clearly. Ha ...

Greetings.Transcription: I'm not good at dealing with visitors ... It reminds me of something bad.

Morning.Transcription: I brought you a flower, go find it in the woodpecker house by the street.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
... Didn't sleep well? That's for sure!
You know who else didn't sleep well? The family on the other side of the monitor.
Poor baby was sick and cried all night. All of us are exhausted.

Night.Transcription: The darkness swallows the sun, the starlight quietly leaks out of its belly.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
The Stasi is watching everyone and everything, except people's dreams.
Sleep ... Go find your own promise land.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Wearing headphones for too long will give you a headache.
Don't be surprised, everyone has had it,
although we seem poker-faced and indifferent.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I don't recommend you read those reports.
Firstly, it's really boring. And secondly, the Stasi may find you.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Someone once wanted to scratch his back but ended up caught in the tree ...
Of course he didn't know it was me who called help for him.

Hobby.Transcription:
I—bought half jar of Lübeck marzipan in a small store ...
Try some? Not much left, don't eat too fast!

Praise.Transcription: You're doing the same thing as I do ... No, you're far braver than me.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Hm? I seem to hear the sound of "contraband" ...
Don't want to share with me?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Do you know where you can see flowers? In a parterre or in a garden?
Neither, my friend, you should go under the bridge where even a tramp will find it too dirty to spend a night.
Only on the mud-coatted walls of the aperture can you see the most beautiful cornflowers' ... graffiti.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
At least for once, I want to check up on the kids on the other side of the monitor ...
Well, we've never met in person, but they are already my old acquaintances.

Monologue.Transcription:
To act like an idealist may be too big a goal, but "to be a nice person" doesn't sound bad either ...
Will they write a sonata about me too?

Deployment.Transcription: Shall I "ask" the enemy for their tactics?

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Whose heart is beating so loud?

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: We should listen to what people say.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Agents have guns. It's called common sense.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Secrets always hide in careless words ... Listen carefully.

Attacked_I.Transcription: Hey, I am the support staff ...

Attacked_II.Transcription:
Retreat!
... What, I can't make the call?

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Stay low-profile.
I don't want to be shunted to some radical department ...

Insight.Transcription:
Technically, these are all contraband ...
Now you are my accomplice.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
The times never stop. Maybe I can't change anything ...
But at least I've once spoken out.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I'm Oliver Fog, special commissioner of the London Climate Management Agency.
Three hours from getting off ... Ok, let's start.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
What a lovely day ...
I want to go for a walk. We couldn't have asked for a better sun where I lived.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
You really want to go to the future?
... Do you think those smog factory will destroy the whole world?

Idle.Transcription:
Rest time is also included in work time.
Both office workers and British people should master the talent of looking for tea time.

Greetings.Transcription:
You're here ...
Hey, maybe you can help me with my homework?

Morning.Transcription:
The last time I was in the mood for a morning walk was when all I had to do was go to school.
... Still vivid in my mind.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: ... Getting up is easier in the summer. In the winter, it's not easy work.

Night.Transcription:
Being off duty, such a wonderful resting time.
Well, now let me prepare my book bag ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
... Sometimes I think that you may need to have more rest.
People with great responsibility are always absorbed by their work
and neglect many other things.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
The Fogwalker's hat doesn't fit me, it's too heavy ...
Although my father honored it very much, it's just a job.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You can't catch the fog ... The only thing you can catch are the things that can be caught ...
like catching the time to get off work.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
A small lad with a lot of thoughts.
That's what many people think about me. But I think they're numb.
It may not be a bad thing to love your job, but isn't it a good thing to love your life?

Hobby.Transcription: The yellow daffodil is the prettiest flower. It reminds me of the glorious St David's Day holiday.

Praise.Transcription: It is said that "Able men are always busy." Your high working efficiency may bring you harm.

Intimacy.Transcription: Uh ... I really don't want to get up today, please just tell others you haven't seen me.

Chitchat_I.Transcription: I'm planning to write to the queen about lowering the retirement age of some special types of work.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
There are people who do screw driving, juggling, dung picking, so of course there are people dealing with the fog.
People who have hands should work, either for living, for self-achieving ...
or other things.

Monologue.Transcription:
They had claimed that the Fogs are incredibly essential to London.
In that case, why didn't they put the emission reduction plan on the agenda earlier?

Deployment.Transcription: I seldom work together with others, but this is not bad.

PreBattle.Transcription: Very well, the enemies don't seem to be in the habit of wearing gas masks.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: ... Just take it as a trip to London.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
3 hours 15 minutes left ...
No, nothing, let's move on to the next.

Insight.Transcription:
If everyone could make such an effort,
perhaps London would have been freed from the fog a long time ago ...
Of course, the faster way is to shut down those factories.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
If the fog in London fades, I will be a special effects artist for stage or film ...
the kind that specializes in making smoke.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Ah! The troopers are here! Get out of ...
Huh? You are not one of them? I am so, so sorry!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
What a nice day. There will be such a large audience to ... night.
Ah! My stomach, it hurts ... so much ... I'm not lying!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Even if we do go back to the future, I still wanna go back farming ...
Grow some potatoes, corn, raise some cattle.

Idle.Transcription:
Silence on the stage is only a tiny lingering charm
before the next magnificent show ...
Um, what am I talking about!
... Whew, thank goodness nobody noticed me.

Greetings.Transcription: I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

Morning.Transcription:
Beautiful sunshine means a beautiful day ...
Hmm, people like me, who cannot do anything well, really don't deserve to be standing in the sun ...

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Good morning. Why am I in a good mood today, you ask?
Because the company takes a day off.

Night.Transcription: Everyone else is ready? Mmm ... my feet ... I can't move my feet!

Bond_Night.Transcription: The light is on ... It's time for me to go on stage.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
The illusion I create can only fool the eyes ...
My arcane skill is not of much use.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: If none of these troubles had happened ... I would probably be milking the cow right now ... *sighs*

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
... It's indeed too much!
I've told the cast do not pick this outfit ...

Hobby.Transcription:
Only when standing on the stage, when saying the lines ...
Could I forget the fact that I'm such a useless, undeserving person ...

Praise.Transcription:
Br ... brilliant! Your achievements are soaring like a harrier in the sky,
one can only admire but not be cynical.

Intimacy.Transcription: I ... I will be brave ... Just like you!

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
People, people! Why are we wooing for our own destruction?
Why not just take my word and go back home farming?!

Chitchat_II.Transcription: An't be my destiny, so. An't be not, so. He that dies this year is quit for the next.

Monologue.Transcription:
Each one of us struggles to survive for a certain reason.
Bloodline, responsibility, pursuit, vocation ...
If the illusion I created could be one of their reasons ...
that would be enough.

Deployment.Transcription: Don ... don't look at me ... I'm not the one you saw on the wanted list ...

PreBattle.Transcription:
Did the show begin?
Excellent, get ready to step onto the stage.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: This shall be my only act!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Thy ending is destined.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
That's what you've got?
... Huh? I'm sorry!

Insight.Transcription: Umm ... Are you sure you're not making a mistake ... choosing me?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Aye ... aye!
Be it tyrant or tyranny, people's right for joy cannot be snatched away.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I am ... Who am I? I don't know ...
It's okay, in Wonderland ... everyone is Alice ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
It's so strange to see ... the raindrops falling from the sky.
In Wonderland, it is either syrup or sewing needles. I have a lot of umbrellas there.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
You always care about the future.
But Wonderland has been the same for hundreds and thousands of years.
There is nothing wrong with standing still.

Idle.Transcription:
What are you doing? What are you looking at?
Do you also have your Wonderland to deal with?
A busy world that ... we never know?

Greetings.Transcription: ... Huuu, hm? ... Hm.

Morning.Transcription:
MRE-flavored cake, cake-flavored MRE,
which one would Miss Badge prefer?

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Still too early to go to bed? Everyone in Wonderland is waiting for us.
If it goes on like this, time will not be happy ...

Night.Transcription:
Shrink the dinner to be swallowed in ... one bite ...
Then, I could finish it as quickly as possible.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Everyone in the dream is waiting for me. Close your eyes and listen.
Outside the door, it's the sound of the heel stepping on the grass ...
Are you not coming with me today?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Since I came to Wonderland, no one has braided my hair ...
so they are getting longer and longer, longer and longer.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Are you looking for candies? Maybe you should bring a magnifying glass.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
I seem to be taller and taller ... The chair is getting too small to seat me ...
If I shrink myself, will everything be as usual like before?

Hobby.Transcription:
There's a teddy bear as big as a mountain in my room.
And there're bears that love honey in the circus box.
Why are there no bears in Wonderland? Hmm ... I will find the bear.

Praise.Transcription: I will ask Mr. Rabbit to prepare one more cake ... Hmm ... It's a reward for you ...

Intimacy.Transcription: One day, if I go back and never come out again, will you come to visit me?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Time paused? I think we should hurry up to buy teacups.
More and more teacups. We won't have time to wash them very soon.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Twinkle twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are.
Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky. Twinkle, twinkle ...

Monologue.Transcription:
People at school once called me ... Umm, how do you say that word?
Ah ... Crazy! Sad? I'm not sad ...
They told me that the most outstanding people were all crazy ...

Deployment.Transcription: Are you also here ... for the tea party?

PreBattle.Transcription: I am not afraid of you. You are just a pile of cards.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Let's play peekaboo ... I will help you!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Smaller than the stars, bigger than the mushrooms.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Snack time! ... Yum yum.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Is everyone seated? Ahem, the court is now in session.
The verdict is ... guilty!

Insight.Transcription: The boundary of Mr. Rabbit and the Queen is getting bigger and bigger.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
What should I give you in return?
A teddy bear? Hmm, or a well filled with syrup?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Mission accepted ...
Advice, you'd better clear your complaint mailbox first.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
You know what? Rain can wash away many things,
tire marks, footprints, bloodstains, let alone some dying message written in blood ...
Anyway, I do love rainy days.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I really don't get why you guys work so hard.
It's a good time, full of delicious desserts and clubs.
Hey, have some juice, little girl,
or should I say ... our great heroine and goddess.

Idle.Transcription:
Peter, Andrea, Maleficent, Tonika, Leon ... is everybody awake?
It's time for something different.
... Don't drool everywhere, Andrea!

Greetings.Transcription: Come in, it's fine, just be careful not be eaten by them.

Morning.Transcription:
You guys always freak me out when you sleep. What kind of people need such a long sleep like that?
Fall in a coma like a crispy critter, and wake up 8 hours later.
... Only god knows how you do that.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Ok, amico mio, a brand new day, let's go shopping!
Why are you so confused? You do know how horrible your fridge is, right?
Its refrigeration is a piece of shit, making my Gelato frozen solid!

Night.Transcription: Nice moon, makes me wanna howl.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
What do you count before sleep? Sheep or wolf?
I suggest you counting wolves, cause they'll eat up all the sheep ...
and you can enjoy your night.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Wanna know how many holes I've made on others' heads?
No? Then stop it.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You've noticed?
These hands can wring one's neck, pull the trigger, slice throat with knife ...
Perfect hands.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Cool as hell, right? It's called the Piemonte Art ...
The salesman said so!

Hobby.Transcription:
I always take souvenirs from my prey.
Rings, earrings, photos and movie tickets in the wallet, huh ...
I got a beautiful cabinet for my collections, you wanna see?

Praise.Transcription:
I mean, if I were the boss, I would hire people like you too.
Although sometimes you are freaking stupid, you gotta be useful somehow, right?

Intimacy.Transcription: You wanna some Gelato? All the doctors say it's unhealthy ... but who cares?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
You do know James Burton, the one who published the reminiscences?
He made tons of money through that single book. I should ask him for some royalties,
it's all about me after all.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Mio padre was missing, mia madre is in the asylum.
I can't remember her face, but vaguely recall the rhyme she sang me ...
She's in Rome, probably in her middle age. I've never visited her.

Monologue.Transcription:
Go back to Rome, where the wolves were born. Said my former boss.
He knew I was born in Rome, but didn't know I was raised in Piemonte.
He was such a fool, even tried to kill me. So I only kept his tie clip.
I didn't tell him that as long as the night will come, everywhere I live is Piemonte.

Deployment.Transcription: Huh ... lemme see who will be my poor teammates.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: I'll give you the time to pray ... as if possible.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Ciao, amore!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Viva il mio maestro!

Insight.Transcription:
The whispering between wolves and the moon of each night ...
You make me understand them better. What a greedy but brave decision.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Hey, I didn't know you value me so much. What do you want from me?

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Y'all wanna fries, burgers, or apple Martini?
The party's gonna begin, sit tight ... my naughty guest!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
... Ha! What a fresh air!
Rains help crops grow better. I love raining!
Let's fixin' out and have a walk!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I hope one day people can accept my job just like they can do to the farmers and the dove keepers.
Mammy would lemme lay on her knees and listen to all the stuff that happened today,
no matter good or bad.

Idle.Transcription:
Welcome!
No no no it's a bit faster, and more energetic ...

Greetings.Transcription: Huh? Where is my hankie?

Morning.Transcription: Good morning, good morning, good morning!

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Who wants some Bunny Bunny yummy brekker?

Night.Transcription:
Hi, it's club time! You wanna grab a drink?
Don't worry, we have 143 different choices here!

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Hey! How about malt beer?
Don't worry if you get drunk, you can always count on Bunny Bunny. Always!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Oh, hey! Mama ain't no like a droopy girl!
Help me get it up, hurry!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
I can hold you with a single arm.
If you don't feel so good, just call me, dear guest!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Whoa, haha ... sorry, it's my belly ...

Hobby.Transcription:
I sure like so many things ... I really, really can't pick one!
You see, I like my job, I like yummy foods, I like everyone, and I like you!

Praise.Transcription:
How I wanna clap for you!
... Hmm, when I got a free hand, I sure gonna do it!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Could you help me fix the zip on my back? Something's wrong there.
Really? If Mama knows I'll be darned!

Chitchat_I.Transcription: I can lift anyone with no sweat, except myself!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Alright! At least I done learnt this time,
I ain't walk by that dessert store no more, nor the restaurant!

Monologue.Transcription:
Back in the village, only my auntie talks about movies with me.
She'd listened to all my faraway and impractical dreams.
I sure am grateful to her. I write her all the time.
And her writing back always smells like apple flower.

Deployment.Transcription: Howdy, howdy, howdy! Howdy to everyone!

PreBattle.Transcription: Hi! Would you like a fruit cut first?

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Hey hoo ... Whoa whoa whoa! Whew, are you ready to have a hearty meal!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Bad guys are all gone, no worries!

Insight.Transcription:
Unbelievable! You don't think ... I can lift a car?
We ... we might could go out and try ...?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Really? Oh ... Really! I done loved it, thank you!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Здравствуйте ...
No, nothing ...
The name is ... on the paper ...
Please ... have a look ...

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Have you ever wondered ... why does it rain ...?
Not about how ... but, um ... but why.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The future ... There may be Tsar no more ...
But, I won't go back to the St. Petersburg either ...
I like the bise in the Far East ... and ... зима.

Idle.Transcription: ... Всему живущему идти путем зерна.

Greetings.Transcription: I'm not ... writing ... poems ...

Morning.Transcription: The in ... inspiration always comes at night ... till now.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: ... You're awake? Would you like to hear ... my work from last night ...?

Night.Transcription: Just one more page ...

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Now ... now I'm going out for a walk ...
The moonlight is ... beautiful ... It's good for writing ...
Maybe ... you should try to write a poem too.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Inspirations ... are elusive ... They come and go, as they please.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: Think much ... Write less ... just like chatting.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Warm ... Wind-proof ... шуба.
Everyone should have it.

Hobby.Transcription: Perhaps ... I once, too, was a lively bird.

Praise.Transcription: You've won my respect ... Although it might not help ...

Intimacy.Transcription: Зима is close to you ... it's not just an assumption ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The throne of the Tsar is covered in heaps of gold ... and stains of blood.
It is dwarfed ... by the firs and the frozen land.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Write when you want ... stop when you don't.
There are not many poems like the orange hair thinks.

Monologue.Transcription:
The fallen Tsar is just like the fallen leaves on the island. зима, do you know, what the Tsar is?
You walk so quietly ...

Deployment.Transcription: C ... can I, not go ...?

PreBattle.Transcription: ... Not even close to the soldiers.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Не было бы счастьe, да несчастьe помогло.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Хорошо! I'll go back, then ...

Insight.Transcription: Зима, poems, are my expressions.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
I hear ... more sounds ...
from animals, trees, oceans and ... poems.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Don't panic, my lord,
<The chasing troopers are also part of the play.>

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
When the rain drops, the sorrow follows. Something shall befall the present day.
<Murder, love, or the eulogistic end of a story—>
the dramatic rain!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Future is an interesting issue, my lord.
I yearn for the wheel of the busy stage moving forward, so do you.
<My friend of one mind, I'll give thee a wind.>

Idle.Transcription:
In the ancient times, the fool's job is to entertain the lord ...
<Dost thou also need this service?>

Greetings.Transcription: The moment you step onto the stage,<it comes clear to me that the hero hath arrived. >

Morning.Transcription:
Greetings to you, my lord.
Your arrival may be the reason of Master Charlie's attendance for rehearsal.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
<Where did they go?>
They all went to work.
<And?>
And they went to church!
<O? Why not go to the play? Why not sing? >
Because long live the all mighty King!

Night.Transcription: I wish you an engrossing dream, <leastwise there is no ban for dreams yet.>

Bond_Night.Transcription:
<Where did they go?>
They all went to pray.
<And?>
And they came to us, in front of us!
<O! They still love—the entertainment, the song, the skin underneath the dress.>
It's the arrival of the night! Let the play begin!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
My mask? I see not necessity of masking off.
<Aren't thou wearing it too?>

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: I picked this floweret, before it was distained by the blockish world.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Are you confirming my gender?
<Out alas, the Fool hath no gender.>

Hobby.Transcription:
What would you do at your leisure?
For me, fishing perhaps, or appreciating silver utensils.
I read no script, I have no script.

Praise.Transcription: Listen—audience, they shout all you forth!

Intimacy.Transcription:
If none dares stand out and do something to His Grace,
your fair laughter, shall it be heard no more?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
The gallows has feet, my lord! Run away when we still can! He is coming!
<His arrival shall kiss all's neck with ropes.> Hahaha!

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Who shall stand pensive for tragedy?
Who shall smile through tears for survival?
Who shall pray for their bloody hands?
People—It's people!

Monologue.Transcription: Some please people with comic, others with wit. Me, with my life.

Deployment.Transcription: Please, allow me to prepare.

PreBattle.Transcription: Only one fool could stay on the stage, <that shall be me.>

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: To that we have free souls forever!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Haha, my lord, I defeated one thousand enemies in battle just now!

Insight.Transcription: <Sing thee a song I will,> in any voice, any way.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hello dear ...
Do I still have to tell you my name? Or sign my name first?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
If I could take a break all day today, nowhere will I go.
I just want to sing on the balcony.
And on the mist of the window, I will draw many many pussycats.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Travel to the future? Most welcome!
Maybe I will become more famous, bringing the pictorial to the other side of the world.

Idle.Transcription:
Well, it seems I have a rare opportunity to take a break.
Even better if there's a recliner and blanket for me.

Greetings.Transcription: It's always lonely to stay somewhere quiet for a long time ...

Morning.Transcription:
I read the news every morning,
just to see how the press piece together what they imagine me with exaggerated words.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
While wandering in the bedroom, whenever I see the oval diamond in my jewelry box,
I know that yesterday was not that bad, and today will be good.

Night.Transcription:
Hmm ... hah ... a silk robe? Thank you, but I don't want it.
Dress me up with Chanel No.5. Only that is my nightwear.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I often dream of my grandparents coming towards me in a purple mist,
but they never reach my side ... Come closer, would you?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
Blondie, blondie, everyone likes my blonde hair.
I can't believe it is really a technical job to do hair.
Can you? When dyeing ... you need to do this and that ...

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
The cane? That's my "Sweet Nighty Night" ...
How it got its name? I hope you won't have the chance to know.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Rifle for soldier; dress for woman. For me, I got both.

Hobby.Transcription:
Will you try three hundred times for a scene less than three seconds?
I tried. For what I love, that's my attitude.

Praise.Transcription:
I value your qualities more than your looks.
After all, when it comes to appearance, who will win? You?

Intimacy.Transcription:
Wives hate me.
They called me Salome. They call me Lamia. They call me Whore of Babylon, or even Siren ...
but I'm none of them. I'm just ... who I am.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
If you want to be a star, come to Hollywood;
if you want to be yourself, then never come.

Chitchat_II.Transcription: A story for another story; a secret for another secret.

Monologue.Transcription:
People spend thousands for my glance.
But you are willing to pay for my soul. Thank you.

Deployment.Transcription: Huh, am I not late?

PreBattle.Transcription: Why haven't those warm-ups walked away?

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: No memory of the scene will be left.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Nighty night. I wish you sweet dreams.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: If only I could be as forgetful as them.

Insight.Transcription: Gosh! I am even more glamorous now!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: When they sit here, they look down at everyone ... The world is in my hands? ... Huh.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Everything in the world is born of laws and regulations.
There are no coincidences, let alone adventures.
There are only expected results, such as our encounter.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
The last time I enjoyed the sun like this was in the afternoon.
I went for an outing in the orphanage.
But later ... they found me.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
The development of the world is like a huge Goldberg machine.
I am curious as to where this little ball of history will lead.

Idle.Transcription:
Try my new inventions ...
Ah! I had never prepared for a plan B in your absence ...

Greetings.Transcription: It's so nice to meet you! I've been waiting for so long!

Morning.Transcription:
