Good morning. The timing with which you pushed the door is just right!
The bread in the kitchen should be ready now.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Good morning. I had a dream last night. In my dream, I ... You wanna know?
Come here, let me tell you.

Night.Transcription:
What I will show you now is that through these little leather boots ...
The lights will be turned on 30 minutes later!

Bond_Night.Transcription: Can I borrow you tonight? I really need your help for my new machine ... please?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
My eyes ... a little scary, aren't they?
Kids new to the orphanage were a little afraid of them, but in the end everyone likes me.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
Haha ... I got you!
I won't let you go, unless you agree to join my experiment!

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
The kids in the orphanage were skinny and fragile.
No one was fed enough, nor did we have winter clothes ...
If only we had a "sister" like you to help us at that time.

Hobby.Transcription:
They like to group people with talents ...
That's the reason why I became interested in the study of enchantment.
It doesn't matter whether the user is talented for Arcanum.

Praise.Transcription:
You once told me that the Goldberg Machine is also an example of the Butterfly Effect.
I like this statement very much.

Intimacy.Transcription: Ah, I seem to have grown a bit taller recently. Can you tell?

Chitchat_I.Transcription: There exists a "singular point" in everyone that makes him or her unique.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
The dean always told me that I should laugh more as a child.
You look about the same age as me. Say cheese ...

Monologue.Transcription:
Arcanists, ordinary people, rich and poor,
everyone's got blood, and may bleed.
Let us get along with everyone equally.

Deployment.Transcription: Me? ... Did you find something?

PreBattle.Transcription: What interesting accident will happen next?

Select_3star_Incantation.Transcription: Every choice will affect the outcome.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: Just a reminder. Watch your steps.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: Please live up to my expectations, colleagues.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Don't worry. Let's have a cup of tea.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Mind the machines on the ground ... Bang!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: I would like to express my deepest regret for the accidents.

Insight.Transcription: A new accessory. I'm inspired! Thank you! You've been of great help!

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: The day I've waited for has finally come. Welcome to my world.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Hi! I am Sotheby. As you can see, I am an excellent and knowledgeable lady!
Huh, that farmer ... he actually owns a whole group of bicorns!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
There are many arcane animals that only come out in the rain ...
Ah ... What has just flown away?!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Ms. Moissan told me the nutritional supplement formula I made couldn't be universal.
But it's fine. I believe in the future, everyone will use it!

Idle.Transcription: Huh, is no one here now? Then I will read my diary out aloud!

Greetings.Transcription: Welcome to Typhon's Movie Party!

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning. Is Regulus here?
I heard she was hard up recently. I was wondering if I could help.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Everyone says "the early bird catches the worm."
But I have just been looking outside for a long time ...
And haven't found any birds or worms ...

Night.Transcription:
Sounds like the roar of a wild beast, also like the spooky hoof of the underworld ...
I got it! It must be the Nightmare galloping away!
... Huh? The engine? What is that?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
I just bought a rare and strong bicorn. I heard it only came out at night ...
A bull? Eh? Am I tricked?
And ... does bull have anything to do with beef?

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Stop it! You can't just touch an adult's head!

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
The egg of the Wraith is one fingerbreadth, the beak of the Phoenix is three fingerbreadths,
while the tail of the Arcane Python measures the length of a whole finger ...

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
This is Typhon, the hero of Auto Island!
Fight against the evil Jupiter every day!

Hobby.Transcription:
I'll have the most fun in a party!
Singing and dancing make me happy.
But my favorites are all about snacks, cakes and puddings!

Praise.Transcription:
Ms. Moissan is my tutor. She taught me a lot of "common knowledge"!
Without her, there would be no outstanding and knowledgeable lady Sotheby!

Intimacy.Transcription:
... You're here! My experiment is almost the last step.
Go find 500 grams of liquid gold and help me settle it!

Chitchat_I.Transcription: There are many Auto Islands on the Thames. Which will Typhon live on?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
It must not feel well to be hungry, right?
Everyone says the nutritional supplement I made won't work. How can I adjust it?

Monologue.Transcription:
The outside world is different from what I imagined.
There are more arcane animals than I thought ...
Humans are also more interesting!

Deployment.Transcription: Let's have a party then!

PreBattle.Transcription: Wow, so many things that I haven't seen ...!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_I.Transcription: I tripled the ingredients this time!

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: The ingredient store owner said it was very effective ... Please believe me!

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: This is the gift well prepared for you!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: I've already said that Sotheby doesn't need a bodyguard!

Insight.Transcription: The expenses ... Shall I reimburse them all?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: The outside world is much bigger ... than I thought ...

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Someone is just a knight, nameless, wandering, beholden to thee for taking me in.
If thou dost not mind, please let Someone serve thee till the end.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
If it doesn't stop raining,
Someone will be the first knight to sacrifice his life because of the rusty armor.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Chivalry today is not common among young people.
In the future, will it be even worse? It really makes Someone worry.

Idle.Transcription: Sometimes Someone looks away just like thee, but no one hath noticed it.

Greetings.Transcription: Bonjour, comment allez-vous?

Morning.Transcription:
Good morning.
Someone is practicing how to rotate the plate on the tip of the sword and keep balance.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
In the age when Someone lived, breakfast is not customary.
However, thy meal looks so delicious that Someone would like to have some grease for himself.

Night.Transcription:
Are you worried about going bald if you stay up late?
Someone hath an ancient secret recipe from my Lord ...
Oh, please do not look at the portrait of his grandson.
Someone believes there is no necessary connection between the two.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
Many years ago, on a starry night, an old friend drove to the moon ...
This may surprise thee, but even an elderly armor remembers things past once in a while.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
One step further, and you will be in close contact with Someone's nose ...
As long as you can hit Someone's head.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
What is the motivation for A Knight along the way? For justice. For honor. For faith ...
And for a bit of grease to prevent the armor from rusting.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Living without the body makes thee disappointed?
Then, please allow Someone to introduce thee to a trusty friend—Knight Dullahan.

Hobby.Transcription:
Don't worry. All thy efforts will pay off.
Someone once learned the difficult technique of armor maintenance, and now it can be applied to himself.

Praise.Transcription: Someone hath never doubted the reason for his loyalty to thee, and thou hast proved Someone's choice.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Someone hath experienced the fight on the battlefield, as well as the brocade bed and the rose garden.
If you'd like some stories, Someone is always at thy service.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
Even if the enemy is just an apple, A Knight will follow the code of fairness ...
So Someone only challenges one at a time.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Roland sætte luren på blodiga mundi, blæs han i med vreide;
Då rivna jord og jardir og ljod iver hav iver heier.

Monologue.Transcription:
Someone's past will fade away with poems in the wind.
And now, Someone, with the sword,
will once again build a brand new legend for thee as a knight.

Deployment.Transcription: Someone's sword hath not rusted yet.

PreBattle.Transcription: Take thy sword. Duel with Someone fair and square.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: His trumpets sound. The Judgement Day hath come.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Considering Someone's physical condition,
the investiture can be simplified.

Insight.Transcription: Thank you for taking good care of me. Someone's armor was saved from rust.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
The last time when honored, Someone was only a man too young.
But Someone's piety and oath hath been unchanged, now and always will be.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
The BSA number? I'm ... I am so sorry, I don't have a number ...
But I will make every effort to do my best. Trust me, please!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: It's cloudy again. What does Arlington look like now?

To_the_Future.Transcription: In the future, I hope both boys and girls can join the scouts, freely.

Idle.Transcription: I will make my plan even when the commander is not here.

Greetings.Transcription: ... Hmm? You're here.

Morning.Transcription: Good morning. Let me help you put the tent away, please.

Bond_Morning.Transcription: Good morning. I will sketch the way you wake up now in my diary.

Night.Transcription: Good evening. Please rest early. It's always right to have a regular schedule.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
The stars ... They are so beautiful ... If I stay longer ...
No! No, we should all go to bed! Good night!

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription: Am I wearing it right?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
If you want to get along with another Boy Scout,
extend your left hand and firmly grasp their left hand.
This is how we greet each other.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: ... I have my father's military badge in my necklace. It will lead my way.

Hobby.Transcription:
All the soldiers were collecting badges, so was father, wasn't he?
When I collect enough badges, I will give him all of them.

Praise.Transcription: Tough. Brave. Never give up. You've done a great job.

Intimacy.Transcription: Please praise me ... Will you?

Chitchat_I.Transcription: Yes, I'm here. Do you need my help?

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
I like photos very much. It's the Arcane Skill that allows people to "never fade."
Let's take pictures together later.

Monologue.Transcription:
It is you who convinced me ...
that even if I don't join the Boy Scouts,
I could stand on my own.

Deployment.Transcription: Be prepared!

PreBattle.Transcription: I will assist you to keep the battle under control.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Flaws! Take the offensive!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Did I meet your expectations?

Insight.Transcription: ... Is this a reward for me?

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: Thank you for your appreciation, commander ... I will not stop making efforts.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
Good day! My name is Nick Bottom, the weaver in town.
I've also acted in dramas. Let me play the lion. Let me play the hero ...
Ahaha, yes, yes, now I will but make an ass!

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: A foggy day ... Does it also come from her magic?

To_the_Future.Transcription: All shall be well, haha, Jack shall have Jill.

Idle.Transcription: Oh oh! It's alright. I am very good at entertaining myself.

Greetings.Transcription: Heh heh, at your service.

Morning.Transcription: Planer, saw, needle and thread. It's a new day!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
What a pity! No one would live in a dream forever.
I am willing to pay everything to come back the midsummer night.

Night.Transcription: Birds have all returned. Only Bottom is still wandering, here and there.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
What are these? I gathered the rosemary and parsley from the forest.
I wish there is a chance to send them tonight.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
I can make costumes.
Dukes and ladies, goats and birds, everyone needs masks! Do you need it too?

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
... What do you want?
A table, chair, clothes or a statue, I can make it with these hands and give it to you.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: If I become a complete ass, would that be better than now?

Hobby.Transcription:
Yeah, yeah, I am very grateful for the drama.
I will play this role until ... until which day?

Praise.Transcription: You are not frightened by my ass head. You are much better than my friends!

Intimacy.Transcription:
Although I'm but a weaver,
as long as you want anything, I will try my best to find it.

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
In addition to my job, I'm also good at spinning around. Yes, donkey work.
I'm best at this kind of useless work, just like love.

Chitchat_II.Transcription: What's in a name? That which we call a rose by any other word would smell as sweet.

Monologue.Transcription:
I don't know plays. I'm but a rugged craftsman ...
But who knows? No one. Each one of us is in the play.

Deployment.Transcription: Cobweb, Peaseblossom, Mustardseed ... Good masters are all here.

Select_Incantation_II.Transcription: Just as easy as dealing with wood and cloth.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: It's a dream I shall never forget.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: One Two Three. Fall asleep with me.

Battle_Victory.Transcription: This is a perfect ending!

Insight.Transcription:
Rounds after rounds, the wheat in the mill will be crushed in the round.
Days after days, she will come to me one day.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription: My steps are more brisker!

First_Encounter.Transcription:
As long as you watch my flight once, you will never forget my name.
I am Lilya. In other words, I am your Goddess of Victory.

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription: The wind ... It's most comfortable now. Let's take off!

To_the_Future.Transcription:
I'm not sure what's going on now, but it would be nice to soar into the air.
We will need your help. Take us to the future, will you?

Idle.Transcription:
Oh? Oh ...! Hey ... Здра́вствуй?
Can anyone hear my voice? Any man alive?

Greetings.Transcription: Don't be in and out. You're bugging me.

Morning.Transcription: Good morning, Mr. Golden Sun!

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
Come and tell me what dreams you had yesterday.
No one cares about your dreams though.
I just want to listen to something for breakfast to shatter the boredom.

Night.Transcription:
Go. Don't be annoying. I am going to take care of my lady Su-01ве now.
You want to help? What if you break it?

Bond_Night.Transcription:
There's still a vacancy behind me on my broomstick. Would you like to ride together?
Of course, if you dare to vomit on my back, I won't spare you.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
You should be grateful that I am too lazy to move now.
Or you should know the first-class pilot's got a first-class head-butt, too.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription:
You must learn to control your wrist first to ride a broomstick ...
You know, there are many recruits who break their legs every year.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription: Feel awesome? Now it's my turn to pet you.

Hobby.Transcription:
If you haven't tried Kholodets with блин, you've never really lived.
Come here! I will show you the real Russian style.

Praise.Transcription:
How can anyone not know how to appreciate Su-01ве!
Look at her elegant lines. Look at her wonderful propulsion system.
Listen to her operation. It is music from heaven.

Intimacy.Transcription:
Hasn't the flight been approved yet? Forget it. Sit in your seat.
I will lift your body up, and make sure you look like flying in the air ...

Chitchat_I.Transcription: If all the rules of the flight manual shall be followed, I'd rather take the train.

Chitchat_II.Transcription:
Не слышны в саду даже шорохи
Всё здесь замерло до утра
Если б знали вы, как мне дороги
Подмосковные вечера.

Monologue.Transcription:
I like the feeling of flying high at the highest speed.
I can split the air like a knife.
Nothing could catch me, they can only see my red shadow.

Deployment.Transcription: No wingman is needed.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: Swallow my exhaust!

Battle_Victory.Transcription: Hah ... Red-38 is about to return.

Insight.Transcription: Limit? Still a long way off. Go ahead.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
Well done. Now I will bring countless victories as red flash.
You ... you made the right choice. I'll give you half of the medals.
Thank me for being generous.

First_Encounter.Transcription:
I am Druvis III. It's my pleasure to meet you.
... You said I didn't look very pleased?
Hah ... How about now?

Suitcase_Climate.Transcription:
Water travels from the ground to the sky, and then falls back;
just as I, who come from the forest, and now go back.

To_the_Future.Transcription:
Perhaps when the dream of industrial society is realized,
no one will ever cut down the dense forest.
I am looking forward to that day.

Idle.Transcription: ... Are you also listening to the wind dancing on the treetops?

Greetings.Transcription: You brought me a gentle breeze on the field.

Morning.Transcription:
When the sun rose, the beasts kept silence.
Then, I heard a bird flapping its wings. It's the first to leave the forest.

Bond_Morning.Transcription:
If you are lazier and get up even later, you won't see such a beautiful sunrise.
... Does it matter?

Night.Transcription: Tides of time rise and fall. Days and nights switch and whirl. The infinite loop will never come to an end.

Bond_Night.Transcription:
The night falls. The beasts howl. The owls sob.
Their feet treading on the ground are just like the roots embedded into the soil.

Hat_and_Hair.Transcription:
The green eyes are inherited from my mother.
Although I did not grow into a lady of the upper class as she wished ...
... I thank my mother for everything she left.

Sleeves_and_Hands.Transcription: When I first saw trees and grass, I knew my life belonged to them.

Clothing_and_Torso.Transcription:
Gowns and heels will not stop me.
I will jump into the woods, as I have done this countless times.

Hobby.Transcription:
It is a pleasure to be alone in the forest.
In a flash, cards of days and nights are shuffled.

Praise.Transcription: Your excellence proves my insight.

Intimacy.Transcription:
I am not good at socializing with others, nor do I understand the truth behind ambiguity.
Is that a loss?

Chitchat_I.Transcription:
There is nothing new for trees and grass.
With no eyesight, nor hearing, they know it all. And I will lend an ear to their whispers.

Chitchat_II.Transcription: After I brew my Celtic ale, I hope everyone will appreciate it.

Monologue.Transcription:
Revenge is only the self-comfort of those who are drowning in the past,
while I choose to look ahead.

Deployment.Transcription: Let's go where trees and grass grow.

PreBattle.Transcription: You should not make an enemy of the earth.

Select_Ultimate.Transcription: The reticent woods are watching you.

Cast_Arcane_Skill_II.Transcription: Frostdew is the armor of the forest.

Cast_Ultimate.Transcription: I weave the gown with thorns. You shall repay with sacrifice of wounds.

Battle_Victory.Transcription:
Just like the prophecies of the woods,
the scales have already been tipped in my direction.
I win today, and so will tomorrow.

Insight.Transcription:
Thank you for showing me the beacon.
It will allow me to go farther and deeper into the woods.

Bottom_of_Insight.Transcription:
From now on, I will see and understand more.
You helped me, and I will give you an appropriate return.
